/-- A set that is the image of a connected space under a continuous map is connected: the circle (image of `ℝ`), the
sphere and the torus (images of `ℝ²`), `ℝⁿ` (image of itself). -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Connected.connected_of_.statement:
theorem connected_of_range (X Y : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [ConnectedSpace X] (S : Set Y)
    (f : X → Y) (hf : Continuous f) (hS : range f = S) : IsConnected S

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Bijective.mul_exp_bijOn.doc: /-- `x ↦ a eˣ` (`a > 0`) is a bijection of `ℝ` onto the positive numbers: `exp` for `a = 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Bijective.mul_exp_bijOn.statement: theorem mul_exp_bijOn (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : Set.BijOn (fun x => a * Real.exp x) Set.univ (Set.Ioi 0)

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Homeomorphism.stereoInv.doc:
/-- The inverse `(u, v) ↦ (2u, 2v, u² + v² - r)/(u² + v² + r)` (`r > 0`) is continuous on the whole plane: `σ⁻¹` for
`r = 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Homeomorphism.stereoInv.statement:
theorem stereoInv_continuous (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ![2 * q.1 / (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r), 2 * q.2 / (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r),
      (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 - r) / (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r)])

KaluzaKlein.Sets.QuotientTopology.cylind.doc:
/-- The boundary of the cylinder is two circles: the height `v` descends to the quotient and separates the images of
the top and bottom edges, so their union is not connected. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.QuotientTopology.cylind.statement:
theorem cylinder_boundary_disconnected (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    ¬ IsPreconnected (Quotient.mk (edgeSetoid L false) '' topBottom L)

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Injective.exp_mul_injec.statement: theorem exp_mul_injective (a : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) : Function.Injective (fun x => Real.exp (a * x))

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Equivalence.modEq_equiv.doc: /-- Congruence modulo `n` is an equivalence relation on `ℤ` (parity for `n = 2`). -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Equivalence.modEq_equiv.statement: theorem modEq_equivalence (n : ℤ) : Equivalence (fun a b : ℤ => n ∣ a - b)

KaluzaKlein.Sets.FiniteTopologies.card_f.doc:
/-- There are `2^(2ⁿ)` families of subsets of an `n`-element set: `2⁸ = 256` for three points, `2¹⁶ = 65536` for
four. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.FiniteTopologies.card_f.statement: theorem card_families (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Finset (Finset (Fin n))) = 2 ^ 2 ^ n

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Continuous.elementary_c.doc: /-- Combinations of `cos`, `sin`, `exp` and a polynomial are continuous on `ℝ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Continuous.elementary_c.statement:
theorem elementary_continuous (a b c : ℝ) (p : Polynomial ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun x => a * Real.cos x + b * Real.sin x + c * Real.exp x + p.eval x)

KaluzaKlein.Sets.OpenSets.discs_open_clo.doc:
/-- For radius `√r`: the open disc is open, the closed disc and the circle are closed, and for `r > 0` the circle is
not open: every ball around a point of the circle contains points off it. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.OpenSets.discs_open_clo.statement:
theorem discs_open_closed (r : ℝ) :
    IsOpen {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 < r} ∧ IsClosed {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ r} ∧
      IsClosed {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r} ∧ (0 < r → ¬ IsOpen {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r})

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Sets.half_odd_not_int.doc: /-- A half-odd number is not an integer (`½ ∉ ℤ`): `ℤ ⊊ ℚ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Sets.half_odd_not_int.statement: theorem half_odd_not_int (m : ℤ) : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, (k : ℚ) = (2 * m + 1) / 2

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Homeomorphism.square_ho.doc:
/-- The boundary of a square is homeomorphic to the circle by radial projection `x ↦ x/|x|`, with inverse
`y ↦ r y / max(|y₁|, |y₂|)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Homeomorphism.square_ho.statement:
theorem square_homeomorph_circle (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ e : squareBoundary r ≃ₜ circle, ∀ p, (e p : ℝ × ℝ) =
      (p.1.1 / Real.sqrt (p.1.1 ^ 2 + p.1.2 ^ 2), p.1.2 / Real.sqrt (p.1.1 ^ 2 + p.1.2 ^ 2))

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Homeomorphism.stereo_co.doc:
/-- Projection from the point of height `c` on the `Z`-axis, `(X, Y, Z) ↦ (X, Y)/(c - Z)`, is continuous where
`Z ≠ c`: stereographic projection (`c = 1`) is continuous on the sphere minus the north pole. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Homeomorphism.stereo_co.statement:
theorem stereo_continuousOn (c : ℝ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun p : Fin 3 → ℝ => (p 0 / (c - p 2), p 1 / (c - p 2))) {p | p 2 ≠ c}

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Connected.graph_compone.doc: /-- The graph `AB, BC, DE` has the two components `{A, B, C}` and `{D, E}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Connected.graph_compone.statement: theorem graph_components (u v : Fin 5) : graphABCDE.Reachable u v ↔ (u.val < 3 ↔ v.val < 3)

KaluzaKlein.Sets.QuotientTopology.sphere.doc:
/-- For `p₀` on the sphere, the quotient of `SO(3)` by "same image of `p₀`" is homeomorphic to the sphere by
`[g] ↦ g · p₀`: a continuous bijection from a compact space onto a Hausdorff one (for the north pole, this is
`SO(3)/SO(2) ≅ S²`). -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.QuotientTopology.sphere.statement:
theorem sphere_quotient_homeomorph (p₀ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ sphere) :
    ∃ e : Quotient (orbitSetoid p₀) ≃ₜ sphere, ∀ g : SO3t, (e ⟦g⟧ : Fin 3 → ℝ) =
      (g : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) *ᵥ p₀

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Sets.circle_slice.doc: /-- The circle meets the line `Y = c` (`|c| < 1`) in the two points `(±√(1 - c²), c)`: for `c = ½`, `(±√3/2, ½)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Sets.circle_slice.statement:
theorem circle_slice (c : ℝ) (hc : c ^ 2 < 1) :
    circle ∩ {p | p.2 = c} = {(Real.sqrt (1 - c ^ 2), c), (-Real.sqrt (1 - c ^ 2), c)}

KaluzaKlein.Sets.OpenSets.parabola_ball.doc:
/-- Around a point `(u₀, v₀)` above the parabola, the ball of radius `δ = min(1, (v₀ - u₀²)/(2|u₀| + 2))` stays above
it: the explicit radius behind the openness (the solution samples such balls). -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.OpenSets.parabola_ball.statement:
theorem parabola_ball (u₀ v₀ u v : ℝ) (h : u₀ ^ 2 < v₀) (hu : |u - u₀| < min 1 ((v₀ - u₀ ^ 2) / (2 * |u₀| + 2)))
    (hv : |v - v₀| < min 1 ((v₀ - u₀ ^ 2) / (2 * |u₀| + 2))) : u ^ 2 < v

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Quotients.add_descends.doc: /-- Addition descends to the remainders: if `a ≡ a'` and `b ≡ b'` modulo `n`, then `a + b ≡ a' + b'`. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Quotients.add_descends.statement: theorem add_descends (n a a' b b' : ℤ) (ha : a ≡ a' [ZMOD n]) (hb : b ≡ b' [ZMOD n]) : a + b ≡ a' + b' [ZMOD n]

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Injective.cubic_strictM.doc: /-- `x ↦ x³ + ax` (`a ≥ 0`) is strictly increasing, hence injective: `x³ + x` among them. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Injective.cubic_strictM.statement:
theorem cubic_strictMono (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : StrictMono (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 + a * x) ∧
    Function.Injective (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 + a * x)

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Connected.components_pa.doc:
/-- The connected components partition a space: each point lies in its component, and two components are equal or
disjoint. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Connected.components_pa.statement:
theorem components_partition (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] (x y : X) :
    x ∈ connectedComponent x ∧
      (connectedComponent x = connectedComponent y ∨ Disjoint (connectedComponent x) (connectedComponent y))

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Products.remainders_dis.doc: /-- Two distinct remainders `r, s < n` are not congruent modulo `n`: the `n` classes are distinct. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Products.remainders_dis.statement: theorem remainders_distinct (n r s : ℕ) (hr : r < n) (hs : s < n) (h : (r : ℤ) ≡ s [ZMOD n]) : r = s

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Equivalence.closeness_n.doc: /-- Closeness `|x - y| < 1` is not transitive (Sage finds `0 ∼ 0.9 ∼ 1.8`, `|0 - 1.8| ≥ 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Equivalence.closeness_n.statement: theorem closeness_not_trans : ∃ x y z : ℝ, |x - y| < 1 ∧ |y - z| < 1 ∧ ¬ |x - z| < 1

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Equivalence.closeness_t.doc:
/-- On `(a, a + 1) ∪ (b, b + 1)` with a gap `b > a + 2`, the chains of closeness steps cannot cross the gap: two
points are related by the generated equivalence relation exactly when they lie in the same interval (two classes; for
`(0, 1) ∪ (5, 6)`, `a = 0`, `b = 5`). -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Equivalence.closeness_t.statement:
theorem closeness_two_pieces (a b : ℝ) (hab : a + 2 < b) (x y : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Ioo a (a + 1) ∪ Set.Ioo b (b + 1))
    (hy : y ∈ Set.Ioo a (a + 1) ∪ Set.Ioo b (b + 1)) :
    Relation.EqvGen (fun p q : ↥(Set.Ioo a (a + 1) ∪ Set.Ioo b (b + 1)) => |(p : ℝ) - (q : ℝ)| < 1)
      ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ ↔
      (x < a + 1 ↔ y < a + 1)

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Subspace.reciprocals_di.doc:
/-- The points `c/n` (`n ≥ 1`, `c > 0`) form a discrete subspace of `ℝ`: each is cut out by a small interval
(`{1/n}` for `c = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Subspace.reciprocals_di.statement: theorem reciprocals_discrete (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) : DiscreteTopology (range (fun n : ℕ => c / (n + 1)))

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Equivalence.closeness_e.doc:
/-- The smallest equivalence relation containing `|x - y| < ε` (`ε > 0`) relates every pair of real numbers: one
class, all of `ℝ` (the line is connected). -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Equivalence.closeness_e.statement: theorem closeness_eqvGen (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (x y : ℝ) : Relation.EqvGen (fun a b : ℝ => |a - b| < ε) x y

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Hausdorff.finite_hausdo.doc: /-- A finite Hausdorff space is discrete: the discrete topology is the only Hausdorff topology on a finite set. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Hausdorff.finite_hausdo.statement: theorem finite_hausdorff_discrete (X : Type) [Finite X] [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] : DiscreteTopology X

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Connected.GL_not_connec.doc:
/-- The invertible `n × n` matrices (`n ≥ 1`) are not connected: `{det > 0}` and `{det < 0}` are disjoint non-empty
open sets covering them (`GL(2, ℝ)` for `n = 2`). -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Connected.GL_not_connec.statement: theorem GL_not_connected (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : ¬ IsPreconnected {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ | A.det ≠ 0}

KaluzaKlein.Sets.Quotients.circle_quotie.doc:
/-- `[φ] ↦ (cos(2πφ/T), sin(2πφ/T))` is a bijection from `ℝ/Tℤ` (`T > 0`) onto the circle: for `T = 2π`,
`[φ] ↦ (cos φ, sin φ)` identifies `ℝ/2πℤ` with the circle. -/
KaluzaKlein.Sets.Quotients.circle_quotie.statement:
theorem circle_quotient_bijective (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∃ F : Quotient (angleSetoid T) → circle, Function.Bijective F ∧
      ∀ φ, (F ⟦φ⟧ : ℝ × ℝ) = wrap (2 * Real.pi * φ / T)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Exercises.fiel.doc: /-- `F_{μν} F^{μν} = 2 (B² - E²)`, as the trace of `F (F^{··})ᵀ`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.doc: /-- The functions on a finite set `X` form a space of dimension `|X|`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.statement: theorem finrank_functions (X : Type*) [Fintype X] : finrank ℝ (X → ℝ) = Fintype.card X

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..doc: /-- `|v|² = 41` from the standard coordinates `(5, 4)` and from the `f`-coordinates `(2, 1)` with the Gram matrix. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualBasis.pair.doc:
/-- Vector components transform with `A⁻¹`, covector components with `A`, and the pairing is invariant:
`α'_j v'^j = α_i v^i` for `v' = A⁻¹ v`, `α' = α A`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualBasis.pair.statement:
theorem pairing_invariant {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ) (h : IsUnit A.det) (v α : Fin n → ℚ) :
    (α ᵥ* A) ⬝ᵥ (A⁻¹ *ᵥ v) = α ⬝ᵥ v

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.n.doc: /-- The real functions on an infinite set (here `ℕ`) form an infinite-dimensional space. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.n.statement: theorem not_finiteDimensional_functions (X : Type) [Infinite X] : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ (X → ℝ)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.doc: /-- Linearity on `f = 3 + 2 cos φ`, `g = 1 - sin 2φ`: `I(f) = 6π`, `I(g) = 2π`, `I(f + g) = 8π`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement:
theorem integral_f_g :
    (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (3 + 2 * Real.cos φ)) = 6 * Real.pi ∧
      (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (1 - Real.sin (2 * φ))) = 2 * Real.pi ∧
      (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ((3 + 2 * Real.cos φ) + (1 - Real.sin (2 * φ)))) = 8 * Real.pi

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.doc: /-- `V* ⊗ V*` has the dimension `9` of the bilinear forms (`3 × 3` matrices) on `ℝ³`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.statement:
theorem finrank_dual_dual :
    finrank ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ) ⊗[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ)) = 9

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualSpace.finr.statement:
theorem finrank_dual {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] :
    finrank K (Module.Dual K V) = finrank K V

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MinkowskiResul.doc: /-- `η η = 1`: `η` is its own inverse, `η^{μν} η_{νρ} = δ^μ_ρ`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.doc: /-- `a L₁ + b L₂ + c L₃` in components. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.a.doc: /-- `(1, 1, 0)` lies on neither the first nor the second coordinate axis. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.a.statement:
theorem axes_union_not_closed :
    (![1, 1, 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) ∉ ({v | v 1 = 0 ∧ v 2 = 0} ∪ {v | v 0 = 0 ∧ v 2 = 0} : Set (Fin 3 → ℝ))

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.f.statement:
theorem finrank_sym_add_antisym (n : ℕ) :
    finrank ℝ (symMatrices n) + finrank ℝ (antisymMatrices n) = n ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.p.doc: /-- The plane `x + y + z = 0` is closed under scaling. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.p.statement: theorem plane0_smul (t a b c : ℝ) (h : a + b + c = 0) : t * a + t * b + t * c = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.statement: theorem plane_basis_independent : LinearIndependent ℝ ![(![1, -1, 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ), ![0, 1, -1]]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.doc: /-- `diag(1, 1, 0) = e₁ ⊗ e₁ + e₂ ⊗ e₂` has rank two: a sum of two elementary tensors that is not elementary. -/

KaluzaKlein.Linear.D_kernel_const.doc: /-- The constants are in the kernel of the derivative. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.statement: theorem quadratic_form_S (x y : ℝ) : !![x, y] * !![(1 : ℝ), 2; 2, 4] * !![x; y] = !![x ^ 2 + 4 * x * y + 4 * y ^ 2]

KaluzaKlein.Linear.trace_basis_independe.doc: /-- The trace does not depend on the basis: `tr (P⁻¹ T P) = tr T` for any invertible `P`. -/
KaluzaKlein.Linear.trace_basis_independe.statement:
theorem trace_basis_independent {n : ℕ} (T P Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ) (hPQ : Q * P = 1) :
    Matrix.trace (Q * T * P) = Matrix.trace T

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.finr.statement: theorem finrank_rn (n : ℕ) : finrank ℝ (Fin n → ℝ) = n

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.lagrange.doc: /-- A vanishing `a (1 - x) + b x = a + (b - a) x` has `a = 0` and `b = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.lagrange.statement: theorem lagrange_coefficients (a b : ℝ) (h0 : a = 0) (h1 : b - a = 0) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.NondegenerateF.doc: /-- The vectors pairing to zero with everything under `S` form the line through `(2, -1)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.NondegenerateF.statement:
theorem S_kernel_line :
    Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range ![![(2 : ℚ), -1]]) = LinearMap.ker KaluzaKlein.Linear.S.mulVecLin

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.mem_span.doc: /-- Its elements are the first Fourier modes `a cos φ + b sin φ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.mem_span.statement:
theorem mem_span_cos_sin (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    f ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![Real.cos, Real.sin]) ↔ ∃ a b : ℝ, f = fun φ => a * Real.cos φ + b * Real.sin φ

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.S_si.doc: /-- `S = (1, 2; 2, 4)` has signature `(1, 0, 1)`, through `Pᵀ S P = diag(1, 0)` (`KaluzaKlein.Linear.S_sylvester`). -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualBasis.dual.doc: /-- `f¹(5, 4) = 2` and `f²(5, 4) = 1`: the rows of `F⁻¹` applied to `(5, 4)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.doc: /-- The components of `u ⊗ v` in `f`: `A X Aᵀ = u vᵀ` with `X = (1, -1, -1; 1, -1, -1; 3, -3, -3)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.doc: /-- Coefficients exist: `λ¹ v₁ + λ² v₂ + λ⁴ v₄ = (4, 7, 2)` componentwise. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.statement:
theorem combination_solve_exists : ∃ l1 l2 l4 : ℚ,
    l1 * 1 + l2 * 0 + l4 * 0 = 4 ∧ l1 * 2 + l2 * 1 + l4 * 0 = 7 ∧ l1 * 0 + l2 * 1 + l4 * 1 = 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.doc:
/-- Linear independence is mathlib's `LinearIndependent`: for a finite family, a vanishing combination has zero
coefficients. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.statement:
theorem linearIndependent_iff_coeffs {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι] [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V] (v : ι → V) :
    LinearIndependent ℚ v ↔ ∀ g : ι → ℚ, ∑ i, g i • v i = 0 → ∀ i, g i = 0

KaluzaKlein.Linear.coordinates_f_exist.doc:
/-- The coordinates of `(5, 4)` in the basis `f`: a solution of `2a + b = 5`, `a + 2b = 4` exists (Veriphy
`witness` recipe finds `a = 2`, `b = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.Linear.coordinates_f_exist.statement: theorem coordinates_f_exist : ∃ a b : ℚ, 2 * a + b = 5 ∧ a + 2 * b = 4

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.so3_coef.doc: /-- A vanishing `a L₁ + b L₂ + c L₃` has `a = b = c = 0` (its entries `X₂₃ = -a`, `X₁₃ = b`, `X₁₂ = -c`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.so3_coef.statement: theorem so3_coefficients (a b c : ℝ) (h23 : -a = 0) (h13 : b = 0) (h12 : -c = 0) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.p.doc: /-- Two points of the plane `x + y + z = 1` add to a point with coordinate sum `2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.p.statement:
theorem plane1_add (a b c a' b' c' : ℝ) (h : a + b + c = 1) (h' : a' + b' + c' = 1) :
    (a + a') + (b + b') + (c + c') = 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.doc: /-- The products `e_i ⊗ f_a` of basis vectors form a basis of `V ⊗ W` (indexed by pairs `(i, a)`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.statement:
noncomputable def tensorBasis {K V W ι κ : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W]
    [Module K W] (e : Basis ι K V) (f : Basis κ K W) : Basis (ι × κ) K (V ⊗[K] W)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.i.doc: /-- The identity map as a type `(1, 1)` tensor has the identity matrix of components. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.i.statement: theorem identity_components (i j : Fin 3) : (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j = if i = j then 1 else 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.eucl.doc: /-- The dot product on `ℝ³` has signature `(3, 0, 0)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.nul.doc: /-- The kernel of the derivative (the constants) has dimension `3 - 2 = 1`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.cir.doc: /-- The circle parametrisation `φ ↦ (cos φ, sin φ)` is not linear (it sends `0` to `(1, 0)`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.cir.statement: theorem circle_not_linear : ¬ ∃ f : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 2 → ℝ), ∀ φ, f φ = ![Real.cos φ, Real.sin φ]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.s.doc: /-- The symmetric matrices `A`, `B` of the exercise, and their sum, are symmetric. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.HasS.doc:
/-- `S` has signature `(p, q, z)`: an invertible `P` brings it by congruence to a diagonal matrix with `p` positive,
`q` negative and `z` zero entries (Veriphy's `Veriphy.Linear.HasSignature`, which counts the entries of the diagonal
with `Finset.filter`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.HasS.statement: abbrev HasSignature {K : Type*} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] {n : ℕ} (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (p q z : ℕ) : Prop

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.span.statement:
theorem span_dimension_coords_exist : ∃ a b c : ℚ,
    a * 1 + b * 0 + c * 0 = 2 ∧ a * 2 + b * 1 + c * 0 = 5 ∧ a * 0 + b * 1 + c * 1 = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.s.doc: /-- The unit sphere `v · v = 1` is not a subspace (it misses `0`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.s.statement:
theorem sphere_not_subspace :
    ¬ ∃ S : Submodule ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ), (S : Set (Fin 3 → ℝ)) = {v | v ⬝ᵥ v = 1}

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Components.det.doc: /-- `det T' = det T` for a type `(1, 1)` tensor, `T' = A⁻¹ T A`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Components.det.statement: theorem det_mixed {n : ℕ} (A T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (h : IsUnit A.det) : (A⁻¹ * T * A).det = T.det

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MinkowskiResul.doc: /-- `det < 0` does not fix `q`: `diag(1, -1, 1, 1)` (one negative direction) has the same determinant as `η`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.nonmembe.doc: /-- `(1, 1, 1) = a v₁ + b v₂` is contradictory: `a = 1`, `2a + b = 1`, `b = 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.nonmembe.statement: theorem nonmember_contradiction (a b : ℚ) (h1 : a = 1) (h2 : 2 * a + b = 1) (h3 : b = 1) : False

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualSpace.doub.doc: /-- `v ↦ ev_v` is a linear isomorphism `V ≃ V**` in finite dimension. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualSpace.doub.statement:
noncomputable def doubleDual (K V : Type*) [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] :
    V ≃ₗ[K] Module.Dual K (Module.Dual K V)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.doc: /-- `α ⊗ v` acts as the linear map `w ↦ α(w) v`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.statement:
theorem dualTensor_apply {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (α : Module.Dual ℝ V) (v w : V) :
    dualTensorHom ℝ V V (α ⊗ₜ v) w = α w • v

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.doc: /-- `dim (U + W) = 3`, from `dim (U + W) + dim (U ∩ W) = dim U + dim W = 2 + 2` and `dim (U ∩ W) = 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.statement: theorem finrank_U_sup_W : finrank ℚ (U ⊔ W : Submodule ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ)) = 3

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Contraction.S_.doc: /-- Contracting `i` with `k`, component by component: `S^{i j}_i = (3, 3, 4)_j`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Contraction.S_.statement: theorem S_contraction_component (j : Fin 3) : ∑ i, S i j i = ![(3 : ℚ), 3, 4] j

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.ra.doc:
/-- A non-zero `2 × n` matrix has rank `1` exactly when its rows are proportional (stated with a non-zero first
row; the other case is symmetric). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.ra.statement:
theorem rank_one_iff_proportional {K : Type*} [Field K] {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin n) K) (h0 : A 0 ≠ 0) :
    A.rank = 1 ↔ ∃ c : K, A 1 = c • A 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.v12_inde.doc: /-- A vanishing combination of `v₁, v₂` has zero coefficients (`a = 0`, `2a + b = 0`, `b = 0`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.v12_inde.statement: theorem v12_independent_coefficients (a b : ℚ) (h1 : a = 0) (h2 : 2 * a + b = 0) (h3 : b = 0) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0

KaluzaKlein.Linear.finrank_tensor.statement: theorem finrank_tensor : Module.finrank ℝ (TensorProduct ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ) (Fin 3 → ℝ)) = 9

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.doc: /-- A form is symmetric exactly when its matrix is: `B(v, w) = B(w, v)` for all `v, w` iff `Bᵀ = B`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.statement:
theorem symmetric_iff {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (∀ v w, Matrix.toBilin' B v w = Matrix.toBilin' B w v) ↔ Bᵀ = B

KaluzaKlein.Linear.dual_f_mul.doc:
/-- The dual basis of `f`, as the rows of the inverse of the matrix with columns `f₁, f₂`: it multiplies that
matrix to the identity (Veriphy `matrix_from_goal` recipe). -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.statement: theorem pair_dependent : ¬ LinearIndependent ℚ ![(![2, 1] : Fin 2 → ℚ), ![4, 2]]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.so3_basi.doc: /-- `L₁, L₂, L₃` is a basis of `𝔰𝔬(3)`: independent and spanning, hence `dim 𝔰𝔬(3) = 3`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.so3_basi.statement: theorem so3_basis_card : finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![L1, L2, L3])) = 3

KaluzaKlein.Linear.S_det.doc: /-- Its determinant vanishes (Veriphy `matrix_from_goal` recipe, closed `det` formula). -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.doc: /-- Every antisymmetric `3 × 3` matrix is `X₃₂ L₁ + X₁₃ L₂ + X₂₁ L₃`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.statement:
theorem antisym_eq_combination (X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hX : Xᵀ = -X) :
    X = X 2 1 • L1 + X 0 2 • L2 + X 1 0 • L3

KaluzaKlein.Linear.eta_lower.doc: /-- Lowering the index of `(2, 1, 0, 3)` with `η` gives `(2, -1, 0, -3)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualBasis.dual.doc: /-- The dual basis returns coordinates: `e^i(v) = v^i`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualBasis.dual.statement:
theorem dualBasis_coord {K V ι : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (e : Basis ι K V) (i : ι) (v : V) : e.dualBasis i v = e.repr v i

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.finr.doc: /-- The span of `cos^k φ`, `k ≤ N`, has dimension `N + 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.finr.statement:
theorem finrank_span_cos_powers (N : ℕ) :
    finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun k : Fin (N + 1) => fun φ : ℝ => Real.cos φ ^ (k : ℕ)))) = N + 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.i.doc: /-- The inverse metric `g^{ij}` contracts with `g_{jk}` to `δ^i_k`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.i.statement: theorem inverse_metric {n : ℕ} (g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (h : g.det ≠ 0) : g⁻¹ * g = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualSpace.dual.doc: /-- The dual basis of a basis `e`: `e^i(e_j) = δ^i_j`, a basis of `V*`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualSpace.dual.statement:
theorem dualBasis_delta {K V ι : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (e : Basis ι K V) (i j : ι) : e.dualBasis i (e j) = if j = i then 1 else 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem integral_cos_circle : ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Real.cos φ = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.doc: /-- `sin³ φ = ¾ sin φ - ¼ sin 3φ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.statement: theorem sin_cube_combination (x : ℝ) : Real.sin x ^ 3 = 3 / 4 * Real.sin x - 1 / 4 * Real.sin (3 * x)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.a.doc: /-- The antisymmetric matrices are closed under linear combinations: they form a subspace. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.a.statement:
theorem antisym_add_smul (n : ℕ) (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = -A) (hB : Bᵀ = -B) :
    (A + c • B)ᵀ = -(A + c • B)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.statement: theorem cos_sq_add_sin_sq (x : ℝ) : Real.cos x ^ 2 + Real.sin x ^ 2 = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.statement:
theorem tensorBasis_apply {K V W ι κ : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W]
    [Module K W] (e : Basis ι K V) (f : Basis κ K W) (i : ι) (a : κ) : tensorBasis e f (i, a) = e i ⊗ₜ f a

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.det.doc: /-- A linear map is determined by its values on a basis. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.det.statement:
theorem determined_by_basis {ι V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℝ W]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ V) (f g : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (h : ∀ i, f (b i) = g (b i)) : f = g

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.doc: /-- The antisymmetric matrix with `X₁₂ = -5`, `X₁₃ = 2`, `X₂₃ = -7` is `7 L₁ + 2 L₂ + 5 L₃`. -/

KaluzaKlein.Linear.finrank_matrix3.doc: /-- The `3 × 3` real matrices form a space of dimension `9`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.doc: /-- The components of `u = (1, 2, 3)` in `f = (e₁ + e₂, e₂, e₃)` are `(1, 1, 3)`: `A (1, 1, 3)ᵀ = u`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Exercises.gram.doc: /-- Lowering: `v_i = G_{ij} v^j = (14, 13)`; raising with `G⁻¹ = ⅑ (5, -4; -4, 5)` returns `(2, 1)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.four.doc: /-- The span of all the modes has no finite dimension `N`: it contains `2N + 3` independent modes. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.four.statement:
theorem fourier_span_finrank_ne (N : ℕ) :
    ¬ (FiniteDimensional ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fourierModes)) ∧
      finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fourierModes)) = N)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..doc: /-- The determinant form `v¹ w² - v² w¹` changes sign under exchange of its arguments. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.doc: /-- `v₁ + v₂ - v₃ - v₄ = 0` for the second family. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorResults..doc: /-- The nine tensors `e_i ⊗ e_j` form a basis of `ℝ³ ⊗ ℝ³`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorResults..statement: noncomputable def basis33 : Basis (Fin 3 × Fin 3) ℝ ((Fin 3 → ℝ) ⊗[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ))

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.B_co.doc: /-- The rational congruence `Pᵀ B P = diag(2, 3/2, 4/3)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.doc: /-- A linear functional on `V` is a linear map `V → ℝ` (mathlib's `Module.Dual ℝ V`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: abbrev LinearFunctional (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.lagrange.doc: /-- The coordinates are the values at `0` and `1`: `p(0) = 2`, `p(1) = 5` for `p = 3x + 2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.lagrange.statement: theorem lagrange_values : (3 * X + 2 : ℝ[X]).eval 0 = 2 ∧ (3 * X + 2 : ℝ[X]).eval 1 = 5

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.doc: /-- The basis `e_i ⊗ f_a` of `V ⊗ W` has `dim V · dim W` elements: `|Fin m × Fin n| = m n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.statement: theorem card_fin_prod (m n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin n) = m * n

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.fBasis.doc: /-- The basis `f₁ = (2, 1)`, `f₂ = (1, 2)` of `ℚ²` (a mathlib `Basis`, from independence and the dimension count). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.fBasis.statement: noncomputable def fBasis : Basis (Fin 2) ℚ (Fin 2 → ℚ)

KaluzaKlein.Linear.dual_basis_delta.doc: /-- The dual basis evaluates to the Kronecker delta on the basis. -/
KaluzaKlein.Linear.dual_basis_delta.statement: theorem dual_basis_delta (i j : Fin 3) : (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 3)).coord i (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 3) j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.doc: /-- For the antisymmetric `J = (0, 1; -1, 0)`, `J(e₁, e₂) = 1` but the polarisation formula gives `0`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.doc: /-- The determinant of the matrix whose rows are the vectors of the first family (the transpose). -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.NondegenerateF.doc: /-- Non-degeneracy (`B(v, w) = 0` for all `w` forces `v = 0`) is equivalent to `det B ≠ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.NondegenerateF.statement: theorem nondegenerate_iff_det {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : B.Nondegenerate ↔ B.det ≠ 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem integral_one : ∫ _φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (1 : ℝ) = 2 * Real.pi

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- `|u| (v · w)` is not linear in `u`: already `u ↦ |u|` is not linear (`|-u| = |u|`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement: theorem norm_not_linear : ¬ ∃ f : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ x, f x = ‖x‖

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.statement: theorem v124_linearIndependent : LinearIndependent ℚ ![(![1, 2, 0] : Fin 3 → ℚ), ![0, 1, 1], ![0, 0, 1]]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MinkowskiResul.doc: /-- `Λᵀ η Λ = η` for the boost with rapidity `u` in the `(t, x)` plane. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualSpace.finr.doc: /-- The cotangent space, the dual of the tangent space of an `n`-manifold modelled on `ℝⁿ`, has dimension `n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualSpace.finr.statement:
theorem finrank_cotangent (n : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    finrank ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ (TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) x)) = n

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.ort.doc: /-- An orthogonal matrix (`Rᵀ R = 1`) has kernel `{0}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.ort.statement:
theorem orthogonal_ker_trivial {n : ℕ} (R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hR : Rᵀ * R = 1) (v : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hv : R *ᵥ v = 0) : v = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.finr.statement:
theorem finrank_span_v123 :
    finrank ℚ (spanOf ![KaluzaKlein.Linear.v1, KaluzaKlein.Linear.v2, KaluzaKlein.Linear.v3]) = 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.V.doc: /-- A vector space over a field `K` is a module over `K`; a subspace is a `Submodule K V`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.V.statement: abbrev VectorSpace (K V : Type*) [Field K] [AddCommGroup V]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.statement: theorem v123_dependent : ¬ LinearIndependent ℚ ![(![1, 2, 0] : Fin 3 → ℚ), ![0, 1, 1], ![1, 3, 1]]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.finr.doc: /-- The tangent space of an `n`-dimensional manifold modelled on `ℝⁿ` has dimension `n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.finr.statement:
theorem finrank_tangentSpace (n : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    finrank ℝ (TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) x) = n

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.tra.statement: theorem translation_not_linear : ¬ ∃ f : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ x, f x = x + 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.X_pow_no.doc: /-- `xⁿ` is not in the span of `1, x, …, xⁿ⁻¹` (the polynomials of degree `< n`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.X_pow_no.statement: theorem X_pow_not_mem (n : ℕ) : (X ^ n : ℝ[X]) ∉ Polynomial.degreeLT ℝ n

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualSpace.dual.statement:
theorem dual_expansion {K V ι : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (e : Basis ι K V) (α : Module.Dual K V) : ∑ i, α (e i) • e.dualBasis i = α

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.finr.doc: /-- `1, cos φ, sin φ, …, cos Nφ, sin Nφ` span a space of dimension `2N + 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.finr.statement:
theorem finrank_span_fourier_modes (N : ℕ) :
    finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fourierModes ∘ Sum.map (fun k : Fin (N + 1) => (k : ℕ))
      (fun k : Fin N => (k : ℕ))))) = 2 * N + 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Components.u_c.doc: /-- `u = (1, 2, 3)` has components `(1, 1, 3)` in the basis `f`: `A (1, 1, 3)ᵀ = u`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualBasis.coor.doc: /-- In the coordinate basis of `ℝⁿ`, `dx^i(∂_j) = δ^i_j`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualBasis.coor.statement:
theorem coordinate_differentials (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)).coord i (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n) j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..doc: /-- `v · w + 1` is not bilinear: a bilinear form vanishes at `v = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..statement: theorem dot_plus_one_not_bilinear : ¬ ∃ B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ), ∀ v w, B v w = v ⬝ᵥ w + 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualBasis.dual.doc: /-- New dual basis `e'^i = (A⁻¹)^i_k e^k`: `(A⁻¹)^i_k A^k_j = δ^i_j`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualBasis.dual.statement: theorem dual_transform_delta {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ) (h : IsUnit A.det) : A⁻¹ * A = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.f.doc: /-- The `n × n` real matrices have dimension `n²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.f.statement: theorem finrank_matrix_sq (n : ℕ) : finrank ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) = n ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.doc: /-- The linear combination `λ^i v_i` of a finite family (mathlib's `Fintype.linearCombination`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.statement: noncomputable abbrev linComb {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι] [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (v : ι → V) (c : ι → ℝ) : V

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MinkowskiResul.doc: /-- A matrix with `Λᵀ η Λ = η` preserves `η(v, v)`, hence the type of every vector. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MinkowskiResul.statement:
theorem preserves_norm {n : ℕ} (L η : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (h : Lᵀ * η * L = η) (v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (L *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (η *ᵥ (L *ᵥ v)) = v ⬝ᵥ (η *ᵥ v)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.finrank_.doc: /-- The span of `v₁, v₂` is a plane: dimension `2`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.doc: /-- A tensor with `k` indices in dimension `n` has `n^k` components (multi-indices `Fin k → Fin n`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.statement: theorem multi_index_count (n k : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Fin k → Fin n) = n ^ k

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.doc: /-- The dot product is symmetric (its matrix is the identity). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.statement: theorem identity_symm (n : ℕ) : (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)ᵀ = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorResults..doc: /-- `dim (ℝ² ⊗ ℝ³) = 6`, with the basis `e_i ⊗ f_a` indexed by `2 × 3` arrays. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorResults..statement: theorem finrank_tensor_23 : finrank ℝ ((Fin 2 → ℝ) ⊗[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ)) = 6

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.doc: /-- The matrix with columns `f₁, f₂` has determinant `3 ≠ 0`, so the coordinates are unique. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.so3_uppe.doc: /-- The entries above the diagonal of `a L₁ + b L₂ + c L₃` are `(X₁₂, X₁₃, X₂₃) = (-c, b, -a)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.so3_uppe.statement:
theorem so3_upper_entries (a b c : ℝ) :
    (a • L1 + b • L2 + c • L3) 0 1 = -c ∧ (a • L1 + b • L2 + c • L3) 0 2 = b ∧ (a • L1 + b • L2 + c • L3) 1 2 = -a

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.pro.statement: theorem product_map_not_linear : ¬ ∃ f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 2 → ℝ), ∀ v, f v = ![v 0 + v 1, v 0 * v 1]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.doc:
/-- Values at `0`, `π`, `π/2` of a vanishing `a + b cos φ + c sin φ`: `a + b = 0`, `a - b = 0`, `a + c = 0` force
`a = b = c = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.statement:
theorem trig_coefficients (a b c : ℝ) (h0 : a + b = 0) (hpi : a - b = 0) (h2 : a + c = 0) :
    a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..statement:
theorem norm_product_not_bilinear :
    ¬ ∃ B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ∀ v w, B v w = ‖v‖ * ‖w‖

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.doc: /-- The first family is independent (its determinant is `2 ≠ 0`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.statement:
theorem family_F_independent : LinearIndependent ℚ
    ![(![1, 0, 1, 0] : Fin 4 → ℚ), ![0, 1, 0, 1], ![1, 1, 0, 0], ![0, 0, 1, -1]]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.doc: /-- The algebraic core of polarisation: from the expansion `s = B(v,v) + B(v,w) + B(w,v) + B(w,w)` and symmetry. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.statement:
theorem polarisation_core (bvv bvw bwv bww s : ℝ) (hs : s = bvv + bvw + bwv + bww) (h : bvw = bwv) :
    2 * bvw = s - bvv - bww

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.R.doc: /-- The rotation by `90°` about the third axis is orthogonal. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.p.doc: /-- The plane `x + y + z = 0` is closed under addition. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.p.statement:
theorem plane0_add (a b c a' b' c' : ℝ) (h : a + b + c = 0) (h' : a' + b' + c' = 0) :
    (a + a') + (b + b') + (c + c') = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.doc: /-- Every `(x, y, z)` is `x e₁ + y e₂ + z e₃`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.statement:
theorem standard_combination (x y z : ℝ) :
    x • !![(1 : ℝ), 0, 0] + y • !![(0 : ℝ), 1, 0] + z • !![(0 : ℝ), 0, 1] = !![x, y, z]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.cos_sin_.doc: /-- A vanishing `a cos + b sin` has `a = b = 0` (values at `0` and `π/2`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.cos_sin_.statement: theorem cos_sin_coefficients (a b : ℝ) (h0 : a * 1 + b * 0 = 0) (h1 : a * 0 + b * 1 = 0) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.NondegenerateF.doc: /-- `det δ = 1` for the Euclidean form on `ℝ³`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.membersh.doc: /-- `(2, 5, 1) = a v₁ + b v₂` has a solution. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.membersh.statement: theorem membership_exists : ∃ a b : ℚ, a * 1 + b * 0 = 2 ∧ a * 2 + b * 1 = 5 ∧ a * 0 + b * 1 = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.doc: /-- `1, cos², sin²` are dependent: `1 - cos² - sin² = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.statement:
theorem one_cos_sq_sin_sq_dependent :
    ¬ LinearIndependent ℝ ![(fun _ => (1 : ℝ)), (fun x => Real.cos x ^ 2), (fun x => Real.sin x ^ 2)]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.doc: /-- The same combination through the definition. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.doc: /-- `1, cos φ, sin φ` are independent functions. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.statement:
theorem one_cos_sin_linearIndependent :
    LinearIndependent ℝ ![(fun _ => (1 : ℝ)), Real.cos, Real.sin]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem alpha_apply (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) : alpha v = 2 * v 0 + v 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Contraction.el.doc: /-- Contracting `u^i v^j α_k β_l` over `i = k`, `j = l` gives `α(u) β(v)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Contraction.el.statement:
theorem elementary_full_contraction {n : ℕ} (u v α β : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, u i * v j * α i * β j = (α ⬝ᵥ u) * (β ⬝ᵥ v)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.lagrange.statement: theorem lagrange_linearIndependent : LinearIndependent ℝ ![(1 - X : ℝ[X]), X]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- `(u, v, w) ↦ α(u) β(v) γ(w)` is linear in each argument (shown for the first). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement:
theorem product_functionals_linear {n : ℕ} (α β γ u u' v w : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (α ⬝ᵥ (u + t • u')) * (β ⬝ᵥ v) * (γ ⬝ᵥ w) =
      (α ⬝ᵥ u) * (β ⬝ᵥ v) * (γ ⬝ᵥ w) + t * ((α ⬝ᵥ u') * (β ⬝ᵥ v) * (γ ⬝ᵥ w))

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.doc: /-- The plane `x + y + z = 0` has dimension `2`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.doc:
/-- `v ⊗ w` is bilinear in `(v, w)` (mathlib's `TensorProduct.mk`), and its components are the outer product
`v^i w^a`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.statement:
theorem outer_components {m n : ℕ} (v : Fin m → ℝ) (w : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin m) (a : Fin n) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec v w i a = v i * w a

KaluzaKlein.Linear.v3_combination_coeffi.doc:
/-- `v₃` is a linear combination of `v₁` and `v₂`: coefficients exist solving the three component equations
(Veriphy `witness` recipe finds `a = b = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.Linear.v3_combination_coeffi.statement:
theorem v3_combination_coefficients :
    ∃ a b : ℚ, a * 1 + b * 0 = 1 ∧ a * 2 + b * 1 = 3 ∧ a * 0 + b * 1 = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.doc: /-- The traceless `3 × 3` matrices, the kernel of the trace, have dimension `9 - 1 = 8`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.statement:
theorem finrank_traceless :
    finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin 3) ℝ ℝ)) = 8

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.doc: /-- The parts are symmetric and antisymmetric. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MinkowskiResul.doc: /-- The determinant of a diagonal matrix is the product of its diagonal entries. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MinkowskiResul.statement: theorem det_diagonal_prod {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → ℝ) : (Matrix.diagonal d).det = ∏ i, d i

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.fourier_.doc: /-- The functions `1, cos, sin` form a basis of their span (they are independent): its dimension is `3`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.fourier_.statement:
theorem fourier_one_basis_card :
    finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![(fun _ => (1 : ℝ)), Real.cos, Real.sin])) = 3

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.doc: /-- Only the symmetric part contributes to the quadratic form. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.statement: theorem antisym_part_quadratic (x y : ℝ) : !![x, y] * !![(0 : ℝ), 3 / 2; -3 / 2, 0] * !![x; y] = !![(0 : ℝ)]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.doc: /-- Polarisation: `2 B(v, w) = B(v + w, v + w) - B(v, v) - B(w, w)` for a symmetric form. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.statement:
theorem polarisation {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB : Bᵀ = B) (v w : Fin n → ℝ) :
    2 * Matrix.toBilin' B v w =
      Matrix.toBilin' B (v + w) (v + w) - Matrix.toBilin' B v v - Matrix.toBilin' B w w

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.nul.doc: /-- The nullity of `A` is `2`: its kernel is a plane. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.doc: /-- The kernel of `2x + y` is the line `y = -2x`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem mem_ker_alpha (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) : v ∈ LinearMap.ker alpha ↔ v 1 = -2 * v 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.doc: /-- The row is unique: two rows giving the same functional are equal (evaluate at `e_j`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem row_unique {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (h : ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, a ⬝ᵥ v = b ⬝ᵥ v) : a = b

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.A_.doc: /-- `(-2, 1, 0)` and every multiple `t (1, 1, -1)` lie in the kernel of `A`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.D_m.doc: /-- `D (1, 0, 0)ᵀ = 0`: the constants are in the kernel. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..doc: /-- A bilinear form with component matrix `B`: `B(v, w) = B_{ij} v^i w^j`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..statement:
theorem bilin_components {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (v w : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Matrix.toBilin' B v w = ∑ i, ∑ j, v i * B i j * w j

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.so3_line.statement: theorem so3_linearIndependent : LinearIndependent ℝ ![L1, L2, L3]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Exercises.gram.doc: /-- The congruence `Pᵀ G P = diag(5, 9/5)` with `P = (1, -4/5; 0, 1)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualSpace.finr.statement: theorem finrank_dual_rn (n : ℕ) : finrank ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ (Fin n → ℝ)) = n

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.doc: /-- `a cos φ + b sin φ` is the linear combination `a • cos + b • sin` of the two functions. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.statement:
theorem fourier_combination (a b : ℝ) :
    (fun φ => a * Real.cos φ + b * Real.sin φ) = a • Real.cos + b • Real.sin

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Components.upp.doc: /-- Upper indices transform with `A⁻¹`, lower indices with `A`: the contraction `a_i u^i` is invariant. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Components.upp.statement:
theorem upper_lower_invariant {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (h : IsUnit A.det) (u a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (a ᵥ* A) ⬝ᵥ (A⁻¹ *ᵥ u) = a ⬝ᵥ u

KaluzaKlein.Linear.S_sylvester.doc:
/-- Sylvester: the congruence `Pᵀ S P` with `P = (1, -2; 0, 1)` diagonalises the degenerate form to `diag(1, 0)`
(Veriphy `matrix_from_goal` recipe). -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualBasis.dual.doc: /-- `f^i(f_j) = δ^i_j`: the rows of `F⁻¹` times the columns `f_j`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.p.doc: /-- The plane `x + y + z = 0` as a subspace of `ℝ³`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.p.statement:
def planeSum0 : Submodule ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ) where
  carrier

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.span_v12.doc: /-- Adding `v₃` does not enlarge the span. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.span_v12.statement:
theorem span_v123_eq : spanOf ![KaluzaKlein.Linear.v1, KaluzaKlein.Linear.v2, KaluzaKlein.Linear.v3] =
    spanOf ![KaluzaKlein.Linear.v1, KaluzaKlein.Linear.v2]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.lin.doc: /-- `(x, y) ↦ (2x - y, 0)` is linear (as the matrix `(2, -1; 0, 0)`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.lin.statement: theorem linear_example (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) : Matrix.toLin' !![(2 : ℝ), -1; 0, 0] v = ![2 * v 0 - v 1, 0]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem evaluation_linear (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : (f + c • g) 0 = f 0 + c * g 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- Linearity in the first slot: `T(2u + v, v, w) = 2 T(u, v, w) + T(v, v, w)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement: theorem T_linear (u v w : Fin 3 → ℚ) : T (2 • u + v) v w = 2 * T u v w + T v v w

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.mem.doc: /-- The kernel of `A` is the plane `x + 2y + 3z = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.mem.statement:
theorem mem_ker_A (x : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    x ∈ LinearMap.ker KaluzaKlein.Linear.A.mulVecLin ↔ x 0 + 2 * x 1 + 3 * x 2 = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Exercises.map_.doc: /-- The traces agree (`3`) and the determinants agree (`2`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Exercises.map_.statement:
theorem map_invariants :
    Matrix.trace !![(1 : ℚ), 3; 0, 2] = 3 ∧ Matrix.trace !![(8 / 3 : ℚ), 10 / 3; -1 / 3, 1 / 3] = 3 ∧
      Matrix.det !![(1 : ℚ), 3; 0, 2] = 2 ∧ Matrix.det !![(8 / 3 : ℚ), 10 / 3; -1 / 3, 1 / 3] = 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.B_ei.statement:
theorem B_eigen_minus :
    !![(2 : ℝ), 1, 0; 1, 2, 1; 0, 1, 2] * !![(1 : ℝ); -Real.sqrt 2; 1] =
      (2 - Real.sqrt 2) • !![(1 : ℝ); -Real.sqrt 2; 1]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.comp.doc: /-- The two quadratic forms as completed squares. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.ran.doc: /-- The rank of `A` is `1`: its image is the line through `(1, 2)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.m.statement: theorem mem_planeX3 (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) : v ∈ planeX3 ↔ v 2 = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..doc: /-- `v¹ w²` and `v¹ w¹ - 3 v² w¹` are bilinear: they are the forms of the matrices `(0, 1; 0, 0)` and `(1, 0; -3, 0)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.Linear.trace_T.doc:
/-- The trace of the type `(1, 1)` tensor of the contraction example is `9` (Veriphy `matrix_from_goal` recipe,
closed `trace` formula). -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.basis_b_.doc: /-- `b₁, b₂, b₃` are independent (the matrix with these rows is the transpose of the one with these columns). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.basis_b_.statement: theorem basis_b_independent : LinearIndependent ℚ ![(![1, 1, 0] : Fin 3 → ℚ), ![0, 1, 1], ![1, 0, 1]]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualSpace.eval.statement:
theorem eval_injective {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] :
    Function.Injective (Module.Dual.eval K V)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.NondegenerateF.doc: /-- Raising undoes lowering: `B⁻¹ (B v) = v` for a non-degenerate `B`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.NondegenerateF.statement: theorem raise_lower {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (h : B.det ≠ 0) (v : Fin n → ℝ) : B⁻¹ *ᵥ (B *ᵥ v) = v

KaluzaKlein.Linear.dual_f_coordinates.doc: /-- The dual basis of `f` reads off the coordinates `(2, 1)` of `(5, 4)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.lagrange.doc: /-- The coordinates of `3x + 2`: the constant and linear coefficients give `a = 2`, `-a + b = 3`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.lagrange.statement: theorem lagrange_coords_exist : ∃ a b : ℝ, a = 2 ∧ -a + b = 3

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.squ.doc: /-- `f ↦ f²` is not linear on functions (it fails homogeneity at the constant function `1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.squ.statement: theorem square_functional_not_additive : ¬ ∃ F : (ℝ → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (ℝ → ℝ), ∀ f, F f = f ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.Linear.f_independent_coeffic.doc:
/-- A vanishing combination of `f₁, f₂` has both coefficients zero (Veriphy `ideal_membership` recipe: each
coefficient is a combination of the two component equations). -/
KaluzaKlein.Linear.f_independent_coeffic.statement:
theorem f_independent_coefficients (a b : ℚ) (h1 : a * 2 + b * 1 = 0) (h2 : a * 1 + b * 2 = 0) :
    a = 0 ∧ b = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.statement: theorem cos_sq_combination (x : ℝ) : Real.cos x ^ 2 = 1 / 2 + 1 / 2 * Real.cos (2 * x)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.f.doc: /-- The polynomials of degree at most `2` form a three-dimensional subspace. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.r.doc: /-- The ranks of the tensor modules of a rank-3 free module: `3^(r + s)` for the six types of the exercise. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.r.statement:
theorem rank_three_counts :
    finrank ℝ (MixedTensor 3 1 0) = 3 ∧ finrank ℝ (MixedTensor 3 0 1) = 3 ∧ finrank ℝ (MixedTensor 3 0 2) = 9 ∧
      finrank ℝ (MixedTensor 3 1 1) = 9 ∧ finrank ℝ (MixedTensor 3 1 2) = 27 ∧ finrank ℝ (MixedTensor 3 2 2) = 81 ∧
      finrank ℝ (MixedTensor 3 2 0) = 9

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- The triple product is the determinant: `u · (v × w) = det(u | v | w)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement: theorem triple_product_det (u v w : Fin 3 → ℝ) : u ⬝ᵥ (v ⨯₃ w) = Matrix.det ![u, v, w]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.eta_.doc: /-- The Minkowski form has signature `(1, 3, 0)` (Lorentzian): it is already diagonal. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Contraction.tr.doc: /-- The cyclic property `tr (X Y) = tr (Y X)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Contraction.tr.statement: theorem trace_cyclic {n : ℕ} (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : (X * Y).trace = (Y * X).trace

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.statement:
theorem elementary_sum_right {m n : ℕ} (u w : Fin m → ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec u v + Matrix.vecMulVec w (c • v) = Matrix.vecMulVec (u + c • w) v

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.statement: theorem v1_mem_U_inf_W : KaluzaKlein.Linear.v1 ∈ (U ⊓ W : Submodule ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ))

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.dot_.doc: /-- It is an inner product: `v · v > 0` for `v ≠ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.dot_.statement: theorem dot_self_pos {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < v ⬝ᵥ v

KaluzaKlein.Linear.finrank_dual_tensor.statement:
theorem finrank_dual_tensor :
    Module.finrank ℝ (TensorProduct ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (Fin 3 → ℝ)) = 9

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Contraction.el.doc: /-- Contracting over `i = l`, `j = k` gives `β(u) α(v)` instead. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Contraction.el.statement:
theorem elementary_cross_contraction {n : ℕ} (u v α β : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, u i * v j * α j * β i = (β ⬝ᵥ u) * (α ⬝ᵥ v)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.doc: /-- The level sets are parallel: `α(v + w) = α(v)` for `w` in the kernel. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem alpha_level_sets (v w : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hw : w ∈ LinearMap.ker alpha) : alpha (v + w) = alpha v

KaluzaKlein.Linear.S_kernel.doc: /-- `(2, -1)` pairs to zero with everything: the form is degenerate. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.base.doc: /-- All bases of a finite-dimensional space have the same number of elements, the dimension. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.base.statement:
theorem bases_same_card {K V ι ι' : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype ι] [Fintype ι']
    (b : Basis ι K V) (b' : Basis ι' K V) : Fintype.card ι = Fintype.card ι'

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Exercises.det_.doc: /-- `det G = 9 = (det A)²` for the Gram matrix `G = (5, 4; 4, 5)` of `f`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Exercises.det_.statement: theorem det_gram : Matrix.det !![(5 : ℚ), 4; 4, 5] = 9 ∧ Matrix.det !![(2 : ℚ), 1; 1, 2] ^ 2 = 9

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorResults..statement:
theorem finrank_dual_tensor_general {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] :
    finrank K (Module.Dual K V ⊗[K] V) = finrank K V ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.Linear.coord_basisFun.doc: /-- The dual basis of the standard basis of `ℝⁿ` reads off coordinates: `e^i(x) = x^i`. -/
KaluzaKlein.Linear.coord_basisFun.statement: theorem coord_basisFun (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)).coord i x = x i

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.f.doc: /-- The symmetric `n × n` matrices have dimension `n (n + 1) / 2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.f.statement: theorem finrank_sym (n : ℕ) : finrank ℝ (symMatrices n) = n * (n + 1) / 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.fBasis_c.doc: /-- The coordinates of `(5, 4)` in the basis `f` are `(2, 1)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc:
/-- Sectional curvature `K(v, w) = R(v, w, w, v) / (|v|²|w|² - (v·w)²)` is not bilinear: rescaling `v` by `t ≠ 0`
multiplies numerator and denominator by `t²` and leaves `K` unchanged. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement: theorem sectional_scale_invariant (r q t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0) : (t ^ 2 * r) / (t ^ 2 * q) = r / q

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- The determinant as mathlib's alternating multilinear map of the rows. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement:
theorem det_is_alternating {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    Matrix.detRowAlternating (fun i => A i) = A.det

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem integral_cos_sq_circle : ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Real.cos φ ^ 2 = Real.pi

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.statement:
theorem finrank_triple_tensor :
    finrank ℝ ((Fin 2 → ℝ) ⊗[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) ⊗[ℝ] (Fin 4 → ℝ)) = 24

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.so3_eq_s.doc: /-- `𝔰𝔬(3)` is the span of `L₁, L₂, L₃`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.so3_eq_s.statement: theorem so3_eq_span : antisymMatrices 3 = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![L1, L2, L3])

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.plane_no.doc: /-- The normal `(2, -1, 1)` of the plane pairs to zero with `v₁` and `v₂`: the plane is `2x - y + z = 0`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.r.doc: /-- The sum of the two rotations is not a rotation: `(R₁ + R₂)ᵀ (R₁ + R₂) ≠ 1`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.spanOf.doc: /-- The span of a family, mathlib's `Submodule.span` of its range. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.spanOf.statement: abbrev spanOf {ι V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V] (v : ι → V) : Submodule ℚ V

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.doc: /-- An elementary tensor of `ℝ³ ⊗ ℝ³` has rank at most one as a matrix. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.statement: theorem rank_elementary_le (u v : Fin 3 → ℚ) : (Matrix.vecMulVec u v).rank ≤ 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.doc: /-- `dim (U ∩ W) = 1`: the intersection is the line through `(1, 2, 0)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.statement: theorem finrank_U_inf_W : finrank ℚ (U ⊓ W : Submodule ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ)) = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.sym_.doc: /-- The decomposition is unique: a matrix both symmetric and antisymmetric vanishes. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.sym_.statement: theorem sym_inf_antisym {n : ℕ} : symMatrices n ⊓ antisymMatrices n = ⊥

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Components.two.doc: /-- Two lower indices: `B'_{ij} = A^k_i A^l_j B_{kl}`, i.e. `B' = Aᵀ B A`, evaluated on new components. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Components.two.statement:
theorem two_lower {n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (x y : Fin n → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ ((Aᵀ * B * A) *ᵥ y) = (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ (A *ᵥ y))

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.v3_mem_s.doc: /-- The running example: `v₃ = (1, 3, 1)` lies in the span of `v₁, v₂` (`KaluzaKlein.Linear.v3_mem_span`). -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.statement: theorem plane_echelon_independent : LinearIndependent ℝ ![(![1, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℝ), ![0, 1, -1]]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.statement:
theorem finrank_tensor_general {K V W : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W] : finrank K (V ⊗[K] W) = finrank K V * finrank K W

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.basis_b_.doc: /-- Coordinates of `(2, 3, 4)` in the basis `b` exist. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.basis_b_.statement:
theorem basis_b_coords_exist : ∃ l1 l2 l3 : ℚ,
    l1 * 1 + l2 * 0 + l3 * 1 = 2 ∧ l1 * 1 + l2 * 1 + l3 * 0 = 3 ∧ l1 * 0 + l2 * 1 + l3 * 1 = 4

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.du.doc: /-- The dual basis of the standard basis of `ℚⁿ` is the standard basis: `1⁻¹ = 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.du.statement: theorem dual_standard (n : ℕ) : (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ)⁻¹ = 1

KaluzaKlein.Linear.S_quadratic_nonneg.doc: /-- The quadratic form of the degenerate matrix is a square, hence non-negative (Veriphy `sos` recipe). -/
KaluzaKlein.Linear.S_quadratic_nonneg.statement: theorem S_quadratic_nonneg (x y : ℝ) : 0 ≤ x ^ 2 + 4 * x * y + 4 * y ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.R.doc: /-- The rotation by `90°` about the first axis is orthogonal. -/

KaluzaKlein.Linear.contraction_a_u.doc: /-- The contraction of the covector `a = (1, 0, -1)` with `u = (1, 2, 3)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Exercises.map_.doc: /-- `A T' = T A` for `T' = ⅓ (8, 10; -1, 1)`: `T'` is the matrix of `T` in the basis `f`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.doc: /-- An independent family extended by a vector outside its span stays independent. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.statement:
theorem extend_independent {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → V) (x : V)
    (hv : LinearIndependent K v) (hx : x ∉ Submodule.span K (Set.range v)) :
    LinearIndependent K (Fin.cons x v : Fin (n + 1) → V)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem integral_sin_two : ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Real.sin (2 * φ) = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.p.statement: theorem plane1_zero_not_mem : ¬ ((0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) ∈ {v : Fin 3 → ℝ | v 0 + v 1 + v 2 = 1})

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.ke.doc: /-- `(1, 1, -1)`, `(3, 0, -1)` is a basis of `ker A`: two independent vectors in a plane. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.ke.statement:
theorem kernel_pair_spans :
    Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range ![(![1, 1, -1] : Fin 3 → ℚ), ![3, 0, -1]]) =
      LinearMap.ker KaluzaKlein.Linear.A.mulVecLin

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Components.u_c.statement: theorem u_components_unique (a b c : ℚ) (h1 : a = 1) (h2 : a + b = 2) (h3 : c = 3) : a = 1 ∧ b = 1 ∧ c = 3

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- A trilinear map in dimensions `a`, `b`, `c` has `a b c` components. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement: theorem card_fin_prod3 (a b c : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Fin a × Fin b × Fin c) = a * b * c

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.f.doc: /-- A type `(r, s)` tensor in dimension `n` has `n^(r + s)` components. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.f.statement: theorem finrank_mixed (n r s : ℕ) : finrank ℝ (MixedTensor n r s) = n ^ (r + s)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.statement: theorem plane_basis_coefficients (a b : ℝ) (h0 : a = 0) (h1 : -a + b = 0) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.der.doc: /-- The derivative sends `1 ↦ 0`, `x ↦ 1`, `x² ↦ 2x`: the columns of `D`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.der.statement:
theorem derivative_basis :
    derivative (X ^ 0 : ℝ[X]) = 0 ∧ derivative (X : ℝ[X]) = 1 ∧ derivative (X ^ 2 : ℝ[X]) = 2 * X

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.u.doc: /-- The sum of the unit vectors `e₁` and `e₂` has squared length `2` (rows times their transpose). -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.doc: /-- `(1, -2)` spans the kernel: the row `(2, 1)` pairs it to zero. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem alpha_kernel_vector : !![(2 : ℝ), 1] * !![(1 : ℝ); -2] = !![(0 : ℝ)]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..doc: /-- Under `e'_j = A^i_j e_i`, `B(A x, A y) = xᵀ (Aᵀ B A) y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..statement:
theorem change_basis_form {n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (x y : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)) = x ⬝ᵥ ((Aᵀ * B * A) *ᵥ y)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement:
theorem T_components (i j k : Fin 3) :
    T (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) (Pi.single k 1) =
      if (i, j, k) = (0, 1, 2) then 1 else if (i, j, k) = (1, 0, 2) then -1 else 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.doc: /-- The decomposition is unique: `S + A = S' + A'` with `S, S'` symmetric and `A, A'` antisymmetric forces `S = S'`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.statement:
theorem decomposition_unique {n : ℕ} (S A S' A' : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hS : Sᵀ = S) (hA : Aᵀ = -A)
    (hS' : S'ᵀ = S') (hA' : A'ᵀ = -A') (h : S + A = S' + A') : S = S'

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.finrank_.doc: /-- The span of `cos, sin` is two-dimensional. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.finrank_.statement: theorem finrank_span_cos_sin : finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![Real.cos, Real.sin])) = 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.statement: theorem coords_system (a b : ℚ) (h1 : 2 * a + b = 5) (h2 : a + 2 * b = 4) : a = 2 ∧ b = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.doc: /-- Its kernel, the plane `3x - y + 2z = 0`, has dimension `3 - 1 = 2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem finrank_ker_beta : finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker beta) = 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.lagrange.statement:
theorem lagrange_coords (c d : ℝ) :
    (3 * X + 2 : ℝ[X]) = 2 * (1 - X) + 5 * X ∧ (C c + C d * X : ℝ[X]) = C c * (1 - X) + C (c + d) * X

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.M.doc: /-- The components of a type `(r, s)` tensor in dimension `n`: `r` upper and `s` lower indices. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.ran.doc: /-- The matrix of the derivative has rank `2` (its rows `(0, 1, 0)`, `(0, 0, 2)` are independent). -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.r.doc: /-- `ℝⁿ` is a real vector space: the four scalar-multiplication rules of the definition. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.r.statement:
theorem rn_axioms (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (v w : Fin n → ℝ) :
    a • (v + w) = a • v + a • w ∧ (a + b) • v = a • v + b • v ∧ (a * b) • v = a • b • v ∧ (1 : ℝ) • v = v

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.d.doc: /-- The Kronecker delta, the type `(1, 1)` identity map: `δ^i_j v^j = v^i`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.d.statement: theorem delta_identity {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℝ) : (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *ᵥ v = v

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.mink.doc: /-- Timelike, spacelike and null examples: `η(w, w) = 1`, `η(e₁, e₁) = -1`, `η(v, v) = 0` for `v = (1, 1, 0, 0)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.B_ei.statement:
theorem B_eigen_plus :
    !![(2 : ℝ), 1, 0; 1, 2, 1; 0, 1, 2] * !![(1 : ℝ); Real.sqrt 2; 1] =
      (2 + Real.sqrt 2) • !![(1 : ℝ); Real.sqrt 2; 1]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.doc: /-- The identity is `e₁ ⊗ e₁ + e₂ ⊗ e₂ + e₃ ⊗ e₃`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..doc: /-- The components: `B(v, w) = v¹ w¹ + 2 v¹ w² - v² w¹` is the form of `(1, 2; -1, 0)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..statement:
theorem bilinear_matrix_formula (v1 v2 w1 w2 : ℝ) :
    !![v1, v2] * !![(1 : ℝ), 2; -1, 0] * !![w1; w2] = !![v1 * w1 + 2 * v1 * w2 - v2 * w1]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.ke.doc: /-- A vanishing `a (1, 1, -1) + b (3, 0, -1)` has `a = b = 0` (second component `a = 0`, first `a + 3b = 0`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.ke.statement: theorem kernel_pair_coefficients (a b : ℚ) (h1 : a + 3 * b = 0) (h2 : a = 0) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.doc: /-- Every functional on `ℝⁿ` is `v ↦ a_i v^i` with `a_i = α(e_i)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement:
theorem functional_is_row {n : ℕ} (α : Module.Dual ℝ (Fin n → ℝ)) (v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    α v = ∑ i, v i * α (fun j => if i = j then 1 else 0)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..doc: /-- The dot product is the bilinear form with the identity matrix. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..statement: theorem dot_product_form {n : ℕ} (v w : Fin n → ℝ) : Matrix.toBilin' (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) v w = v ⬝ᵥ w

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualSpace.doub.statement:
theorem doubleDual_apply {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] (v : V)
    (α : Module.Dual K V) : doubleDual K V v α = α v

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- `(u · v)(v · w)` is quadratic in `v`: replacing `v` by `2v` multiplies it by `4`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement:
theorem quadratic_in_v {n : ℕ} (u v w : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (u ⬝ᵥ ((2 : ℝ) • v)) * (((2 : ℝ) • v) ⬝ᵥ w) = 4 * ((u ⬝ᵥ v) * (v ⬝ᵥ w))

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.du.doc: /-- The dual basis of a basis of `ℚⁿ` is the list of rows of `B⁻¹`: `B⁻¹ B = 1` for invertible `B`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.du.statement: theorem dual_basis_rows {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ) (h : B.det ≠ 0) : B⁻¹ * B = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- The algebraic core of the converse: `B(v + w, v + w) = 0`, `B(v, v) = B(w, w) = 0` force `B(v, w) = -B(w, v)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement:
theorem antisym_core (bvv bvw bwv bww s : ℝ) (hs : s = bvv + bvw + bwv + bww) (h0 : s = 0) (h1 : bvv = 0)
    (h2 : bww = 0) : bvw = -bwv

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.ke.statement: theorem kernel_pair_independent : LinearIndependent ℚ ![(![1, 1, -1] : Fin 3 → ℚ), ![3, 0, -1]]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualSpace.alph.doc: /-- `α = 2 e¹ + e²`: the coordinate functionals span the rows. -/

KaluzaKlein.Linear.A_rows_proportional.doc: /-- The two rows of `A` are proportional: the second is twice the first. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.doc: /-- Integration over `[0, 2π]` is linear on continuous functions. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement:
theorem integration_linear (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
    ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (f φ + c * g φ) =
      (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f φ) + c * ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g φ

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndepend.statement:
theorem family_G_dependent : ¬ LinearIndependent ℚ
    ![(![1, 0, 1, 0] : Fin 4 → ℚ), ![0, 1, 0, 1], ![1, 1, 0, 0], ![0, 0, 1, 1]]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.g.statement: theorem gauss_sum_succ (n : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((k : ℚ) + 1) = (n : ℚ) * ((n : ℚ) + 1) / 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.statement:
theorem elementary_sum_left {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → ℝ) (v z : Fin n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec u v + Matrix.vecMulVec (c • u) z = Matrix.vecMulVec u (v + c • z)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.doc: /-- The trace is `9` in both bases. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Components.tra.doc: /-- The trace of a type `(1, 1)` tensor is basis independent. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Components.tra.statement: theorem trace_mixed {n : ℕ} (A T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (h : IsUnit A.det) : (A⁻¹ * T * A).trace = T.trace

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Signature.S_nu.doc: /-- The form vanishes identically along the null direction `(-2, 1)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.doc: /-- The level set `β = c` is the kernel translated: `β(p + w) = c` for `β(p) = c`, `w` in the kernel. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement:
theorem beta_level_set (p w : Fin 3 → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hp : beta p = c) (hw : w ∈ LinearMap.ker beta) :
    beta (p + w) = c

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorResults..statement: theorem finrank_tensor_R : finrank ℝ ((Fin 3 → ℝ) ⊗[ℝ] ℝ) = 3

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.d.doc: /-- The polynomials of degree at most `2` are closed under addition and scaling (a `Submodule`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.d.statement:
theorem deg_le_two_closed (p q : Polynomial ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hp : p ∈ Polynomial.degreeLT ℝ 3)
    (hq : q ∈ Polynomial.degreeLT ℝ 3) : p + q ∈ Polynomial.degreeLT ℝ 3 ∧ t • p ∈ Polynomial.degreeLT ℝ 3

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- An alternating map vanishes when two arguments coincide. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement:
theorem alternating_repeated {ι V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℝ W]
    (f : V [⋀^ι]→ₗ[ℝ] W) (v : ι → V) (i j : ι) (h : v i = v j) (hij : i ≠ j) : f v = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- A matrix with two equal rows is singular. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement: theorem det_repeated_rows (a b c g h i : ℝ) : Matrix.det !![a, b, c; a, b, c; g, h, i] = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.g.statement: theorem gauss_sum_id (n : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (k : ℚ) = (n : ℚ) * ((n : ℚ) - 1) / 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem integral_sin_circle : ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Real.sin φ = 0

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.doc: /-- If `F` is invertible and `F λ = v`, then `λ = F⁻¹ v`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.statement:
theorem coords_inverse {n : ℕ} (F : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ) (h : IsUnit F.det) (lam v : Fin n → ℚ)
    (hv : F *ᵥ lam = v) : lam = F⁻¹ *ᵥ v

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.mat.doc: /-- In coordinates `L(v)^i = L^i_j v^j`: the map of a matrix is matrix-vector multiplication. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.mat.statement:
theorem matrix_map_apply {m n : ℕ} (L : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin m) :
    Matrix.toLin' L v i = ∑ j, L i j * v j

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.statement:
theorem tmul_bilinear {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℝ W] (v v' : V) (w : W)
    (t : ℝ) : (v + t • v') ⊗ₜ[ℝ] w = v ⊗ₜ w + t • (v' ⊗ₜ w)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.doc: /-- The identity has rank three, so it is not elementary. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.statement: theorem identity_not_elementary : ¬ ∃ u v : Fin 3 → ℚ, Matrix.vecMulVec u v = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.f.statement: theorem finrank_antisym (n : ℕ) : finrank ℝ (antisymMatrices n) = n * (n - 1) / 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.doc: /-- Contracting `a = (1, 0, -1)` with the first slot of `u ⊗ v` gives `a(u) v = (-2, 0, 2)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.four.doc: /-- The modes `1, cos φ, …, cos Nφ, sin φ, …, sin Nφ` are independent, for every `N`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.four.statement:
theorem fourierModes_truncation_linearIndependent (N : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (fourierModes ∘ Sum.map (fun k : Fin (N + 1) => (k : ℕ)) (fun k : Fin N => (k : ℕ)))

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.c.doc:
/-- In four dimensions: the Riemann tensor (type `(1, 3)`) has `256` components, the Ricci tensor and the field
strength (type `(0, 2)`) `16`, the scalar curvature (type `(0, 0)`) one. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MixedTensors.c.statement:
theorem curvature_counts :
    finrank ℝ (MixedTensor 4 1 3) = 256 ∧ finrank ℝ (MixedTensor 4 0 2) = 16 ∧ finrank ℝ (MixedTensor 4 2 0) = 16 ∧
      finrank ℝ (MixedTensor 4 0 0) = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Contraction.pa.doc: /-- Pairing a covector with a vector is the contraction of `v ⊗ α`: `tr (v αᵀ) = α_i v^i`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Contraction.pa.statement: theorem pairing_is_contraction {n : ℕ} (v α : Fin n → ℝ) : (Matrix.vecMulVec v α).trace = α ⬝ᵥ v

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.span_thr.doc: /-- If `v₃ = a v₁ + b v₂`, every combination of the three is a combination of the first two. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Spans.span_thr.statement:
theorem span_three_reduce {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (v1 v2 v3 : V) (a b l1 l2 l3 : ℝ)
    (h : v3 = a • v1 + b • v2) :
    l1 • v1 + l2 • v2 + l3 • v3 = (l1 + a * l3) • v1 + (l2 + b * l3) • v2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.doc: /-- A metric (any matrix of components) is the sum `g_{ij} e^i ⊗ e^j` of elementary tensors of basis covectors. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.statement:
theorem metric_sum_elementary {n : ℕ} (g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, g i j • Matrix.vecMulVec (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) = g

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..doc: /-- The components are the values on basis vectors: `B(e_i, e_j) = B_{ij}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..statement:
theorem bilin_on_basis {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    Matrix.toBilin' B (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) = B i j

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.statement: theorem coords_f_other_2_exist : ∃ a b : ℚ, 2 * a + b = -1 ∧ a + 2 * b = 1

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.ran.doc: /-- Rank-nullity: `dim ker L + dim L(V) = dim V`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.ran.statement:
theorem rank_nullity {K V W : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (L : V →ₗ[K] W) :
    finrank K (LinearMap.ker L) + finrank K (LinearMap.range L) = finrank K V

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.doc: /-- The outer product `(1, 2, 3) ⊗ (1, 0, -1)` has rank exactly one. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.doc: /-- `V* ⊗ V ≅ End V` in finite dimension. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.TensorProducts.statement:
noncomputable def dualTensorEquiv (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] :
    Module.Dual ℝ V ⊗[ℝ] V ≃ₗ[ℝ] (V →ₗ[ℝ] V)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.s.doc: /-- The two counts add up to `n²` (the core: `a + b = n²` from `2a = n(n+1)`, `2b = n(n-1)`, over `ℚ`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.s.statement: theorem sym_antisym_count (a b n : ℚ) (ha : 2 * a = n * (n + 1)) (hb : 2 * b = n * (n - 1)) : a + b = n ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.doc: /-- The `i`-th coordinate is a linear functional on `ℝⁿ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement:
theorem coordinate_functional (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    LinearMap.proj (R

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.standard.doc: /-- The coordinates of `x` in the standard basis of `ℝⁿ` are its entries. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Bases.standard.statement: theorem standard_coords (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)).repr x i = x i

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- The determinant is alternating: swapping two rows changes its sign. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement:
theorem det_swap_rows (a b c d e f g h i : ℝ) :
    Matrix.det !![d, e, f; a, b, c; g, h, i] = -Matrix.det !![a, b, c; d, e, f; g, h, i]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.NondegenerateF.doc: /-- `v ↦ B(v, ·)`, in components `v ↦ B v`, is a linear isomorphism `V ≅ V*` when `det B ≠ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.NondegenerateF.statement:
theorem lowering_bijective {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (h : B.det ≠ 0) :
    Function.Bijective (Matrix.toLin' B)

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.cos_.doc:
/-- The powers `cos^k φ`, `k = 0, …, N`, are independent: a vanishing combination is a polynomial in `cos φ` with
infinitely many roots (all of `[-1, 1]`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.cos_.statement:
theorem cos_powers_linearIndependent (N : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (fun k : Fin (N + 1) => fun φ : ℝ => Real.cos φ ^ (k : ℕ))

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- A bilinear form vanishing on the diagonal is antisymmetric. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement:
theorem antisym_of_diag_zero {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ V)
    (h : ∀ v, B v v = 0) (v w : V) : B v w = -B w v

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MinkowskiResul.doc: /-- For a diagonal matrix with entries `±1`, the determinant is `(-1)^q`, `q` the number of `-1` entries. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MinkowskiResul.statement:
theorem det_signs {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Bool) :
    (Matrix.diagonal fun i => if s i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1).det = (-1) ^ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i = true).card

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.int.doc: /-- The integral over `[0, 1]` is additive on continuous functions. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.int.statement:
theorem integral_additive (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (f x + g x) = (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x) + ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, g x

KaluzaKlein.Linear.outer_product.doc: /-- The components of the elementary tensor `u ⊗ v` for `u = (1, 2, 3)`, `v = (1, 0, -1)` form the outer product. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.doc: /-- The determinant is linear in each row (here: the first row of a `3 × 3` matrix). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.MultilinearMap.statement:
theorem det_linear_first_row (a b c a' b' c' t d e f g h i : ℝ) :
    Matrix.det !![a + t * a', b + t * b', c + t * c'; d, e, f; g, h, i] =
      Matrix.det !![a, b, c; d, e, f; g, h, i] + t * Matrix.det !![a', b', c'; d, e, f; g, h, i]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.DualResults.du.doc: /-- The dual basis of `f` applied to `(1, 5)` and `(-1, 1)`: coordinates `(-1, 3)` and `(-1, 1)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.sym_.doc: /-- Every matrix is `½ (A + Aᵀ) + ½ (A - Aᵀ)`, a symmetric plus an antisymmetric matrix. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.sym_.statement:
theorem sym_antisym_decomposition {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    A = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (A + Aᵀ) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (A - Aᵀ) ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (A + Aᵀ) ∈ symMatrices n ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (A - Aᵀ) ∈ antisymMatrices n

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.doc: /-- The quadratic form of the determinant form vanishes identically. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricForms.statement: theorem det_form_quadratic_zero (x y : ℝ) : !![x, y] * !![(0 : ℝ), 1; -1, 0] * !![x; y] = !![(0 : ℝ)]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.statement:
theorem combination_solve_unique (l1 l2 l4 : ℚ) (h1 : l1 = 4) (h2 : 2 * l1 + l2 = 7) (h3 : l2 + l4 = 2) :
    l1 = 4 ∧ l2 = -1 ∧ l4 = 3

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.ran.doc: /-- The image of `A` is the line spanned by `(1, 2)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearCombinat.statement:
theorem so3_combination_antisymm (a b c : ℝ) :
