    (!![(0 : ℝ), -c, b; c, 0, -a; -b, a, 0])ᵀ = -!![(0 : ℝ), -c, b; c, 0, -a; -b, a, 0]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.ElementaryTens.statement: theorem diag_110_not_elementary : ¬ ∃ u v : Fin 3 → ℚ, Matrix.vecMulVec u v = Matrix.diagonal ![1, 1, 0]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.squ.statement: theorem square_not_linear : ¬ ∃ f : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ x, f x = x ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.z.doc: /-- The zero polynomial has no degree `n` (its degree is `⊥`). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaces.z.statement: theorem zero_degree_ne (n : ℕ) : (0 : Polynomial ℝ).degree ≠ n

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunction.statement: theorem beta_apply (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) : beta v = 3 * v 0 - v 1 + 2 * v 2

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..doc: /-- `B(v, w) = α(v) β(w)` has components `α_i β_j` (in two dimensions). -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForms..statement:
theorem product_of_functionals (v1 v2 w1 w2 a1 a2 b1 b2 : ℝ) :
    !![v1, v2] * !![a1 * b1, a1 * b2; a2 * b1, a2 * b2] * !![w1; w2] = !![(v1 * a1 + v2 * a2) * (b1 * w1 + b2 * w2)]

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.NondegenerateF.doc: /-- `(2, -1)` pairs to zero with `e₁` and `e₂` under `S`. -/

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Components.det.doc: /-- `det B' = (det A)² det B` for a type `(0, 2)` tensor. -/
KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.Components.det.statement: theorem det_two_lower {n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : (Aᵀ * B * A).det = A.det ^ 2 * B.det

KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpaceRes.statement: theorem coords_f_other_1_exist : ∃ a b : ℚ, 2 * a + b = 1 ∧ a + 2 * b = 5

KaluzaKlein.Linear.coordinates_f.statement: theorem coordinates_f : (2 : ℚ) • f1 + (1 : ℚ) • f2 = ![5, 4]

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.even.doc: /-- An even smooth function has vanishing odd derivatives at `0` (and an odd one vanishing even derivatives). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.even.statement:
theorem even_odd_derivatives (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((∀ x, f (-x) = f x) → iteratedDeriv (2 * k + 1) f 0 = 0) ∧
      ((∀ x, f (-x) = -f x) → iteratedDeriv (2 * k) f 0 = 0)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.rpow_.statement: theorem rpow_inv_limit (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => a ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹)) atTop (𝓝 1)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: theorem feynman_derivative (a : ℝ) (ha : -1 < a) : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ a = 1 / (a + 1)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.inte.doc:
/-- The intermediate value theorem: a continuous function on `[a, b]` takes every value between `f(a)` and
`f(b)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.inte.statement:
theorem intermediate_value (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b y : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hy : y ∈ Icc (f a) (f b)) : ∃ c ∈ Icc a b, f c = y

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.square.doc: /-- `F(x, y) = F(-x, -y)`: the map is two-to-one. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.square.statement:
theorem square_map_two_to_one (x y : ℝ) :
    ((-x) ^ 2 - (-y) ^ 2, 2 * (-x) * (-y)) = (x ^ 2 - y ^ 2, 2 * x * y)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.newto.doc: /-- The error of one Newton step squares: `(a + c/a)/2 - √c = (a - √c)²/(2a)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.newto.statement:
theorem newton_step_error (a c s : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hs : s ^ 2 = c) :
    (a + c / a) / 2 - s = (a - s) ^ 2 / (2 * a)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.spheri.doc: /-- At the poles (`θ = 0`) the spherical map does not depend on `φ`: it is not injective there. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.spheri.statement:
theorem spherical_pole (r φ : ℝ) :
    (r * Real.sin 0 * Real.cos φ, r * Real.sin 0 * Real.sin φ, r * Real.cos 0) = (0, 0, r)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.exp_.statement: theorem exp_gt_one_add (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) : 1 + x < Real.exp x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.doc:
/-- `∫₀ᵃ x √(a² - x²) dx = a³/3` by the substitution `u = a² - x²` (at `a = 1`: `∫₀¹ x √(1 - x²) dx = 1/3`). The
integrand's antiderivative `-(a² - x²)^(3/2)/3` is not differentiable at `x = a`, so the claim is proved by the
substitution rule and tested at instances. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.statement: theorem integral_x_sqrt (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..a, x * √(a ^ 2 - x ^ 2) = a ^ 3 / 3

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.doc: /-- The integral is linear, additive over intervals, and changes sign with the orientation. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.statement:
theorem integral_rules (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b c k : ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
    (∫ x in a..b, (f x + k * g x)) = (∫ x in a..b, f x) + k * ∫ x in a..b, g x ∧
      (∫ x in a..b, f x) + (∫ x in b..c, f x) = ∫ x in a..c, f x ∧
      (∫ x in a..b, f x) = -∫ x in b..a, f x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.elem.doc: /-- Polynomials, `exp`, `sin`, `cos` are continuous on `ℝ` and `log` on `(0, ∞)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.elem.statement:
theorem elementary_continuous (P : Polynomial ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun x => P.eval x) ∧ Continuous Real.exp ∧ Continuous Real.sin ∧ Continuous Real.cos ∧
      ContinuousOn Real.log (Ioi 0)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.mvt_.doc:
/-- For `e^x` on `[0, b]` the mean value point is `c = log((e^b - 1)/b) ∈ (0, b)`; at `b = 1`, `c = log(e - 1) ≈
0.541`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.mvt_.statement:
theorem mvt_exp (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Real.exp (Real.log ((Real.exp b - 1) / b)) = (Real.exp b - Real.exp 0) / (b - 0) ∧
      0 < Real.log ((Real.exp b - 1) / b) ∧ Real.log ((Real.exp b - 1) / b) < b

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.x_sq_s.doc:
/-- Both Riemann sums of `x²` tend to `1/3`: the lower sum is `1/3 - 1/(2n) + 1/(6n²)`, the upper
`1/3 + 1/(2n) + 1/(6n²)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.iter.statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_sq_exp (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun x => x ^ 2 * Real.exp x) x = (x ^ 2 + 2 * n * x + n * (n - 1)) * Real.exp x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.log_f.doc: /-- `∫₁ⁿ log x dx ≤ log n! ≤ ∫₁^(n+1) log x dx`, with `∫ log x dx = x log x - x`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.log_f.statement:
theorem log_factorial_bounds (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (n : ℝ) * Real.log n - n + 1 ≤ Real.log (n ! : ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (n ! : ℝ) ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - ((n : ℝ) + 1) + 1

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.log_.doc: /-- Powers beat logarithms: `log x / x^r → 0` as `x → ∞` for `r > 0` (`(log x)/x`). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.log_.statement: theorem log_div_rpow_limit (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : Tendsto (fun x => Real.log x / x ^ r) atTop (𝓝 0)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.antide.statement: theorem antideriv_log_sq (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : deriv (fun x => Real.log x ^ 2 / 2) x = Real.log x / x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.sin_n.doc: /-- No element of `{sin n : n ∈ ℕ}` equals `1`: `sin n = 1` would make `π` rational. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.harmo.doc: /-- `H_n - log n → γ` with `0 < H_n - log n - γ < 1/n`; at `n = 10⁴` the difference is within `10⁻⁴` of `γ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.harmo.statement:
theorem harmonic_error (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    0 < (harmonic n : ℝ) - Real.log n - Real.eulerMascheroniConstant ∧
      (harmonic n : ℝ) - Real.log n - Real.eulerMascheroniConstant < 1 / n

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- The iteration behind the simplex volume `1/n!`: `∫₀¹ (1 - x)^k/k! dx = 1/(k+1)!`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: theorem simplex_step (k : ℕ) : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - x) ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) = 1 / ((k + 1)! : ℝ)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.spheri.doc:
/-- The first row of the inverse spherical Jacobian is `(sin θ cos φ, sin θ sin φ, cos θ) = ∇r`: it times `J` is
`(1, 0, 0)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.abs_conv.statement: theorem abs_conv_conv (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h : Summable (fun k => |a k|)) : Summable a

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geometri.statement: theorem geometric_diverges (r : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ |r|) : ¬ Summable (fun k : ℕ => r ^ k)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.inv_.doc: /-- `1/x` is unbounded near `0`: for every `M` some `x ∈ (0, 1]` has `1/x > M`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.inv_.statement: theorem inv_unbounded (M : ℝ) : ∃ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, M < 1 / x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.exp_rema.doc:
/-- The remainder of the exponential series at `x = 1`: `1/(m+1)! ≤ e - ∑_{k ≤ m} 1/k! ≤ (m+2)/((m+1)!(m+1)) < 1/m!`
(checked at `m = 3, 6, 9`; at `m = 12` the gap is `1.7 · 10⁻¹⁰`). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.exp_rema.statement:
theorem exp_remainder (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    1 / ((m + 1)! : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 - expPartial m ∧
      Real.exp 1 - expPartial m ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 2) / (((m + 1)! : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) + 1)) ∧
      ((m : ℝ) + 2) / (((m + 1)! : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) + 1)) < 1 / (m ! : ℝ)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.antide.doc: /-- `(x log x - x)' = log x` for `x > 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.antide.statement: theorem antideriv_log_x (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : deriv (fun x => x * Real.log x - x) x = Real.log x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.chain_.doc: /-- Along the circle: `d/dt f(cos t, sin t) = -2 cos t sin² t + (cos² t + cos(sin t)) cos t`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.chain_.statement:
theorem chain_circle (t : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => Real.cos t ^ 2 * Real.sin t + Real.sin (Real.sin t)) t =
      -2 * Real.cos t * Real.sin t ^ 2 + (Real.cos t ^ 2 + Real.cos (Real.sin t)) * Real.cos t

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.doc: /-- The Taylor polynomial `T₇(x) = x - x³/6 + x⁵/120 - x⁷/5040` of `sin` at `0` has remainder at most `|x|⁹/9!`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.statement:
theorem sin_taylor7 (x : ℝ) :
    |Real.sin x - (x - x ^ 3 / 6 + x ^ 5 / 120 - x ^ 7 / 5040)| ≤ |x| ^ 9 / 9 !

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.exp_f.doc: /-- `E(x) = ∑ xᵏ/k!` converges absolutely for every `x`, satisfies `E(x + y) = E(x) E(y)` and `E' = E`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.exp_f.statement:
theorem exp_from_series (x y : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => |x ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)|) ∧
      (∑' k : ℕ, (x + y) ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)) = (∑' k : ℕ, x ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)) * (∑' k : ℕ, y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)) ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun z => ∑' k : ℕ, z ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)) (∑' k : ℕ, x ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)) x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.inv_one_.statement:
theorem inv_one_add_div_pow_limit (x : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (1 + x / n) ^ n) atTop (𝓝 (Real.exp (-x)))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.statement: theorem integral_x_sq : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ 2 = 1 / 3

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc:
/-- The moving bump `f_n = n` on `(0, 1/n)`: `f_n(x) → 0` for every `x`, but `∫₀¹ f_n = 1` for all `n ≥ 1` and
`sup f_n = n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem moving_bump (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (x : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => if 0 < x ∧ x < 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) then ((m : ℝ) + 1) else 0) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, (if 0 < y ∧ y < 1 / (n : ℝ) then (n : ℝ) else 0) = 1

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.radius_r.doc:
/-- The ratio formula for the radius: if `|c_k / c_(k+1)| → R > 0`, then `∑ c_k x^k` converges absolutely for
`|x| < R` and diverges for `|x| > R`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.radius_r.statement:
theorem radius_ratio (c : ℕ → ℝ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hc : ∀ k, c k ≠ 0)
    (h : Tendsto (fun k => |c k / c (k + 1)|) atTop (𝓝 R)) (x : ℝ) :
    (|x| < R → Summable (fun k => |c k * x ^ k|)) ∧ (R < |x| → ¬ Summable (fun k => c k * x ^ k))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.inve.doc: /-- The inverse function rule: `(f⁻¹)'(y) = 1/f'(x)` at `y = f(x)` when `f'(x) ≠ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.inve.statement:
theorem inverse_rule (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (x f' : ℝ) (hg : ContinuousAt g (f x)) (hf : HasDerivAt f f' x)
    (hf' : f' ≠ 0) (hgf : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (f x), f (g y) = y) (hgx : g (f x) = x) :
    HasDerivAt g (1 / f') (f x)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.statement: theorem integral_cauchy (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) : ∫ x : ℝ, 1 / (c ^ 2 + x ^ 2) = π / c

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.factoria.doc: /-- The ratio of consecutive terms of `n!/n^n` is `(n/(n + 1))^n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.factoria.statement:
theorem factorial_power_ratio (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (((n + 1)! : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1)) / ((n ! : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ n) = ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ n

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.statement: theorem integral_x : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x = 1 / 2
theorem integral_x_exp : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x * Real.exp x = 1

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.doc: /-- `sin(1/x)` has no limit at `0`: for every `L`, `sin(1/x) ↛ L`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.statement: theorem sin_inv_no_limit (L : ℝ) : ¬ Tendsto (fun x => Real.sin (1 / x)) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 L)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.doc: /-- `∫₋ₐᵃ dx/(1 + x²) = 2 arctan a`; at `a = 1` it is `π/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.statement: theorem integral_arctan (a : ℝ) : ∫ x in (-a)..a, 1 / (1 + x ^ 2) = 2 * Real.arctan a

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.euler.doc: /-- The binomial expansion `(1 + 1/n)^n = ∑_{k ≤ n} (1/k!) ∏_{j < k} (1 - j/n)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.euler.statement:
theorem euler_binomial (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (1 + 1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), eulerTerm n k

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.half_par.statement: theorem half_partial (N : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n = 1 - (1 / 2) ^ N

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.ratio_te.doc: /-- The ratio test, convergent case: `|a_(k+1)/a_k| → L < 1` gives absolute convergence. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.ratio_te.statement:
theorem ratio_test (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hL : L < 1) (h0 : ∀ k, a k ≠ 0)
    (h : Tendsto (fun k => |a (k + 1)| / |a k|) atTop (𝓝 L)) : Summable (fun k => |a k|)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.limi.doc: /-- The `ε`-`δ` definition of `lim_{x → a} f(x) = L` is mathlib's `Tendsto f (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 L)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.limi.statement:
theorem limit_eps_delta (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a L : ℝ) :
    Tendsto f (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 L) ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x, 0 < |x - a| → |x - a| < δ → |f x - L| < ε

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.third_.doc:
/-- The third-order expansion of `x² y + sin y` at the origin: `y + x² y - y³/6`, with error at most `|y|⁴ · 5/96`
for `|y| ≤ 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.third_.statement:
theorem third_order_f (x y : ℝ) (hy : |y| ≤ 1) :
    |x ^ 2 * y + Real.sin y - (y + x ^ 2 * y - y ^ 3 / 6)| ≤ |y| ^ 4 * (5 / 96)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.prod.statement:
theorem product_rule (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a f' g' : ℝ) (hf : HasDerivAt f f' a) (hg : HasDerivAt g g' a) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => f x * g x) (f' * g a + f a * g') a

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.exp_in.statement: theorem exp_integral (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-(a * x)) = 1 / a

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geometri.doc: /-- Differentiating the geometric series term by term: `∑ (k + 1) x^k = 1/(1 - x)²` for `|x| < 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geometri.statement:
theorem geometric_derivative (x : ℝ) (hx : |x| < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => ((k : ℝ) + 1) * x ^ k) (1 / (1 - x) ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.CauchyHa.doc:
/-- Cauchy-Hadamard (stated, tested at the standard series, not proved here): the radius is
`1/limsup |c_k|^(1/k)`; for coefficients whose `k`-th roots converge to `ρ > 0`, the series converges absolutely for
`|x| < 1/ρ` and diverges for `|x| > 1/ρ`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.log_f.doc: /-- Hence `log n! = n log n - n + O(log n)`: `|log n! - (n log n - n)| ≤ log(n + 1) + 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.log_f.statement:
theorem log_factorial_asymptotic (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    |Real.log (n ! : ℝ) - ((n : ℝ) * Real.log n - n)| ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) + 1

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.exp_rati.doc: /-- The ratio of consecutive terms of `∑ x^k/k!` is `|x|/(k + 1)`, which tends to `0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.exp_rati.statement:
theorem exp_ratio (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    |x ^ (k + 1) / ((k + 1)! : ℝ)| / |x ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)| = |x| / ((k : ℝ) + 1)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.limit.doc: /-- The product rule: `a_n b_n → L M`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.limit.statement:
theorem limit_mul (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (L M : ℝ) (ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 L)) (hb : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 M)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => a n * b n) atTop (𝓝 (L * M))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.mvt_.doc: /-- For `sin` on `[0, kπ]` the average slope is `0` and `c = π/2` has `cos c = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.mvt_.statement:
theorem mvt_sin (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    Real.cos (π / 2) = (Real.sin (k * π) - Real.sin 0) / (k * π - 0) ∧ π / 2 ∈ Ioo 0 ((k : ℝ) * π)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.deri.statement: theorem deriv_log_rule (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : deriv (fun x => Real.log x) x = 1 / x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.chai.statement: theorem chain_sin_sq (t : ℝ) : deriv (fun t => Real.sin (t ^ 2)) t = Real.cos (t ^ 2) * (2 * t)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.harmonic.doc: /-- The partial sums of the harmonic series grow like `log n`: `log(n + 1) ≤ H_n ≤ 1 + log n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.harmonic.statement:
theorem harmonic_log_bounds (n : ℕ) :
    Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ harmonic n ∧ (harmonic n : ℝ) ≤ 1 + Real.log n

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.statement: theorem integral_sin_pi : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, Real.sin x = 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: theorem half_gaussian (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) : ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-b * x ^ 2) = √(π / b) / 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.limit.doc: /-- The quotient rule: `a_n / b_n → L / M` when `M ≠ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.limit.statement:
theorem limit_div (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (L M : ℝ) (ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 L)) (hb : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 M))
    (hM : M ≠ 0) : Tendsto (fun n => a n / b n) atTop (𝓝 (L / M))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.p_inte.statement:
theorem p_integral_finite (p b : ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 1) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∫ x in (1 : ℝ)..b, x ^ (-p) = (b ^ (1 - p) - 1) / (1 - p) ∧ ∫ x in (1 : ℝ)..b, x⁻¹ = Real.log b

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.cauch.doc: /-- The inner sum of the Cauchy product: `∑_{i+j=n} xⁱ/i! · yʲ/j! = (x + y)ⁿ/n!` (the binomial theorem). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.cauch.statement:
theorem cauchy_product_term (x y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), cauchyTerm x y n i = (x + y) ^ n / (n ! : ℝ)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.exp_s.doc: /-- The exponential series: `∑ x^k/k! = e^x`; at `x = 1` the sum is `e`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.exp_s.statement: theorem exp_series (x : ℝ) : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => x ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)) (Real.exp x)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.rearrang.doc: /-- The rearranged alternating harmonic series has the sum `½ log 2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.rearrang.statement:
theorem rearranged_limit :
    Tendsto (fun b : ℕ => ∑ j ∈ range b, (1 / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / (4 * (j : ℝ) + 2) - 1 / (4 * (j : ℝ) + 4)))
      atTop (𝓝 (Real.log 2 / 2))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- `|sin(nx)/n| ≤ 1/n` for all `x`, so `sin(nx)/n → 0` uniformly, and `∫₀^π sin(nx)/n dx = (1 - cos nπ)/n²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem sine_uniform (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (x : ℝ) :
    |Real.sin (n * x) / n| ≤ 1 / n ∧ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..π, Real.sin (n * x) / n = (1 - Real.cos (n * π)) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.newto.doc: /-- The fixed points of the recursion: `L = (L + 2/L)/2` exactly when `L² = 2`, so the positive limit is `√2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.newto.statement: theorem newton_fixed_point (L : ℝ) (hL : L ≠ 0) : L = (L + 2 / L) / 2 ↔ L ^ 2 = 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.inv_one_.doc: /-- `1/(1 + x²) = ∑ (-1)^k x^(2k)` for `|x| < 1`, and the series diverges for `|x| ≥ 1`: the radius is `1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.inv_one_.statement:
theorem inv_one_add_sq_series (x : ℝ) :
    (|x| < 1 → HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * x ^ (2 * k)) (1 / (1 + x ^ 2))) ∧
      (1 ≤ |x| → ¬ Summable (fun k : ℕ => (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * x ^ (2 * k)))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.sum_sq_m.statement:
theorem sum_sq_mul_geometric (x : ℝ) (hx : |x| < 1) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * x ^ n) (x * (1 + x) / (1 - x) ^ 3)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.cos_.statement:
theorem cos_sin_derivatives_zero (k : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv (2 * k) Real.cos 0 = (-1) ^ k ∧ iteratedDeriv (2 * k + 1) Real.cos 0 = 0 ∧
      iteratedDeriv (2 * k) Real.sin 0 = 0 ∧ iteratedDeriv (2 * k + 1) Real.sin 0 = (-1) ^ k

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.alt_b.doc: /-- The set `{(-1)^n + 1/n : n ≥ 1}`: every element lies in `(-1, 3/2]`, and `3/2` is attained at `n = 2`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.rotati.doc: /-- The Jacobian of `R_α ∘ F` is `J_F` at `φ + α`, and it equals `R_α J_F(r, φ)`; its determinant is still `r`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.rotati.statement:
theorem rotation_polar (r φ α : ℝ) :
    !![Real.cos α, -Real.sin α; Real.sin α, Real.cos α] * !![Real.cos φ, -r * Real.sin φ; Real.sin φ, r * Real.cos φ] =
      !![Real.cos (φ + α), -r * Real.sin (φ + α); Real.sin (φ + α), r * Real.cos (φ + α)]

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.comparis.doc: /-- The comparison test: `0 ≤ a_k ≤ b_k` and `∑ b_k` convergent imply `∑ a_k` convergent. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.comparis.statement:
theorem comparison_test (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ a k) (hab : ∀ k, a k ≤ b k) (hb : Summable b) :
    Summable a

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.telescop.doc: /-- `∑_{k=1}^n 1/(k(k+1)) = 1 - 1/(n + 1)`: with `k` from `0`, the terms are `telescopingTerm 1 k = 1/((k+1)(k+2))`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.telescop.statement:
theorem telescoping_partial (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range n, telescopingTerm 1 k = 1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.critic.doc:
/-- `g = x² + 4y² - 2x` has `∇g = (2x - 2, 8y)`, vanishing at `(1, 0)`, and `g - (-1) = (x - 1)² + 4y² ≥ 0`: a strict
minimum with `g(1, 0) = -1` and Hessian `diag(2, 8)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.critic.statement:
theorem critical_point_g (x y : ℝ) :
    x ^ 2 + 4 * y ^ 2 - 2 * x - (-1) = (x - 1) ^ 2 + 4 * y ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.log_.doc: /-- `(log(x + h) - log x)/h → 1/x` as `h → 0`, for `x > 0`: the derivative of `log` from the definition. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.log_.statement:
theorem log_slope_limit (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    Tendsto (fun h => (Real.log (x + h) - Real.log x) / h) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (1 / x))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.part.doc: /-- `∂ₓ(x² y + sin y) = 2xy`, a one-variable derivative in `x` with `y` fixed. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.part.statement: theorem partial_x_poly (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => x ^ 2 * y + Real.sin y) x = 2 * x * y

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.invers.doc: /-- The transition map `(u, v) ↦ (u, v)/(u² + v²)` between the stereographic charts is smooth away from the origin. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.invers.statement:
theorem inversion_smooth (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 / (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2), p.2 / (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2))) p

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.doc: /-- Along `x_n = 1/(2πn)` the values `sin(1/x_n)` are `0`, along `x'_n = 1/(2πn + π/2)` they are `1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.statement:
theorem sin_inv_sequences (n : ℕ) :
    Real.sin (1 / (1 / (2 * π * ((n : ℝ) + 1)))) = 0 ∧ Real.sin (1 / (1 / (2 * π * ((n : ℝ) + 1) + π / 2))) = 1

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.conve.doc: /-- A convergent sequence is Cauchy (in the `ε` form of the definition). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.conve.statement:
theorem convergent_cauchy (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (h : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 L)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m n : ℕ, N ≤ m → N ≤ n → |a m - a n| < ε

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.one_.doc: /-- `(1 - cos(cx))/x² → c²/2` as `x → 0`; at `c = 1` the limit is `1/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.one_.statement:
theorem one_sub_cos_div_limit (c : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun x => (1 - Real.cos (c * x)) / x ^ 2) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (c ^ 2 / 2))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.deri.statement:
theorem deriv_bound_lipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (h : ∀ x, |deriv f x| ≤ M)
    (x y : ℝ) : |f x - f y| ≤ M * |x - y|

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.glue.doc:
/-- Gluing `x²` (for `x < a`) to the line `2ax - a² + d` (for `x ≥ a`) is continuous at `a` exactly when `d = 0`;
at `a = 1`: `2x - 1` glues continuously, `2x` jumps. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.glue.statement:
theorem glue_continuous (a d : ℝ) :
    ContinuousAt (fun x => if x < a then x ^ 2 else 2 * a * x - a ^ 2 + d) a ↔ d = 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.log_in.statement: theorem log_integral (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : Real.log x = ∫ t in (1 : ℝ)..x, 1 / t

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.gaussi.doc: /-- The Gaussian integral `∫_ℝ e^(-b x²) dx = √(π/b)`; at `b = 1` it is `√π`, at `b = 1/2` it is `√(2π)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.gaussi.statement: theorem gaussian (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) : ∫ x : ℝ, Real.exp (-b * x ^ 2) = √(π / b)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sign.doc: /-- `|x - a|/(x - a)` has the one-sided limits `1` and `-1` at `a`, and no limit there. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sign.statement:
theorem sign_one_sided (a : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun x => |x - a| / (x - a)) (𝓝[>] a) (𝓝 1) ∧ Tendsto (fun x => |x - a| / (x - a)) (𝓝[<] a) (𝓝 (-1)) ∧
      ¬ ∃ L, Tendsto (fun x => |x - a| / (x - a)) (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 L)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.Harmo.doc:
/-- The rate of convergence to `γ` (stated, tested numerically, not proved here): `H_n - log n - γ` lies between
`1/(2n + 1)` and `1/(2n)`, so `2n (H_n - log n - γ) → 1`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.isLUB.doc:
/-- The `ε`-characterisation of the supremum: `M = sup S` if and only if `M` is an upper bound and every
`M - ε` is exceeded by an element of `S`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.isLUB.statement:
theorem isLUB_iff_eps (S : Set ℝ) (M : ℝ) :
    IsLUB S M ↔ M ∈ upperBounds S ∧ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ s ∈ S, M - ε < s

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.square.doc: /-- The Jacobian of the local inverse at `(1, 1)` is `J⁻¹ = ¼ (1, 1; -1, 1)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.mvt_.doc:
/-- For `x³` on `[0, b]` the average slope is `b²` and the mean value point is `c = b/√3 ∈ (0, b)`; at `b = 2`:
slope `4`, `c = 2/√3 ≈ 1.155`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.extr.doc: /-- The extreme value theorem: a continuous function on `[a, b]` attains its maximum and minimum. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.extr.statement:
theorem extreme_value (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) :
    (∃ c ∈ Icc a b, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, f x ≤ f c) ∧ ∃ d ∈ Icc a b, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, f d ≤ f x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geom_neg.doc: /-- The partial sums for `r = -1` alternate between `1` and `0`: `∑_{k < n} (-1)^k = (1 - (-1)^n)/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geom_neg.statement: theorem geom_neg_one_partial (n : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ range n, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k = (1 - (-1) ^ n) / 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.stirl.doc:
/-- Stirling's formula with its constant: `r_n = n!/(√(2πn)(n/e)ⁿ)` satisfies `1 ≤ r_n`, decreases, and tends to
`1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.stirl.statement:
theorem stirling_ratio (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    1 ≤ (n ! : ℝ) / (√(2 * π * n) * (n / Real.exp 1) ^ n) ∧
      (((n + 1)! : ℝ) / (√(2 * π * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * (((n : ℝ) + 1) / Real.exp 1) ^ (n + 1))) ≤
        (n ! : ℝ) / (√(2 * π * n) * (n / Real.exp 1) ^ n)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.comparis.doc: /-- The comparison test for divergence: if `∑ a_k` diverges, so does `∑ b_k`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.comparis.statement:
theorem comparison_test_diverges (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ a k) (hab : ∀ k, a k ≤ b k)
    (ha : ¬ Summable a) : ¬ Summable b

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.partia.statement: theorem partial_x_f (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => x ^ 2 * y + Real.sin y) x = 2 * x * y

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.ellipt.doc: /-- Elliptic polar coordinates `(ar cos t, br sin t)` have `det J = abr`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.ellipt.statement:
theorem elliptic_det (a b r t : ℝ) :
    Matrix.det !![a * Real.cos t, -a * r * Real.sin t; b * Real.sin t, b * r * Real.cos t] = a * b * r

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.sqrt_ene.doc: /-- The non-relativistic limit: `√(m² + p²) ≤ m + p²/(2m)`, with equality to second order. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.rat_f.doc: /-- `(2n + 1)/(n + 3) → 2` from the definition: `|a_n - 2| = 5/(n + 3) < ε` as soon as `n > 5/ε - 3`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.smooth.doc: /-- Sums, products and compositions of smooth maps are smooth. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.smooth.statement:
theorem smooth_rules (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => f x + g x) ∧ ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => f x * g x) ∧ ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (g ∘ f)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.tayl.doc: /-- Taylor's theorem with the Lagrange remainder. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.tayl.statement:
theorem taylor_lagrange (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hx : x₀ ≠ x) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ (n + 1) f (uIcc x₀ x)) :
    ∃ c ∈ uIoo x₀ x, f x - taylorWithinEval f n (uIcc x₀ x) x₀ x =
      iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f c * (x - x₀) ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1)!

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geometri.doc: /-- Integrating the geometric series term by term: `∑ x^(k+1)/(k + 1) = -log(1 - x)` for `|x| < 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geometri.statement:
theorem geometric_integral (x : ℝ) (hx : |x| < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => x ^ (k + 1) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) (-Real.log (1 - x))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.statement: theorem sin_div_limit (c : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun x => Real.sin (c * x) / x) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 c)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.gradie.doc:
/-- The level curve `f = 8` is `c(t) = (2√2 cos t, √2 sin t)`, and `∇f(c(t)) · ċ(t) = 0`: the gradient is
orthogonal to the level set. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.gradie.statement:
theorem gradient_orthogonal (t : ℝ) :
    (2 * √2 * Real.cos t) ^ 2 + 4 * (√2 * Real.sin t) ^ 2 = 8 ∧
      2 * (2 * √2 * Real.cos t) * (-(2 * √2) * Real.sin t) + 8 * (√2 * Real.sin t) * (√2 * Real.cos t) = 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.sphere.doc:
/-- The surface area `n π^(n/2)/Γ(n/2 + 1)` of the unit sphere of `ℝⁿ` (`n` times the volume of the unit ball)
equals `2π^(n/2)/Γ(n/2)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.sphere.statement:
theorem sphere_area (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (n : ℝ) * π ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) / Real.Gamma ((n : ℝ) / 2 + 1) = 2 * π ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) / Real.Gamma ((n : ℝ) / 2)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.deri.statement: theorem deriv_zero_const (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (h : ∀ x, deriv f x = 0) (x y : ℝ) : f x = f y

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.sInf_.doc: /-- `inf (a, ∞) = a`, and `(a, ∞)` is unbounded above, so it has no supremum. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.sInf_.statement:
theorem sInf_Ioi_unbounded (a : ℝ) :
    IsGLB (Set.Ioi a) a ∧ sInf (Set.Ioi a) = a ∧ ¬ BddAbove (Set.Ioi a)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.flat.statement: theorem flat_eq (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) : flat x = Real.exp (-1 / x ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.doc: /-- `sin(cx)/x`, given the value `c` at `0`, is continuous on `ℝ`: the discontinuity is removable. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.statement: theorem sin_div_removable (c : ℝ) : Continuous (fun x => if x = 0 then c else Real.sin (c * x) / x)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.jump_i.doc: /-- A bounded function continuous except at one point `c` is integrable. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.jump_i.statement:
theorem jump_integrable (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b c M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M) (hf : ContinuousOn f ({c}ᶜ)) :
    IntervalIntegrable f volume a b

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.doc: /-- `∫₀^a cos x/(1 + sin² x) dx = arctan(sin a)`; at `a = π/2` it is `arctan 1 = π/4`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.statement:
theorem integral_cos_div (a : ℝ) :
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..a, Real.cos x / (1 + Real.sin x ^ 2) = Real.arctan (Real.sin a)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.n_sin.statement: theorem n_sin_div_limit (x : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * Real.sin (x / n)) atTop (𝓝 x)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.doc: /-- `|sin x - sin y| ≤ |x - y|` and `|e^x - e^y| ≤ e^max(x,y) |x - y|`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.statement:
theorem sin_exp_lipschitz (x y : ℝ) :
    |Real.sin x - Real.sin y| ≤ |x - y| ∧ |Real.exp x - Real.exp y| ≤ Real.exp (max x y) * |x - y|

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.sin_po.doc: /-- The reduction formula `I_n = (n-1)/n I_(n-2)` for `I_n = ∫₀^(π/2) sinⁿ x dx`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.sin_po.statement:
theorem sin_pow_reduction (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sin x ^ (n + 2) = ((n : ℝ) + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 2) * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sin x ^ n

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.mixed_.doc: /-- The mixed partials agree: `∂_y(2xy) = 2x = ∂ₓ(x² + cos y)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.mixed_.statement:
theorem mixed_partials_f (x y : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun y => 2 * x * y) y = 2 * x ∧ deriv (fun x => x ^ 2 + Real.cos y) x = 2 * x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.log_seri.doc: /-- `∑ x^k/k` converges exactly on `[-1, 1)` (its partial sums converge; at `-1` conditionally). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.log_seri.statement:
theorem log_series_set (x : ℝ) :
    (∃ L, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ range n, x ^ (k + 1) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 L)) ↔ -1 ≤ x ∧ x < 1

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.rearrang.doc: /-- The sum of an absolutely convergent series does not depend on the order of its terms. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.rearrang.statement:
theorem rearrangement_invariant (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h : Summable (fun k => |a k|)) (e : ℕ ≃ ℕ) :
    ∑' n, a (e n) = ∑' n, a n

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.poly_.doc:
/-- The leading terms decide: for polynomials of equal degree, `P(n)/Q(n)` tends to the ratio of the leading
coefficients (`(2n + 1)/(n + 3) → 2`, `(3n² + 1)/(n² - 5) → 3`). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.poly_.statement:
theorem poly_ratio_limit (P Q : Polynomial ℝ) (h : P.degree = Q.degree) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => P.eval (n : ℝ) / Q.eval (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 (P.leadingCoeff / Q.leadingCoeff))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.harmo.doc: /-- `H_n - log n` is decreasing and positive (bounded below by `γ > 0`). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.harmo.statement:
theorem harmonic_sub_log_decreasing (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (harmonic (n + 1) : ℝ) - Real.log ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < (harmonic n : ℝ) - Real.log n ∧
      0 < (harmonic n : ℝ) - Real.log n

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.gaussi.doc: /-- The odd moments vanish: `∫_ℝ x^(2n+1) e^(-a x²) dx = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.gaussi.statement: theorem gaussian_odd_moment (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) : ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ (2 * n + 1) * Real.exp (-a * x ^ 2) = 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.euler.statement: theorem euler_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (1 + 1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ n < 3

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.roll.doc: /-- Rolle's theorem: equal endpoint values give a critical point. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.roll.statement:
theorem rolle (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hd : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) (he : f a = f b) : ∃ c ∈ Ioo a b, f' c = 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.isGre.doc: /-- A finite set `{a, b, c}` with largest element `b` has supremum `b`, attained (a maximum). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.isGre.statement:
theorem isGreatest_three (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hcb : c ≤ b) :
    IsGreatest {a, b, c} b ∧ sSup {a, b, c} = b

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.step_i.doc: /-- A step function is integrable on every interval. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.step_i.statement: theorem step_integrable (a b c u v : ℝ) : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => if x < c then u else v) volume a b

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.factor.statement:
theorem factorial_integral (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), x ^ n * Real.exp (-(a * x)) = n ! / a ^ (n + 1)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geometri.doc: /-- `1/(1 + x) = ∑ (-1)^k x^k` for `|x| < 1`, the geometric series in `-x`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geometri.statement: theorem geometric_neg (x : ℝ) (hx : |x| < 1) : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * x ^ k) (1 / (1 + x))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.abs_tsum.doc: /-- The triangle inequality for an absolutely convergent series: `|∑ a_k| ≤ ∑ |a_k|`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.abs_tsum.statement: theorem abs_tsum_le (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h : Summable (fun k => |a k|)) : |∑' k, a k| ≤ ∑' k, |a k|

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.antit.doc: /-- A decreasing sequence bounded below converges to the infimum of its values. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.antit.statement:
theorem antitone_convergence (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h : Antitone a) (hb : BddBelow (range a)) :
    Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 (⨅ n, a n))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.half_d.doc: /-- `∫₋ᵣʳ √(R² - x²) dx = πR²/2`; at `R = 1`, twice it is the area `π` of the unit disc. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.half_d.statement: theorem half_disc (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) : ∫ x in (-R)..R, √(R ^ 2 - x ^ 2) = π * R ^ 2 / 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.flat.statement:
theorem flat_smooth_positive (x : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) flat ∧ (x ≠ 0 → 0 < flat x) ∧ flat 0 = 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.limit.statement:
theorem limit_unique (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L L' : ℝ) (h : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 L)) (h' : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 L')) :
    L = L'

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.hessia.doc: /-- The Hessian of `x² y + sin y`: `∂ₓ(2xy) = 2y`, `∂_y(x² + cos y) = -sin y`; it is symmetric. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.hessia.statement:
theorem hessian_f (x y : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun x => 2 * x * y) x = 2 * y ∧ deriv (fun y => x ^ 2 + Real.cos y) y = -Real.sin y

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.rotati.doc: /-- The rotation and the shear have Jacobian determinant `1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.rotati.statement:
theorem rotation_shear_det (α k : ℝ) :
    Matrix.det !![Real.cos α, -Real.sin α; Real.sin α, Real.cos α] = 1 ∧ Matrix.det !![(1 : ℝ), k; 0, 1] = 1

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.Schwar.doc:
/-- Schwarz's theorem in partial-derivative form (stated, tested at the chapter's functions, not proved here): for
a `C²` function of two variables the mixed partial derivatives agree. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.leibni.doc: /-- `d/dx ∫₀ˣ (x - t) f(t) dt = ∫₀ˣ f`, so the integral solves `y'' = f`, `y(0) = y'(0) = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.leibni.statement:
theorem leibniz_kernel (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..x, (x - t) * f t) (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..x, f t) x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.invers.doc: /-- `det J_(F⁻¹)(F p) = 1/det J_F(p)`: from `J_(F⁻¹) J_F = 1`; for the inverse polar map, `det J = 1/r`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.invers.statement: theorem inverse_det (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (h : B * A = 1) : B.det = 1 / A.det

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.sin_cos_.doc: /-- The power series of `sin` and `cos`, convergent for every `x`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.sin_cos_.statement:
theorem sin_cos_series (x : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * x ^ (2 * k + 1) / ((2 * k + 1)! : ℝ)) (Real.sin x) ∧
      HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * x ^ (2 * k) / ((2 * k)! : ℝ)) (Real.cos x)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.sSup_.doc: /-- `sup [a, b) = b`, which is not an element of the set: a supremum need not be attained. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.sSup_.statement:
theorem sSup_Ico_not_mem (a b : ℝ) (h : a < b) :
    IsLUB (Set.Ico a b) b ∧ sSup (Set.Ico a b) = b ∧ b ∉ Set.Ico a b

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.alt_i.doc:
/-- The infimum `-1` of `{(-1)^n + 1/n}` is approached by the odd terms: for every `ε > 0` some odd `n` has
`(-1)^n + 1/n < -1 + ε`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.alt_i.statement: theorem alt_inf (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧ (-1 : ℝ) ^ n + 1 / n < -1 + ε

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.cauch.doc: /-- The Cauchy criterion in `ℝ`: a Cauchy sequence converges. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.cauch.statement:
theorem cauchy_converges (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m n : ℕ, N ≤ m → N ≤ n → |a m - a n| < ε) :
    ∃ L, Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 L)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.direct.doc: /-- The directional derivative of `x² y + sin y` at `(1, 0)` along `(3, 4)/5` is `8/5`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.direct.statement: theorem directional_f : deriv (fun t => (1 + 3 / 5 * t) ^ 2 * (4 / 5 * t) + Real.sin (4 / 5 * t)) 0 = 8 / 5

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.sin_ru.doc:
/-- For `sin` on `[0, π]` with `h = π/4`: trapezoidal rule `π(1 + √2)/4 = 1.896…`, Simpson's rule
`π(2√2 + 1)/6 = 2.0046…`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.sin_ru.statement:
theorem sin_rules :
    π / 4 / 2 * (Real.sin 0 + 2 * Real.sin (π / 4) + 2 * Real.sin (π / 2) + 2 * Real.sin (3 * π / 4) + Real.sin π) =
        π * (1 + √2) / 4 ∧
      π / 4 / 3 * (Real.sin 0 + 4 * Real.sin (π / 4) + 2 * Real.sin (π / 2) + 4 * Real.sin (3 * π / 4) + Real.sin π) =
        π * (2 * √2 + 1) / 6

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.weie.doc: /-- Weierstrass's function `W(x) = ∑ aⁿ cos(bⁿ π x)` (`0 < a < 1`) is continuous everywhere. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.weie.statement:
theorem weierstrass_continuous (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
    Continuous (fun x => ∑' n : ℕ, a ^ n * Real.cos (b ^ n * π * x))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc:
/-- The Dirichlet integral (stated, tested by Sage's exact value, not proved here): `F(a) = ∫₀^∞ e^(-ax) sin x/x dx =
π/2 - arctan a` for `a > 0`, and the improper integral `∫₀^∞ sin x/x dx = π/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: def DirichletIntegral : Prop

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- Uniform convergence on `[a, b]` allows the exchange `lim ∫ f_n = ∫ lim f_n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem uniform_limit_integral (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hf : ∀ n, Continuous (f n))
    (h : TendstoUniformlyOn f g atTop (Icc a b)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in a..b, f n x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in a..b, g x))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.Termwise.doc:
/-- Term-by-term differentiation of a power series inside its interval of convergence (stated, tested at the
geometric and exponential series, not proved here): if `∑ c_k r^k` converges absolutely for every `r < R`, then
`f(x) = ∑ c_k x^k` has derivative `∑ k c_k x^(k-1)` on `(-R, R)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem inv_iterated_deriv (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * iteratedDeriv n (fun a : ℝ => a⁻¹) a = n ! * a⁻¹ ^ (n + 1)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.sin_d.doc: /-- `sin(cn)/n → 0` by the squeeze `-1/n ≤ sin(cn)/n ≤ 1/n`; at `c = 1`, `sin n / n → 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.sin_d.statement: theorem sin_div_n_limit (c : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.sin (c * n) / n) atTop (𝓝 0)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.one_a.doc: /-- `(1 + x/n)^n → e^x`; at `x = 1` the limit is `e`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.one_a.statement: theorem one_add_div_pow_limit (x : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 + x / n) ^ n) atTop (𝓝 (Real.exp x))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.exp_.statement: theorem exp_sub_one_div_limit (c : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun x => (Real.exp (c * x) - 1) / x) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 c)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sat_.doc:
/-- `x/(1 + x)` on `[0, ∞)` is bounded by `1` and never attains it: every value is below `1` and values exceed
`1 - ε` for every `ε > 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sat_.statement:
theorem sat_not_attained (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x / (1 + x) < 1) ∧ ∃ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x ∧ 1 - ε < x / (1 + x)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.sqrt_tel.doc: /-- `∑ (√(k+1) - √k)` has partial sums `√(n+1) - 1 → ∞` and diverges, although its terms tend to `0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.sqrt_tel.statement:
theorem sqrt_telescoping :
    (∀ n : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ range n, sqrtStep k = √((n : ℝ) + 1) - 1) ∧
      ¬ Summable sqrtStep ∧ Tendsto sqrtStep atTop (𝓝 0)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.poly_.doc: /-- A numerator of lower degree gives the limit `0` (`n/(n² + 1) → 0`). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.poly_.statement:
theorem poly_ratio_limit_zero (P Q : Polynomial ℝ) (h : P.degree < Q.degree) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => P.eval (n : ℝ) / Q.eval (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.deri.statement: theorem deriv_sin_sq (x : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => Real.sin (x ^ 2)) x = 2 * x * Real.cos (x ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.sq_serie.statement: theorem sq_series_set (x : ℝ) : Summable (fun k : ℕ => x ^ (k + 1) / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) ↔ |x| ≤ 1

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.dirich.doc:
/-- The indicator function of the rationals has infimum `0` and supremum `1` on every subinterval, so all its lower
sums are `0` and all its upper sums are `1`: it is not Riemann integrable. Its Lebesgue integral is `0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.dirich.statement:
theorem dirichlet (c d : ℝ) (hcd : c < d) :
    sInf ((fun x : ℝ => if ∃ q : ℚ, (q : ℝ) = x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) '' Icc c d) = 0 ∧
      sSup ((fun x : ℝ => if ∃ q : ℚ, (q : ℝ) = x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) '' Icc c d) = 1 ∧
      ∫ x in c..d, (if ∃ q : ℚ, (q : ℝ) = x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.steepe.doc:
/-- Cauchy-Schwarz: the directional derivative `∇f · u` along a unit vector is at most `|∇f|`, with equality for
`u = ∇f/|∇f|`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.steepe.statement:
theorem steepest_direction (g₁ g₂ u₁ u₂ : ℝ) (hu : u₁ ^ 2 + u₂ ^ 2 = 1) :
    g₁ * u₁ + g₂ * u₂ ≤ √(g₁ ^ 2 + g₂ ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.odd_ro.doc:
/-- An inverse `g` of `x ↦ x^(2k+1)` (`k ≥ 1`; the real cube root `x^(1/3)` for `k = 1`) is not differentiable at `0`:
differentiating `g(x)^(2k+1) = x` at `0` would give `1 = (2k+1) g(0)^(2k) g'(0) = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.odd_ro.statement:
theorem odd_root_not_differentiable (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, g x ^ (2 * k + 1) = x) :
    ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ g 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.telescop.statement:
theorem telescoping_sum (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => 1 / (((k : ℝ) + a) * ((k : ℝ) + a + 1))) (1 / a)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.deri.statement: theorem deriv_sq_exp (x : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => x ^ 2 * Real.exp x) x = (x ^ 2 + 2 * x) * Real.exp x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem gamma_props (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x => Real.exp (-x) * x ^ (s - 1)) (Ioi 0) ∧ Real.Gamma (s + 1) = s * Real.Gamma s ∧
      Real.Gamma (n + 1) = n !

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.seco.doc: /-- The second-derivative test: `f'(a) = 0` and `f''(a) > 0` give a strict local minimum. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.seco.statement:
theorem second_derivative_test (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (h1 : deriv f a = 0)
    (h2 : 0 < deriv (deriv f) a) : IsLocalMin f a

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc:
/-- The cone `x² + y² ≤ z²`, `0 ≤ z ≤ h` (radius `R` at height `h`) has volume `πR²h/3`: slicing gives
`∫₀ʰ π (Rz/h)² dz`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: theorem cone_volume (R h : ℝ) (hh : h ≠ 0) : ∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..h, π * (R * z / h) ^ 2 = π * R ^ 2 * h / 3

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.basel_pa.doc: /-- The partial sums of `∑ 1/k²` are bounded by `2`: `∑_{k=1}^N 1/k² ≤ 2 - 1/N` (telescoping comparison). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.basel_pa.statement:
theorem basel_partial_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, baselTerm k ≤ 2 - 1 / (N : ℝ)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.antide.doc: /-- `(-log |cos x|)' = tan x = sin x / cos x` where `cos x ≠ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.antide.statement:
theorem antideriv_tan (x : ℝ) (hx : Real.cos x ≠ 0) :
    deriv (fun x => -Real.log (Real.cos x)) x = Real.sin x / Real.cos x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.exp_term.statement: theorem exp_terms_needed (m : ℕ) : (1 : ℝ) / (m ! : ℝ) < 1 / 10 ^ 10 ↔ 14 ≤ m

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geom_par.doc: /-- The partial sums of the geometric series: `∑_{k ≤ n} r^k = (1 - r^(n+1))/(1 - r)` for `r ≠ 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geom_par.statement:
theorem geom_partial (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), r ^ k = (1 - r ^ (n + 1)) / (1 - r)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.deri.statement: theorem deriv_pos_increasing (f : ℝ → ℝ) (h : ∀ x, 0 < deriv f x) : StrictMono f

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.euler.statement: theorem euler_term (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (1 + 1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ n = ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ n / (n : ℝ) ^ n

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.smooth.doc: /-- `log(x² + y²)` is smooth on `ℝ²` minus the origin, and `(x² - y², 2xy)` on all of `ℝ²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.smooth.statement:
theorem smooth_two_variables (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (p ≠ 0 → ContDiffAt ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.log (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)) p) ∧
      ContDiffAt ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 ^ 2 - p.2 ^ 2, 2 * p.1 * p.2)) p

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- The other order: `∫₀¹ ∫_y¹ e^(x+y) dx dy = e²/2 - e + 1/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem triangle_x_first :
    ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, (∫ x in y..1, Real.exp (x + y)) = Real.exp 1 ^ 2 / 2 - Real.exp 1 + 1 / 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.antide.statement: theorem antideriv_x_exp (x : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => (x - 1) * Real.exp x) x = x * Real.exp x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.neg_o.doc: /-- No element of `{sin n : n ∈ ℕ}` equals `-1`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc:
/-- Feynman's trick (stated, tested numerically, not proved here): `∫₀¹ (xᵃ - 1)/log x dx = log(1 + a)` for
`a > -1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: def FeynmanTrick : Prop

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.x_abs_.doc:
/-- `x|x|` is differentiable everywhere with derivative `2|x|`, which is not differentiable at `0`: `C¹` but not
smooth at `0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.x_abs_.statement:
theorem x_abs_x (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => x * |x|) (2 * |x|) x ∧ ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : ℝ => 2 * |x|) 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc:
/-- For `f = (x² - y²)/(x² + y²)²` on `(0, 1]²`: `∫₀¹ f dy = 1/(1 + x²)` for `x > 0`, so `∫₀¹ ∫₀¹ f dy dx = π/4`,
while `∫₀¹ ∫₀¹ f dx dy = -π/4`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.linear.doc:
/-- `∫₀¹ x dx = 1/2`; the lower and upper sums are `(n-1)/(2n)` and `(n+1)/(2n)`, and the midpoint sum is exactly
`1/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.linear.statement:
theorem linear_sums (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((k : ℝ) / n) * (1 / n) = ((n : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * n) ∧
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (((k : ℝ) + 1) / n) * (1 / n) = ((n : ℝ) + 1) / (2 * n) ∧
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / n) * (1 / n) = 1 / 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.polar_.doc:
/-- The partial derivatives of the polar map: `∂_r x = cos φ`, `∂_φ x = -r sin φ`, `∂_r y = sin φ`,
`∂_φ y = r cos φ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.polar_.statement:
theorem polar_partials (r φ : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun r => r * Real.cos φ) r = Real.cos φ ∧ deriv (fun φ => r * Real.cos φ) φ = -r * Real.sin φ ∧
      deriv (fun r => r * Real.sin φ) r = Real.sin φ ∧ deriv (fun φ => r * Real.sin φ) φ = r * Real.cos φ

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.gaussi.statement:
theorem gaussian_moment (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ (2 * n) * Real.exp (-a * x ^ 2) = (2 * n - 1 : ℕ)‼ / (2 * a) ^ n * √(π / a)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.smooth.doc:
/-- Polynomials, `exp`, `sin`, `cos` are smooth on `ℝ`; `√x` is smooth on `(0, ∞)`; `|x|` is not differentiable at
`0`, hence not smooth there. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.smooth.statement:
theorem smooth_elementary (P : Polynomial ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => P.eval x) ∧ ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Real.exp ∧ ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Real.sin ∧ ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Real.cos ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Real.sqrt (Ioi 0) ∧ ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : ℝ => |x|) 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- The derivatives `cos(nx)` do not converge at `x = (2k+1)π`, where they are `(-1)ⁿ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: theorem cos_derivatives_diverge (k : ℕ) : ¬ ∃ L, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.cos (n * ((2 * k + 1) * π))) atTop (𝓝 L)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.cube.doc:
/-- `x³ - y` changes sign on `[1, 2]` for `1 < y < 8`, so it has a root in `(1, 2)`; at `y = 2`: `f(1) = -1 < 0 <
f(2) = 6` and the root is `∛2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.cube.statement:
theorem cube_root_exists (y : ℝ) (hy1 : 1 < y) (hy8 : y < 8) :
    (1 : ℝ) ^ 3 - y < 0 ∧ 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ 3 - y ∧ ∃ c ∈ Ioo (1 : ℝ) 2, c ^ 3 = y

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.doc: /-- The mean value theorem for integrals: a continuous `f` on `[a, b]` attains its average. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.statement:
theorem integral_mean_value (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hf : Continuous f) :
    ∃ c ∈ Icc a b, ∫ x in a..b, f x = f c * (b - a)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.cube_b.doc:
/-- `x ↦ x³` is a smooth bijection of `ℝ` (strictly increasing and onto); its inverse is not differentiable at `0`
(see `cbrt_not_differentiable`); `tan` has derivative `1 + tan² x > 0` on `(-π/2, π/2)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.cube_b.statement:
theorem cube_bijection (y : ℝ) (x : ℝ) (hx : Real.cos x ≠ 0) :
    (∃! z : ℝ, z ^ 3 = y) ∧ deriv Real.tan x = 1 + Real.tan x ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.n_log.doc: /-- `n log(1 + x/n) → x`, the step Sage uses for `(1 + 1/n)^n = exp(n log(1 + 1/n)) → e`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.n_log.statement: theorem n_log_limit (x : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + x / n)) atTop (𝓝 x)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.spheri.doc: /-- The Jacobian determinant of spherical coordinates is `r² sin θ`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.poly.doc: /-- A non-zero polynomial of degree `n` has at most `n` real roots. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.poly.statement: theorem poly_roots_le (P : Polynomial ℝ) (hP : P ≠ 0) : P.roots.toFinset.card ≤ P.natDegree

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.antide.statement: theorem antideriv_log (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) : deriv (fun x => Real.log x) x = 1 / x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.xyRati.doc:
/-- Both partial derivatives of `xy/(x² + y²)` exist at the origin (they vanish: `f` is `0` on the axes), but
`f(x, x) = 1/2` for `x ≠ 0`, so `f` is not continuous at the origin. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.xyRati.statement:
theorem xyRatio_props (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    xyRatio (x, 0) = 0 ∧ xyRatio (0, x) = 0 ∧ xyRatio (x, x) = 1 / 2 ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t => xyRatio (t, 0)) 0 0 ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t => xyRatio (0, t)) 0 0 ∧
      ¬ ContinuousAt xyRatio 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sign.doc: /-- The jump of `|x|/x` at `0` is not removable: no value `v` at `0` makes it continuous. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sign.statement: theorem sign_not_removable (v : ℝ) : ¬ ContinuousAt (fun x => if x = 0 then v else |x| / x) 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.binomial.doc:
/-- The first binomial coefficients: `C(-1, k) = (-1)^k` (the geometric series in `-x`) and `C(1/2, 1) = 1/2`,
`C(1/2, 2) = -1/8` (`√(1 + x) = 1 + x/2 - x²/8 + …`). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.binomial.statement:
theorem binomial_coefficients (k : ℕ) :
    Ring.choose (-1 : ℝ) k = (-1) ^ k ∧ Ring.choose (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1 = 1 / 2 ∧ Ring.choose (1 / 2 : ℝ) 2 = -1 / 8

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.expPa.doc: /-- `|s_m - s_n| ≤ 2/(n + 1)!` for `m > n`: the tail is bounded by a geometric series. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.expPa.statement: theorem expPartial_tail (n m : ℕ) (h : n < m) : |expPartial m - expPartial n| ≤ 2 / ((n + 1) ! : ℝ)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.sin_po.statement: theorem sin_pow_four : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sin x ^ 4 = 3 * π / 16

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- The Weierstrass M-test: if `|f_k(x)| ≤ M_k` with `∑ M_k < ∞`, the partial sums converge uniformly. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem m_test (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℝ) (hM : Summable M) (h : ∀ k x, |f k x| ≤ M k) :
    TendstoUniformly (fun n x => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f k x) (fun x => ∑' k, f k x) atTop

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.basel_ta.doc: /-- `∑ 1/n² = π²/6`, and the tail after `N` terms lies between `1/(N + 1)` and `1/N`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.basel_ta.statement:
theorem basel_tail (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1) ≤ π ^ 2 / 6 - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ∧
      π ^ 2 / 6 - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / N

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.newto.doc: /-- For `c ≥ 1` the Newton iterates are positive, satisfy `a_n² ≥ c` and decrease. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.newto.statement:
theorem newton_bounds (c : ℝ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (n : ℕ) :
    0 < newton c n ∧ c ≤ newton c n ^ 2 ∧ newton c (n + 1) ≤ newton c n

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.p_series.doc:
/-- The `p`-series `∑ 1/n^p` converges exactly when `p > 1`; at `p = 1` (the harmonic series) the terms tend to
`0` but the series diverges. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.p_series.statement: theorem p_series (p : ℝ) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ p) ↔ 1 < p

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.binomial.doc: /-- The binomial series: `(1 + x)^α = ∑ C(α, k) x^k` for `|x| < 1` and every real `α`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.binomial.statement:
theorem binomial_series (a x : ℝ) (hx : |x| < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => Ring.choose a k * x ^ k) ((1 + x) ^ a)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.Flat.doc:
/-- Every derivative of the flat function vanishes at `0` (stated, tested by Sage's limits of the derivatives, not
proved here). -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.cont.doc:
/-- Sums, products, quotients with non-vanishing denominator and compositions of continuous functions are
continuous. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.cont.statement:
theorem continuity_rules (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
    Continuous (fun x => f x + g x) ∧ Continuous (fun x => f x * g x) ∧ Continuous (g ∘ f) ∧
      ((∀ x, g x ≠ 0) → Continuous (fun x => f x / g x))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.compl.doc: /-- The completeness axiom: a non-empty set of reals bounded above has a least upper bound. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.compl.statement: theorem completeness (S : Set ℝ) (hne : S.Nonempty) (hb : BddAbove S) : ∃ M, IsLUB S M

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.condense.doc:
/-- Cauchy condensation: the block of `2^m` terms of `∑ 1/k^p` gives the geometric term `2^m · 2^(-mp) = (2^(1-p))^m`,
so the condensed series is geometric with ratio `2^(1-p)`, which is below `1` exactly when `p > 1`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.square.statement: theorem square_map_det (x y : ℝ) : Matrix.det !![2 * x, -2 * y; 2 * y, 2 * x] = 4 * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- The triangle's area `∫₀¹ ∫₀ˣ dy dx = 1/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: theorem triangle_area : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..x, (1 : ℝ)) = 1 / 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.polar_.doc: /-- The inverse of the polar Jacobian: `J⁻¹ = (cos φ, sin φ; -sin φ/r, cos φ/r)`, `J⁻¹ J = 1` for `r ≠ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.polar_.statement:
theorem polar_jacobian_inverse (r φ : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    !![Real.cos φ, Real.sin φ; -Real.sin φ / r, Real.cos φ / r] *
      !![Real.cos φ, -r * Real.sin φ; Real.sin φ, r * Real.cos φ] = 1

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- `∫₀² (∫₀¹ x² y dx) dy = 2/3`: the inner integral is `y/3`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: theorem rectangle_x_first : ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..2, (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ 2 * y) = 2 / 3

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.improp.doc: /-- The comparison test: `0 ≤ f ≤ g` with `∫ g` convergent forces `∫ f` convergent. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.improp.statement:
theorem improper_comparison (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (s : Set ℝ) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hf : ContinuousOn f s)
    (h0 : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ f x) (hfg : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ g x) (hg : IntegrableOn g s) : IntegrableOn f s

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.euler.statement:
theorem euler_increasing (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (1 + 1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ n < (1 + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ (n + 1)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.antide.statement: theorem antideriv_pow (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun x => x ^ (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) (x ^ n) x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.mean.statement:
theorem mean_value (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hd : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) : ∃ c ∈ Ioo a b, f' c = (f b - f a) / (b - a)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.one_s.doc:
/-- `sup {1 - 1/n} = 1` in the `ε` form: every element is below `1`, and for `n > 1/ε` the element `1 - 1/n`
exceeds `1 - ε`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.one_s.statement:
theorem one_sub_inv_sup (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 1 - 1 / (n : ℝ) < 1) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 1 / ε < n → 1 - ε < 1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.fixe.doc: /-- A continuous `f : [0, 1] → [0, 1]` has a fixed point. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.fixe.statement:
theorem fixed_point (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 1)) (hmaps : MapsTo f (Icc 0 1) (Icc 0 1)) :
    ∃ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f x = x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geom_two.doc: /-- The partial sums for `r = 2` are `2^(n+1) - 1`, unbounded. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geom_two.statement: theorem geom_two_partial (n : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ range n, (2 : ℝ) ^ k = 2 ^ n - 1

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.cubi.doc: /-- `x³ + x - y` has exactly one real root for every `y` (at `y = 1`: `f(0) = -1 < 0 < 1 = f(1)`). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.cubi.statement: theorem cubic_unique_root (y : ℝ) : ∃! x : ℝ, x ^ 3 + x - y = 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: theorem laplace_sin (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-(a * x)) * Real.sin x = 1 / (1 + a ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.alt_p_ab.doc: /-- `∑ |(-1)^k / k^p|` converges for `p > 1` (`p = 2`), by comparison with the `p`-series. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.alt_p_ab.statement: theorem alt_p_abs (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) : Summable (fun k : ℕ => |(-1 : ℝ) ^ k / (k : ℝ) ^ p|)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.fundam.doc:
/-- The fundamental theorem of calculus: `F(x) = ∫ₐˣ f` has `F' = f` for continuous `f`, and `∫ₐᵇ f = G(b) - G(a)`
for every antiderivative `G`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.fundam.statement:
theorem fundamental_theorem (f G : ℝ → ℝ) (a b x : ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (hG : ∀ y, HasDerivAt G (f y) y) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => ∫ t in a..x, f t) (f x) x ∧ ∫ t in a..b, f t = G b - G a

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc:
/-- The multivariate Gaussian integral (stated, tested at `2 × 2` matrices, not proved here): for symmetric
positive definite `A`, `∫_{ℝⁿ} e^(-xᵀAx/2) dⁿx = (2π)^(n/2)/√det A`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: def MultivariateGaussian : Prop

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.deri.statement: theorem deriv_sin_rule (x : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => Real.sin x) x = Real.cos x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc:
/-- The improper Dirichlet integral `∫₀^∞ sin x/x dx = π/2`, in the `ε`-`R₀` form of the limit of `∫₀ᴿ sin x/x dx`
(stated, tested by Sage's sine integral, not proved here). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: def DirichletLimit : Prop

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.partia.doc: /-- `∂_y(x² y + sin y) = x² + cos y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.partia.statement: theorem partial_y_f (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun y => x ^ 2 * y + Real.sin y) y = x ^ 2 + Real.cos y

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geometri.statement:
theorem geometric_moments (x : ℝ) (hx : |x| < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ) * x ^ k) (x / (1 - x) ^ 2) ∧
      HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * x ^ k) (2 * x ^ 2 / (1 - x) ^ 3)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- `∫₀¹ (∫₀² x² y dy) dx = 2/3`: the inner integral is `2x²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: theorem rectangle_y_first : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..2, x ^ 2 * y) = 2 / 3

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.inv_n.doc:
/-- `{1/n : n ≥ 1}` has the maximum `1` (attained at `n = 1`) and the infimum `0`, not attained: every element is
in `(0, 1]` and for `n > 1/ε` the element `1/n` is below `ε`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.neste.doc: /-- Nested closed intervals whose lengths tend to `0` have exactly one common point. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.neste.statement:
theorem nested_intervals (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (hab : ∀ n, a n ≤ b n) (ha : Monotone a) (hb : Antitone b)
    (hlen : Tendsto (fun n => b n - a n) atTop (𝓝 0)) : ∃! x, ∀ n, a n ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b n

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.chain_.statement: theorem chain_sin_sq (t : ℝ) : deriv (fun t => Real.sin (t ^ 2)) t = Real.cos (t ^ 2) * (2 * t)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement: theorem gaussian_shifted (μ σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) : ∫ x : ℝ, Real.exp (-(x - μ) ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2)) = √(2 * π) * σ

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.newto.doc: /-- The error of the Newton iterates for `√2`: `0 ≤ a_n - √2 ≤ (a_n² - 2)/2`, below `10⁻⁴⁸` at `n = 6`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.newto.statement: theorem newton_error (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ newton 2 n - √2 ∧ newton 2 n - √2 ≤ (newton 2 n ^ 2 - 2) / 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.walli.doc:
/-- Wallis's product: the partial products `W_k = ∏_{i<k} (2i+2)²/((2i+1)(2i+3))` satisfy
`(2k+1)/(2k+2) · π/2 ≤ W_k ≤ π/2`, so `π/2 = ∏ 4k²/(4k² - 1)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.walli.statement:
theorem wallis_product (k : ℕ) :
    ((2 : ℝ) * k + 1) / (2 * k + 2) * (π / 2) ≤ Real.Wallis.W k ∧ Real.Wallis.W k ≤ π / 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.pow_.doc: /-- Exponentials beat powers: `x^n e^(-x) → 0` as `x → ∞` (`x e^(-x)`, `x²/e^x`). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.pow_.statement: theorem pow_mul_exp_neg_limit (n : ℕ) : Tendsto (fun x => x ^ n * Real.exp (-x)) atTop (𝓝 0)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.doc: /-- Integration by parts: `∫ₐᵇ f g' = f g |ₐᵇ - ∫ₐᵇ f' g`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.statement:
theorem integration_by_parts (f g f' g' : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hg : ∀ x, HasDerivAt g (g' x) x) (hf' : Continuous f') (hg' : Continuous g') :
    ∫ x in a..b, f x * g' x = f b * g b - f a * g a - ∫ x in a..b, f' x * g x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc:
/-- `xⁿ → 0` for `0 ≤ x < 1` and `1ⁿ = 1`, while `sup_{[0,1)} xⁿ = 1` for every `n ≥ 1`: the convergence is
pointwise, not uniform. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem pow_not_uniform (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (x : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => x ^ m) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ IsLUB ((fun y : ℝ => y ^ n) '' Ico 0 1) 1

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.doc:
/-- On `[-π, π]` the remainder bound `π^(2m+1)/(2m+1)!` after `T_(2m-1)` is below `10⁻⁶` exactly for `m ≥ 8`
(`π¹⁷/17! = 8.0 · 10⁻⁷`). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.statement: theorem sin_terms_pi (m : ℕ) : π ^ (2 * m + 1) / ((2 * m + 1)! : ℝ) < 1 / 10 ^ 6 ↔ 8 ≤ m

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- A uniform limit of continuous functions is continuous. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem uniform_limit_continuous (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n, Continuous (f n))
    (h : TendstoUniformly f g atTop) : Continuous g

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.ratio_p_.doc:
/-- The ratio test is inconclusive at `L = 1`: for every `p` the ratio of `1/n^p` tends to `1`, and the
`p`-series converges for `p = 2` and diverges for `p = 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.ratio_p_.statement:
theorem ratio_p_series (p : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) ^ p) / (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ p)) atTop (𝓝 1)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.walli.statement:
theorem wallis_values (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sin x ^ (2 * n) = ((2 * n - 1 : ℕ)‼ : ℝ) / ((2 * n : ℕ)‼ : ℝ) * (π / 2) ∧
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sin x ^ (2 * n + 1) = ((2 * n : ℕ)‼ : ℝ) / ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ)‼ : ℝ)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.invers.doc:
/-- The inversion `I(u, v) = (u, v)/(u² + v²)` is its own inverse, and its Jacobian determinant is
`-1/(u² + v²)²`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem gaussian_second_moment (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    deriv (fun a => √(π / a)) a = -(1 / 2) * √π / (a * √a) ∧
      ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 * Real.exp (-a * x ^ 2) = 1 / 2 * √π / (a * √a)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.alt_harm.doc:
/-- Leibniz's error bound: the partial sums `s_m` of the alternating harmonic series alternate around `log 2`,
`(-1)^m (log 2 - s_m) ≥ 0`, with `|s_m - log 2| < 1/(m + 1)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.alt_harm.statement:
theorem alt_harmonic_error (m : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ (-1 : ℝ) ^ m * (Real.log 2 - ∑ k ∈ range m, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ∧
      |∑ k ∈ range m, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k / ((k : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log 2| < 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.deri.doc: /-- `(tan x)' = (sin x / cos x)' = 1/cos² x` where `cos x ≠ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.deri.statement:
theorem deriv_tan_rule (x : ℝ) (hx : Real.cos x ≠ 0) :
    deriv (fun x => Real.sin x / Real.cos x) x = 1 / Real.cos x ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.sin_.statement: theorem sin_terms_one (m : ℕ) : 1 / ((2 * m + 1)! : ℝ) < 1 / 10 ^ 10 ↔ 7 ≤ m

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.diff.statement: theorem diff_continuous (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a f' : ℝ) (h : HasDerivAt f f' a) : ContinuousAt f a

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.same.doc: /-- Functions with the same derivative differ by a constant. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.same.statement:
theorem same_deriv_const (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hg : Differentiable ℝ g)
    (h : ∀ x, deriv f x = deriv g x) : ∃ C, ∀ x, f x = g x + C

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.antide.statement: theorem antideriv_sin (x : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => -Real.cos x) x = Real.sin x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.leib.doc:
/-- The arctangent series at `x = 1` is Leibniz's series for `π/4`; after `k` terms the error is at most
`1/(2k + 1)`, so three decimals need about `500` terms. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.leib.statement:
theorem leibniz_error (k : ℕ) :
    |∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, leibnizTerm j - π / 4| ≤ 1 / (2 * (k : ℝ) + 1)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geometri.statement: theorem geometric_abs (r : ℝ) (hr : |r| < 1) : Summable (fun k : ℕ => |r ^ k|)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.contin.doc: /-- Continuous functions are integrable on `[a, b]`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.contin.statement:
theorem continuous_integrable (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (uIcc a b)) :
    IntervalIntegrable f volume a b

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- The Gaussian integral squared: `(∫_ℝ e^(-bx²) dx)² = π/b`; at `b = 1` it is `π`, so the integral is `√π`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem gaussian_sq (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, Real.exp (-b * x ^ 2)) ^ 2 = π / b ∧ ∫ x : ℝ, Real.exp (-b * x ^ 2) = √(π / b)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.harmonic.statement: theorem harmonic_two_pow (m : ℕ) : 1 + (m : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (harmonic (2 ^ m) : ℝ)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.antide.doc: /-- `(x sin x + cos x)' = x cos x`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.antide.statement: theorem antideriv_x_cos (x : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => x * Real.sin x + Real.cos x) x = x * Real.cos x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.recip.doc: /-- `1/n → 0`: for `n > 1/ε`, `|1/n - 0| < ε`, and the same `N` works for `(-1)^n/n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.recip.statement:
theorem recip_eps (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 / ε < n) :
    |1 / (n : ℝ) - 0| < ε ∧ |(-1 : ℝ) ^ n / n - 0| < ε

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.invers.statement:
theorem inverse_polar_det (r φ : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.det !![Real.cos φ, Real.sin φ; -Real.sin φ / r, Real.cos φ / r] = 1 / r

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.squee.statement:
theorem squeeze (a b c : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hab : ∀ n, a n ≤ b n) (hbc : ∀ n, b n ≤ c n)
    (ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 L)) (hc : Tendsto c atTop (𝓝 L)) : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 L)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem sqrt_exp_integral (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), √x * Real.exp (-(a * x)) = (1 / a) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.Gamma (3 / 2)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.decim.doc: /-- The decimal approximations form a Cauchy sequence: `|a_m - a_n| < 10⁻ⁿ` for `m ≥ n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.decim.statement:
theorem decimalTrunc_cauchy (x : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m) :
    |(decimalTrunc x m : ℝ) - decimalTrunc x n| < 1 / 10 ^ n

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.terms_te.doc: /-- If a series converges, its terms tend to `0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.terms_te.statement: theorem terms_tendsto_zero (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h : Summable a) : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.partia.doc: /-- `∂_y(x² y + sin y) = x² + cos y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.partia.statement: theorem partial_y_encoding (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun y => x ^ 2 * y + Real.sin y) y = x ^ 2 + Real.cos y

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.doc: /-- `∫_(-π/2)^(π/2) cos² θ dθ = π/2` (the substitution `x = sin θ`). -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.statement: theorem integral_cos_sq : ∫ θ in (-(π / 2))..(π / 2), Real.cos θ ^ 2 = π / 2

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- Fubini's theorem on a rectangle: for continuous `f` both iterated integrals equal the double integral. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.statement:
theorem fubini_rectangle (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (a b c d : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    ∫ p in Icc a b ×ˢ Icc c d, f p = ∫ x in a..b, ∫ y in c..d, f (x, y) ∧
      ∫ p in Icc a b ×ˢ Icc c d, f p = ∫ y in c..d, ∫ x in a..b, f (x, y)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.limit.doc: /-- The sum rule: `a_n → L` and `b_n → M` imply `a_n + b_n → L + M`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.limit.statement:
theorem limit_add (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (L M : ℝ) (ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 L)) (hb : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 M)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => a n + b n) atTop (𝓝 (L + M))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.quot.statement:
theorem quotient_rule (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a f' g' : ℝ) (hf : HasDerivAt f f' a) (hg : HasDerivAt g g' a)
    (hga : g a ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => f x / g x) ((f' * g a - f a * g') / g a ^ 2) a

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.gaussi.statement:
theorem gaussian_linear (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, Real.exp (-a * x ^ 2 + b * x) = √(π / a) * Real.exp (b ^ 2 / (4 * a))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.exp_term.doc: /-- Term-by-term differentiation of the exponential series: `(x^(k+1)/(k+1)!)' = x^k/k!`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.exp_term.statement:
theorem exp_term_deriv (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (k + 1) / ((k + 1)! : ℝ)) (x ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)) x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.newto.statement: theorem newton_limit (c : ℝ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) : Tendsto (newton c) atTop (𝓝 (√c))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.gradie.statement:
theorem gradient_ellipse (x y : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun x => x ^ 2 + 4 * y ^ 2) x = 2 * x ∧ deriv (fun y => x ^ 2 + 4 * y ^ 2) y = 8 * y

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.abs_.doc:
/-- `|x|` is continuous at `0` but not differentiable there: the difference quotient `|h|/h` has one-sided limits
`±1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.abs_.statement:
theorem abs_corner (a : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => |x - a|) ∧ ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : ℝ => |x - a|) a

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.log_.statement: theorem log_one_add_inv_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : Real.log (1 + 1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / n

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.arcs.statement:
theorem arcsin_arctan_deriv (x : ℝ) (hx : -1 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
    HasDerivAt Real.arcsin (1 / √(1 - x ^ 2)) x ∧ HasDerivAt Real.arctan (1 / (1 + x ^ 2)) x

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Series.geometri.statement:
theorem geometric_sums (r : ℝ) (hr : |r| < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => r ^ k) (1 / (1 - r)) ∧ HasSum (fun k : ℕ => r ^ (k + 1)) (r / (1 - r))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.polar_.doc:
/-- The polar map is a diffeomorphism from `(0, ∞) × (-π, π)` onto the plane minus the non-positive `x`-axis
(mathlib's `polarCoord`); at `r = 0` all angles give the origin. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.polar_.statement:
theorem polar_diffeo (φ : ℝ) :
    polarCoord.target = Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π ∧ (0 * Real.cos φ, 0 * Real.sin φ) = ((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.doub.doc:
/-- The double well `V(φ) = λ(φ² - v²)²/4` (`λ > 0`, `v ≠ 0`): `V'(φ) = λφ(φ² - v²)`, `V''(φ) = λ(3φ² - v²)`, which is
`-λv² < 0` at `0` (a local maximum) and `2λv² > 0` at `±v` (minima); at `λ = v = 1`: `V'' = -1` and `2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Continuity.doub.statement:
theorem double_well (lam v : ℝ) (hl : 0 < lam) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    (∀ p, deriv (fun p => lam * (p ^ 2 - v ^ 2) ^ 2 / 4) p = lam * p * (p ^ 2 - v ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ p, deriv (fun p => lam * p * (p ^ 2 - v ^ 2)) p = lam * (3 * p ^ 2 - v ^ 2)) ∧
      IsMinOn (fun p => lam * (p ^ 2 - v ^ 2) ^ 2 / 4) univ v ∧
      IsMinOn (fun p => lam * (p ^ 2 - v ^ 2) ^ 2 / 4) univ (-v) ∧
      IsLocalMax (fun p => lam * (p ^ 2 - v ^ 2) ^ 2 / 4) 0

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.MultipleIntegra.doc: /-- The tetrahedron `x, y, z ≥ 0`, `x + y + z ≤ 1` has volume `∫₀¹ ∫₀^(1-x) (1 - x - y) dy dx = 1/6`. -/

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.recip.doc: /-- `1/n` is decreasing and bounded below by `0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.recip.statement: theorem recip_decreasing (n : ℕ) : 0 < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) ∧ 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.diffeo.doc: /-- The Jacobian of a diffeomorphism is invertible: from `G ∘ F = id` the chain rule gives `J_G(F p) J_F(p) = 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Calculus.diffeo.statement: theorem diffeo_jacobian_invertible (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (h : B * A = 1) : IsUnit A.det

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.doc: /-- `∫₀ᵃ dx/√x = 2√a` for `a ≥ 0` (an integrable singularity at `0`); at `a = 1` it is `2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.integr.statement: theorem integral_inv_sqrt (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..a, 1 / √x = 2 * √a

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.x_sq_s.doc:
/-- The lower and upper sums of `x²` on `[0, 1]` with `n` equal subintervals are `(n-1)n(2n-1)/(6n³)` and
`n(n+1)(2n+1)/(6n³)`, with difference `1/n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Integral.x_sq_s.statement:
theorem x_sq_sums (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((k : ℝ) / n) ^ 2 * (1 / n) = ((n : ℝ) - 1) * n * (2 * n - 1) / (6 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3) ∧
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ((k : ℝ) / n) ^ 2 * (1 / n) = (n : ℝ) * (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1) / (6 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3) ∧
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ((k : ℝ) / n) ^ 2 * (1 / n) - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((k : ℝ) / n) ^ 2 * (1 / n) =
        1 / (n : ℝ)

KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.walli.doc: /-- `I_n = ∫₀^(π/2) sinⁿ x dx` decreases: `I_(2n+1) ≤ I_(2n) ≤ I_(2n-1)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Exercises.walli.statement:
theorem wallis_monotone (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sin x ^ (2 * n + 1) ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sin x ^ (2 * n) ∧
