    cint (fun z => z) γ a b = (γ b ^ 2 - γ a ^ 2) / 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- `cos z = 0` exactly at `z = π/2 + kπ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem cos_eq_zero_iff_claim (z : ℂ) : Complex.cos z = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, z = π / 2 + k * π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement:
theorem rational_contour (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ‖a‖ < ρ) :
    (∮ z in C(0, ρ), (z ^ 2 + 1) / (z * (z - a) ^ 2)) = 2 * π * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.doc: /-- Over `ℝ`, `x² + 1` has no zero (it is positive), so it does not factor into real linear factors. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement: theorem sq_add_one_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < x ^ 2 + 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.doc: /-- `Log` inverts `eᶻ` on the strip `-π < Im z < π`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.statement: theorem log_exp_strip (z : ℂ) (h₁ : -π < z.im) (h₂ : z.im < π) : Complex.log (Complex.exp z) = z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.clos.doc: /-- Closed discs (the closed unit disc among them) are compact. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.clos.statement: theorem closed_disc_compact (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) : IsCompact (closedBall c r)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc: /-- Jordan's inequality: `∫₀^π e^{-R sin θ} dθ ≤ π/R` for `R > 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement: theorem jordan (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, Real.exp (-(R * Real.sin θ)) ≤ π / R

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- The `n`-th root of the `n`-th term of the logarithmic series tends to `|z|` (`|aₙ|^(1/n) → 1`, `R = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem log_root (z : ℂ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖(-1) ^ (n + 1) * z ^ n / n‖ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / n)) atTop (𝓝 ‖z‖)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement:
theorem cint_ML (f : ℂ → ℂ) (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (a b M : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, ‖f (γ t)‖ ≤ M) (hγ : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖deriv γ t‖) volume a b) :
    ‖cint f γ a b‖ ≤ M * length γ a b

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- `e^{1/z}` never takes the value `0`: `0` is the one exceptional value. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement: theorem exp_inv_ne_zero (z : ℂ) : exp z⁻¹ ≠ 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc:
/-- The Gaussian with complex `λ = p + iq`, `Re λ = p > 0`: `∫ e^{-λx²/2} dx = (2π/λ)^{1/2}` (principal branch), with
`2π/λ = (2π/(p² + q²))(p - iq)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement:
theorem gaussian_complex (p q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-(1 / 2) * (p + q * I) * (x : ℂ) ^ 2) =
      (((2 * π / (p ^ 2 + q ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (p - q * I)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.doc: /-- The Wallis integral `∫₀^{π/2} sin⁴θ dθ = 3π/16`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement: theorem wallis_four : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sin θ ^ 4 = 3 * π / 16

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourWorke.statement: theorem t_sq_integral : ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ 2 = 1 / 3

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.disc.doc: /-- Open discs (the open unit disc among them) are domains: open and connected. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.disc.statement: theorem disc_domain (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : IsOpen (ball c r) ∧ IsConnected (ball c r)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- `Log` is holomorphic on the slit plane with `Log' z = 1/z`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem log_hasDerivAt (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ slitPlane) : HasDerivAt Complex.log z⁻¹ z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- The solutions of `zⁿ = 1` are the `ω_k`, `k = 0, …, n - 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement:
theorem roots_of_unity_iff (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (z : ℂ) :
    z ^ n = 1 ↔ ∃ k < n, Complex.exp (2 * π * I * (k / n)) = z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem cayley_one_sub (z : ℂ) (hz : z + I ≠ 0) : 1 - (z - I) / (z + I) = 2 * I / (z + I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem hasSum_inv_one_add_sq (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (-1) ^ n * z ^ (2 * n)) (1 / (1 + z ^ 2))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.doc: /-- `h` decays like `1/k²`: `|1/(k² - c²)| ≤ 4/(3k²)` for `|k| ≥ 2|c|`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement: theorem propagator_decay (c : ℂ) (k : ℝ) (hk : 2 * ‖c‖ ≤ |k|) : ‖1 / ((k : ℂ) ^ 2 - c ^ 2)‖ ≤ 4 / (3 * k ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem cpow_half_mul_I (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) : ((c : ℂ) * I) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) = (√c : ℝ) * Complex.exp (π * I / 4)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem cayley_left_inv (z : ℂ) (hz : z + I ≠ 0) : I * (1 + (z - I) / (z + I)) / (1 - (z - I) / (z + I)) = z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.doc:
/-- A rational quadratic `X² + bX + c` with negative discriminant `b² < 4c` has no rational root and is irreducible over
`ℚ`; this covers the factors `X² ± X + 1` (discriminant `-3`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.statement: theorem quadratic_irreducible (b c : ℚ) (h : b ^ 2 < 4 * c) : Irreducible (X ^ 2 + C b * X + C c : ℚ[X])

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement: theorem inv_sq_primitive (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => -z⁻¹) ((z ^ 2)⁻¹) z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- The exponential is periodic with period `2πi`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem exp_periodic_claim (z : ℂ) : Complex.exp (z + 2 * π * I) = Complex.exp z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement: theorem deriv_sq (z : ℂ) : deriv (fun w : ℂ => w ^ 2) z = 2 * z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.cir.statement: theorem circle_length (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) : length (circleMap z₀ r) 0 (2 * π) = 2 * π * r

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.rat.doc:
/-- The residues of `(z² + 1)/(z (z - a)²)` on small circles: `1/a²` at `0` (also `lim z f(z)`) and `1 - 1/a²`
at `a` (the text: `a = 1`: `1` and `0`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.rat.statement:
theorem rational_residues (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρa : ρ < ‖a‖) :
    residue (fun z => (z ^ 2 + 1) / (z * (z - a) ^ 2)) 0 ρ = 1 / a ^ 2 ∧
      Tendsto (fun z => (z - 0) * ((z ^ 2 + 1) / (z * (z - a) ^ 2))) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (1 / a ^ 2)) ∧
      residue (fun z => (z ^ 2 + 1) / (z * (z - a) ^ 2)) a ρ = 1 - 1 / a ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.sqr.doc:
/-- A branch of `√(z² - c)` where `c - z²` avoids the cut: `i (c - z²)^{1/2}`; for `c = 1` a branch of `√(z² - 1)` on
`ℂ ∖ ((-∞, -1] ∪ [1, ∞))`. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.doc: /-- The two prescriptions are complex conjugates: `∫ dk/(k² - E² - iε) = conj ∫ dk/(k² - E² + iε)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement:
theorem prescriptions_conj (E ε : ℝ) :
    ∫ k : ℝ, 1 / ((k : ℂ) ^ 2 - E ^ 2 - ε * I) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (∫ k : ℝ, 1 / ((k : ℂ) ^ 2 - E ^ 2 + ε * I))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement: theorem re_not_differentiableAt (z : ℂ) : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (w.re : ℂ)) z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.para.statement: theorem parallelogram (z w : ℂ) : ‖z + w‖ ^ 2 + ‖z - w‖ ^ 2 = 2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement:
theorem sq_identity (s c S C : ℝ) (h1 : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (h2 : C ^ 2 - S ^ 2 = 1) :
    (s * C) ^ 2 + (c * S) ^ 2 = s ^ 2 + S ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.doc: /-- `1/(2 + i) = (2 - i)/5`: multiply by the conjugate. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement: theorem quot_example : 1 / (2 + I) = (2 - I) / 5

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem cayley_inv_num (w : ℂ) (h1 : 1 - w ≠ 0) : I * (1 + w) / (1 - w) - I = 2 * I * w / (1 - w)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement:
theorem cif_deriv (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R)) :
    2 * π * I * iteratedDeriv n f c = n.factorial * ∮ z in C(c, R), f z / (z - c) ^ (n + 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement:
theorem cint_poly5_closed (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ) (hγ : ContDiff ℝ 1 γ) (hclosed : γ a = γ b) :
    cint (fun z => z ^ 5 - 3 * z + 2) γ a b = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement: theorem conj_diffQuot (z h : ℂ) (hh : h ≠ 0) : (conj (z + h) - conj z) / h = conj h / h

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `1/z = x/(x² + y²) - i y/(x² + y²)`: the product with `z` is `1`. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- On a disc every harmonic function is the real part of a holomorphic function: it has a harmonic conjugate. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem conjugate_exists (u : ℂ → ℝ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (hu : HarmonicOnNhd u (ball c R)) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ F (ball c R) ∧ ∀ z ∈ ball c R, (F z).re = u z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.doc: /-- The residue at `-E + iδ` as a limit: `(k - (-E + iδ)) h(k) → 1/((-E + iδ) - (E - iδ))`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement:
theorem propagator_residue (E δ : ℝ) (hE : 0 < E) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℂ => (k - (-E + δ * I)) * (1 / ((k - (E - δ * I)) * (k - (-E + δ * I)))))
      (𝓝[≠] (-E + δ * I)) (𝓝 (1 / ((-E + δ * I) - (E - δ * I))))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc: /-- A circle enclosing only the pole `a`: `∮ = 2πi/(a - b)` (the text: `|z| = 1.5`, `-2πi`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement:
theorem two_poles_one (a b : ℂ) (hab : a ≠ b) (ρ : ℝ) (ha : ‖a‖ < ρ) (hb : ρ < ‖b‖) :
    (∮ z in C(0, ρ), 1 / ((z - a) * (z - b))) = 2 * π * I / (a - b)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- `cos z` and `sin z` equal their series for every `z`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem hasSum_cos_sin (z : ℂ) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (-1) ^ n * z ^ (2 * n) / (Nat.factorial (2 * n) : ℂ)) (cos z) ∧
      HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (-1) ^ n * z ^ (2 * n + 1) / (Nat.factorial (2 * n + 1) : ℂ)) (sin z)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem norm_exp_claim (x y : ℝ) : ‖Complex.exp (x + y * I)‖ = Real.exp x

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.doc: /-- `h̄/h = 1` for real `h = t ≠ 0` and `h̄/h = -1` for imaginary `h = t i`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement: theorem conj_quot_axes (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0) : conj (t : ℂ) / t = 1 ∧ conj ((t : ℂ) * I) / (t * I) = -1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement:
theorem derivs_from_boundary (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R)) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (closedBall c R))
    (hfg : ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, f z = g z) : iteratedDeriv n f c = iteratedDeriv n g c

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc: /-- `∫ dx/(a² + x²) = π/a` for `a > 0` (the text: `a = 1`, `∫ dx/(1 + x²) = π`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement: theorem integral_inv_sq_add_sq (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : ∫ x : ℝ, 1 / (a ^ 2 + x ^ 2) = π / a

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `v_y = eˣ cos y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem exp_vy (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun y => Real.exp x * Real.sin y) y = Real.exp x * Real.cos y

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement:
theorem toMat_add (x y u v : ℝ) :
    !![x, -y; y, x] + !![u, -v; v, u] = !![x + u, -(y + v); y + v, x + u]

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- `ω_k = e^{2πik/n}` satisfies `ω_kⁿ = 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem root_of_unity_pow (n k : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) : Complex.exp (((2 * π * k / n : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) ^ n = 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.doc: /-- Legendre's duplication formula `Γ(z)Γ(z + 1/2) = 2^{1-2z}√π Γ(2z)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement:
theorem gamma_duplication (z : ℂ) :
    Complex.Gamma z * Complex.Gamma (z + 1 / 2) = 2 ^ (1 - 2 * z) * (√π : ℝ) * Complex.Gamma (2 * z)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc:
/-- The sum of all residues vanishes: for `f = ∑ cᵢ/(z - wᵢ)^(kᵢ+1) + g` with every pole inside `|z| < ρ`,
the finite residues plus `Res_∞ f = -(2πi)⁻¹ ∮_{|z| = ρ} f` sum to `0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement:
theorem sum_residues_zero {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (w c : ι → ℂ) (k : ι → ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, w i ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (closedBall 0 ρ)) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, if k i = 0 then c i else 0) +
      -residue (fun z => (∑ i ∈ s, c i / (z - w i) ^ (k i + 1)) + g z) 0 ρ = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.doc: /-- `1/sin z` has a simple pole at each `kπ` with residue `(-1)ᵏ`; for `k = 0` the residue is `1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.statement:
theorem csc_residue (k : ℤ) :
    Tendsto (fun z => (z - k * π) * (1 / sin z)) (𝓝[≠] ((k : ℂ) * π)) (𝓝 ((-1) ^ k))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc: /-- The real part of `∫_{ε < |x| < R} e^{ix}/x dx` vanishes: `cos x/x` is odd. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement: theorem odd_pv (ε R : ℝ) : (∫ x in (-R)..(-ε), Real.cos x / x) + ∫ x in ε..R, Real.cos x / x = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc:
/-- If `f` is complex differentiable at `z`, its partial derivatives exist: `f_x = f'` and `f_y = f' i` (that is
`u_y + i v_y = i(u_x + i v_x)`: `u_y = -v_x`, `v_y = u_x`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem partials (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) (h : DifferentiableAt ℂ f z) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (z + t)) (deriv f z) 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (z + t * I)) (deriv f z * I) 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.ga.doc: /-- The Fourier transform of the Gaussian: `∫ e^{-x²/2} e^{ikx} dx = √(2π) e^{-k²/2}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.ga.statement:
theorem gaussian_fourier (k : ℝ) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-(x : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) * Complex.exp (I * k * x) =
      ((2 * π : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(k : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement: theorem fta (p : ℂ[X]) (hp : 0 < p.natDegree) : ∃ z, p.eval z = 0
theorem sin_unbounded (M : ℝ) : ∃ z : ℂ, M < ‖sin z‖

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourWorke.statement: theorem exp_div_residue (a : ℂ) : Tendsto (fun z => z * (exp (a * z) / z)) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.doc:
/-- The residue at `-E + iδ` is `1/((-E + iδ) - (E - iδ))` with `(-E + iδ) - (E - iδ) = -2E + 2iδ`, so
`2πi Res_{-E+iδ} h = 2πi/(-2E + 2iδ)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement: theorem residue_value (E δ : ℝ) : (-(E : ℂ) + δ * I) - (E - δ * I) = -2 * E + 2 * δ * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.roo.doc:
/-- A number whose `n`-th power has modulus `rⁿ` has modulus `r`: the four roots of `z⁴ = -16` (`|z⁴| = 16 = 2⁴`)
lie on the circle of radius `2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.roo.statement:
theorem roots_neg_sixteen_norm (z : ℂ) (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (h : ‖z ^ n‖ = r ^ n) :
    ‖z‖ = r

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.doc:
/-- The error of the annulus partial sums: `f - S_N = -(z/2)^N/(2 - z) - z^(-N)/(z - 1)`, written with
`+ z^(-N)/(1 - z)` for the last term. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement:
theorem ball_volume_from_sphere (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    2 * π ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) / Real.Gamma ((n : ℝ) / 2) / n = π ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) / Real.Gamma ((n : ℝ) / 2 + 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- The Cauchy estimate: `|aₙ| ≤ M/rⁿ` when `|f| ≤ M` on the circle `|z - c| = r`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem cauchy_estimate (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r M : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (ball c r))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ sphere c r, ‖f z‖ ≤ M) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv n f c / (Nat.factorial n : ℂ)‖ ≤ M / r ^ n

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- The Euclidean side, multiplied out: `E · i ∫ dk⁴/((ik⁴)² - E²) = -iπ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement:
theorem euclidean_side (E : ℝ) (hE : 0 < E) :
    (E : ℂ) * (I * ∫ k : ℝ, 1 / ((I * k) ^ 2 - (E : ℂ) ^ 2)) = -(π * I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.statement: theorem factor_rat : (X ^ 6 - 1 : ℚ[X]) = (X - 1) * (X + 1) * (X ^ 2 + X + 1) * (X ^ 2 - X + 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement:
theorem cauchy_rect (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z w : ℂ)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Set.uIcc z.re w.re ×ℂ Set.uIcc z.im w.im)) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in z.re..w.re, f (x + z.im * I)) - (∫ x : ℝ in z.re..w.re, f (x + w.im * I)) +
      I • (∫ y : ℝ in z.im..w.im, f (w.re + y * I)) - I • (∫ y : ℝ in z.im..w.im, f (z.re + y * I)) = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- `Log(-1) = iπ` and `Log(i) = iπ/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement: theorem log_neg_one_I : Complex.log (-1) = π * I ∧ Complex.log I = π / 2 * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.sem.statement: theorem semicircle_closed (R : ℝ) : seg (-R) R 1 = circleMap 0 R 0 ∧ circleMap 0 R π = seg (-R) R 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.doc: /-- `V_n = π^{n/2}/Γ(n/2 + 1)` makes sense for every complex `n`: it is an entire function of `n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement:
theorem ball_volume_entire (s : ℂ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun s : ℂ => (π : ℂ) ^ (s / 2) * (Complex.Gamma (s / 2 + 1))⁻¹) s

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.rat.doc: /-- Partial fractions of `(z² + 1)/(z (z - a)²)`: residue `1/a²` at `0` and `1 - 1/a²` at `a` (the text: `a = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.rat.statement:
theorem rational_partial_fractions (a z : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hza : z - a ≠ 0) :
    (z ^ 2 + 1) / (z * (z - a) ^ 2) = 1 / a ^ 2 / z + (1 - 1 / a ^ 2) / (z - a) + (a ^ 2 + 1) / a / (z - a) ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement: theorem deriv_rational (z : ℂ) (hz : z ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) : deriv ratFun z = ratDeriv z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.statement: theorem zero_partial (y : ℝ) : deriv (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) y = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- Inside the disc of convergence the sum may be differentiated term by term. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem hasSum_deriv (a : ℕ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) (hz : (‖z‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) < radius a) :
    HasSum (fun n => a n * (n * z ^ (n - 1))) (deriv (fun w => ∑' n, a n * w ^ n) z)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.doc:
/-- `e^{1/z} = ∑_{n ≥ 0} z⁻ⁿ/n!` on `0 < |z|`: the coefficient of `z⁻¹` is `1`, and every coefficient of the
principal part is non-zero (the principal part is infinite). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.statement:
theorem exp_inv_laurent (z : ℂ) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => z⁻¹ ^ n / (Nat.factorial n : ℂ)) (exp z⁻¹) ∧ z⁻¹ ^ 1 / (Nat.factorial 1 : ℂ) = z⁻¹ ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, (Nat.factorial n : ℂ)⁻¹ ≠ 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.doc: /-- Used outside its annulus (`|z| ≥ 1`), the Taylor series diverges: its terms do not tend to `0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.statement:
theorem taylor_diverges (z : ℂ) (hz : 1 ≤ ‖z‖) :
    ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1 - (1 / 2 : ℂ) ^ (n + 1)) * z ^ n)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.doc:
/-- With `c² = E² - iε`, `Re c > 0` (the pole in the fourth quadrant): the imaginary part of the Minkowski integral
is `-π/E` up to `πε²/(2E⁵)` and its real part is at most `πε/(2E³)` (`E = 1`, `ε = 10⁻⁴`: `-π` to `10⁻³`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement:
theorem minkowski_numeric (E ε : ℝ) (hE : 0 < E) (hε : 0 < ε) (c : ℂ) (hc : c ^ 2 = E ^ 2 - ε * I)
    (hre : 0 < c.re) :
    |(∫ k : ℝ, 1 / ((k : ℂ) ^ 2 - E ^ 2 + ε * I)).im + π / E| ≤ π * ε ^ 2 / (2 * E ^ 5) ∧
      |(∫ k : ℝ, 1 / ((k : ℂ) ^ 2 - E ^ 2 + ε * I)).re| ≤ π * ε / (2 * E ^ 3)
theorem gamma_neg_half : Real.Gamma (-1 / 2) = -2 * √π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement: theorem beta_symm (a b : ℂ) : betaIntegral a b = betaIntegral b a

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.ell.statement: theorem ellipse_identity (c s : ℝ) (h : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) : (2 * c) ^ 2 + 4 * s ^ 2 = 4

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.seg.statement: theorem seg_diag_length (a : ℝ) : length (seg 0 (a + a * I)) 0 1 = Real.sqrt 2 * |a|

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.roo.doc: /-- The four solutions of `z⁴ = -16` are `√2(±1 ± i)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- `1/((z - a)(z - b))`, `a ≠ b`, has simple poles at `a` and `b` (the text: `a = 1`, `b = 2`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement:
theorem two_simple_poles (a b : ℂ) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    IsPoleOfOrder (fun z => 1 / ((z - a) * (z - b))) a 1 ∧
      IsPoleOfOrder (fun z => 1 / ((z - a) * (z - b))) b 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- The series of `1/(z² + 4)` about `0` converges exactly on `|z| < 2`: its radius is `2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem summable_inv_sq_add_four_iff (z : ℂ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (-1) ^ n * z ^ (2 * n) / 4 ^ (n + 1)) ↔ ‖z‖ < 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.fOu.doc: /-- Just above and below the cut at `0`: `f(±iε) = ±i√(ε² + 1)`, which tends to `±i` (a jump of `2i`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.fOu.statement:
theorem fOut_imaginary (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    fOut (ε * I) = √(ε ^ 2 + 1) * I ∧ fOut (-(ε * I)) = -(√(ε ^ 2 + 1) * I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- Setting the value `1` at `0` makes `sin z/z` entire. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement: theorem sinc_entire (z : ℂ) : DifferentiableAt ℂ (update (fun z => sin z / z) 0 1) z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem conj_parts (x y : ℝ) : conj ((x : ℂ) + y * I) = (x : ℂ) - y * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- The tangents are non-zero away from `z = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem parabola_tangent_ne_zero (a b : ℝ) (h : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) : 0 < (-2 * b) ^ 2 + (2 * a) ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc:
/-- If `f(z) - f(z₀) = (z - z₀)ⁿ g(z)` with `g` continuous at `z₀` (the Taylor expansion, `g(z₀) = f⁽ⁿ⁾(z₀)/n!`),
then along the ray `z₀ + t e^{iα}` the displacement `(f(z) - f(z₀))/tⁿ` tends to `g(z₀) e^{inα}`: the image curve
leaves `f(z₀)` in the direction `arg g(z₀) + nα`, so angles between curves are multiplied by `n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement:
theorem critical_direction (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ) (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ)
    (hfg : ∀ z, f z - f z₀ = (z - z₀) ^ n * g z) (hg : ContinuousAt g z₀) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (f (z₀ + t * Complex.exp (α * I)) - f z₀) / (t : ℂ) ^ n) (𝓝[≠] 0)
      (𝓝 (g z₀ * Complex.exp (((n * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourWorke.statement:
theorem exp_circle_series (t : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => exp (k * t * I) / k.factorial) (exp (exp (t * I)))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.doc: /-- `(cos z)' = -sin z` and `(sin z)' = cos z`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement: theorem deriv_cos_sin (z : ℂ) : deriv Complex.cos z = -Complex.sin z ∧ deriv Complex.sin z = Complex.cos z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement: theorem beta_half_half : betaIntegral (1 / 2) (1 / 2) = π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- The cross terms cancel: `r²(u_rr + u_r/r + u_θθ/r²) = r²(u_xx + u_yy)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem polar_laplacian (c s r p q a b d : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    r ^ 2 * (c ^ 2 * a + 2 * c * s * b + s ^ 2 * d) + r * (c * p + s * q) +
        (r ^ 2 * (s ^ 2 * a - 2 * s * c * b + c ^ 2 * d) - r * (c * p + s * q)) = r ^ 2 * (a + d)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc:
/-- At the image of `a + ib` the two parabolas have tangents `(-2b, 2a)` and `(2a, 2b)` (the derivatives
`CauchyRiemann.sq_uy`, `sq_vy`, `sq_ux`, `sq_vx`), which are orthogonal. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem parabolas_orthogonal (a b : ℝ) : (-2 * b) * (2 * a) + (2 * a) * (2 * b) = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement: theorem liouville (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (hb : ∃ M, ∀ z, ‖f z‖ ≤ M) (z w : ℂ) : f z = f w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- `ln |z| = ln √(x² + y²)` is the real part of every branch `Log z + 2πik` of `log z`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem log_re_eq (k : ℤ) (x y : ℝ) :
    (Complex.log ((x : ℂ) + y * I) + 2 * π * I * k).re = Real.log (Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.statement:
theorem outer_region (z : ℂ) (hz : 2 < ‖z‖) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (2 ^ (n + 1) - 1) * z⁻¹ ^ (n + 2)) (1 / ((z - 1) * (z - 2)))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.statement:
theorem laplace_gamma (a r : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), t ^ (a - 1) * Real.exp (-(r * t)) = Real.Gamma a / r ^ a

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.doc: /-- For `Re s > 1` the series `∑ 1/(n + 1)^s` converges absolutely, with sum `ζ(s)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.statement:
theorem zeta_series (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖1 / ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ s‖) ∧ HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ s) (riemannZeta s)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.pr.doc:
/-- For `t < 0` (closing above, the pole `-E + iδ`): `(1/2π)(2πi) e^{-i(-E + iδ)t}/(-2(E - iδ)) → -(i/2E) e^{iEt}`,
so that `G(t) = -(i/2E) e^{-iE|t|}` for both signs of `t`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.pr.statement:
theorem propagator_neg (E t : ℝ) (hE : 0 < E) :
    Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => 1 / (2 * π) * (2 * π * I) *
      (Complex.exp (-I * (-E + I * δ) * t) / (-2 * (E - I * δ)))) (𝓝 0)
      (𝓝 (-(I / (2 * E)) * Complex.exp (I * E * t)))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- The principal values satisfy additivity up to `2πik`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement:
theorem log_mul_mod (z w : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, Complex.log (z * w) = Complex.log z + Complex.log w + 2 * π * I * k

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- The vertical line `Re z = x₀` goes to the circle of radius `e^{x₀}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem exp_vertical_circle (x₀ y : ℝ) : ‖Complex.exp ((x₀ : ℂ) + y * I)‖ = Real.exp x₀

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc: /-- On `|z| = R > 1`: `|z²/(1 + z⁴)| ≤ R²/(R⁴ - 1)`, so the arc is negligible (`deg q - deg p = 2`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement:
theorem arc_bound_sq_fourth (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 < R) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = R) :
    ‖z ^ 2 / (1 + z ^ 4)‖ ≤ R ^ 2 / (R ^ 4 - 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc: /-- The large arc: `|∫_{C_R} e^{iz} dz/z| ≤ ∫₀^π e^{-R sin θ} dθ ≤ π/R → 0` (Jordan's lemma). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement: theorem large_arc (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) : ‖∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, exp (I * (R * exp (θ * I))) * I‖ ≤ π / R

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- At `0` the two half-axes `t > 0` and `-t < 0` (at angle `π`) are both sent to `t²` on the positive real axis. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem half_axes (t : ℝ) : (t : ℂ) ^ 2 = ((t ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧ (-(t : ℂ)) ^ 2 = ((t ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem lambda_eq (a ε : ℂ) : -I * (a + ε * I) = ε - a * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- `u_yy = -eˣ cos y` for `u = eˣ cos y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem exp_uyy (x y : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun y => deriv (fun y => Real.exp x * Real.cos y) y) y = -(Real.exp x * Real.cos y)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc:
/-- A circle enclosing both poles of `1/((z - a)(z - b))`: `∮ = 2πi (1/(a - b) + 1/(b - a)) = 0`
(the text: `|z| = 3`, `a = 1`, `b = 2`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement:
theorem two_poles_both (a b : ℂ) (hab : a ≠ b) (ρ : ℝ) (ha : ‖a‖ < ρ) (hb : ‖b‖ < ρ) :
    (∮ z in C(0, ρ), 1 / ((z - a) * (z - b))) = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.sq_n.statement: theorem sq_norm_eq_mul_conj (z : ℂ) : ((‖z‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = z * conj z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem exp_three_pi_div_two : Complex.exp (3 * π / 2 * I) = -I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- Compositions of holomorphic functions are holomorphic. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement:
theorem comp_holo (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (U V : Set ℂ) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g V)
    (hUV : Set.MapsTo f U V) : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => g (f z)) U

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- The geometric expansion of the Cauchy kernel: `1/(w - z) = ∑ (z - c)ⁿ/(w - c)ⁿ⁺¹` for `|z - c| < |w - c|`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem hasSum_cauchy_kernel (c w z : ℂ) (h : ‖z - c‖ < ‖w - c‖) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (z - c) ^ n / (w - c) ^ (n + 1)) (1 / (w - z))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement:
theorem cint_inv_sq_closed (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ) (hγ : ContDiff ℝ 1 γ) (h0 : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0)
    (hclosed : γ a = γ b) : cint (fun z => (z ^ 2)⁻¹) γ a b = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem polar_form : 2 * (1 + I) = ((2 * Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (↑(π / 4) * I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem sq_laplacian (x y : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun x => deriv (fun x => x ^ 2 - y ^ 2) x) x + deriv (fun y => deriv (fun y => x ^ 2 - y ^ 2) y) y = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- The ML estimate: `(1/2π) (M/rⁿ⁺¹) (2πr) = M/rⁿ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem ml_arith (M r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    1 / (2 * π) * (M / r ^ (n + 1)) * (2 * π * r) = M / r ^ n

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement:
theorem cint_primitive_closed (f F : ℂ → ℂ) (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt F (f (γ t)) (γ t))
    (hγ : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt γ (deriv γ t) t)
    (hc : ContinuousOn (fun t => f (γ t) * deriv γ t) (Set.uIcc a b)) (hclosed : γ a = γ b) :
    cint f γ a b = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- A pole of order `m` means that `(z - c)ᵐ f(z)` has a removable singularity with non-zero value at `c`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement:
theorem isPoleOfOrder_iff (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (m : ℕ) :
    IsPoleOfOrder f c m ↔
      ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ g c ∧ g c ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] c, (z - c) ^ m * f z = g z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.norm.statement:
theorem norm_product_example :
    ‖(2 + I) * (3 - I)‖ = √50 ∧ ‖(7 : ℂ) + I‖ = √50 ∧ √50 = √5 * √10

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.sq_n.statement: theorem sq_norm_add (z w : ℂ) : ‖z + w‖ ^ 2 = ‖z‖ ^ 2 + ‖w‖ ^ 2 + 2 * (z * conj w).re

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.fOu.statement: theorem fOut_asymptotic (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) : ‖fOut z - z‖ ≤ 1 / ‖z‖

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.doc: /-- `z² e^{1/z} = z² + z + 1/2 + 1/(6z) + …`: the coefficient of `1/z` is `1/6 = z² · z⁻³/3!`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.statement:
theorem sq_mul_exp_inv (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => z ^ 2 * (z⁻¹ ^ n / (Nat.factorial n : ℂ))) (z ^ 2 * exp z⁻¹) ∧
      z ^ 2 * (z⁻¹ ^ 0 / (Nat.factorial 0 : ℂ)) = z ^ 2 ∧ z ^ 2 * (z⁻¹ ^ 1 / (Nat.factorial 1 : ℂ)) = z ∧
      z ^ 2 * (z⁻¹ ^ 2 / (Nat.factorial 2 : ℂ)) = 1 / 2 ∧
      z ^ 2 * (z⁻¹ ^ 3 / (Nat.factorial 3 : ℂ)) = 1 / 6 * z⁻¹

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement: theorem gamma_quarter_duplication : Real.Gamma (1 / 4) * Real.Gamma (3 / 4) = √2 * π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement:
theorem cif (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c w : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R)) (hw : w ∈ ball c R) :
    2 * π * I * f w = ∮ z in C(c, R), f z / (z - w)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.re.doc: /-- The reflection formula `Γ(a)Γ(1 - a) = π/sin πa` (mathlib's form, for every complex `a`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.re.statement:
theorem reflection (a : ℂ) (ha : ∀ n : ℤ, a ≠ n) :
    Complex.Gamma a * Complex.Gamma (1 - a) * Complex.sin (π * a) = π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.pol.doc: /-- The addition formula: `r(cos θ + i sin θ) s(cos φ + i sin φ) = rs(cos(θ + φ) + i sin(θ + φ))`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.pol.statement:
theorem polar_mul (r s θ φ : ℝ) :
    ((r : ℂ) * (Complex.cos θ + Complex.sin θ * I)) * ((s : ℂ) * (Complex.cos φ + Complex.sin φ * I)) =
      (r * s : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (θ + φ) + Complex.sin (θ + φ) * I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc:
/-- At infinity `1/(1 + z⁴) = ∑ (-1)ⁿ z^(-4n-4)` for `|z| > 1`: no `1/z` term, so `Res_∞ = 0` and the four finite
residues sum to `0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement:
theorem inv_one_add_fourth_infinity (z : ℂ) (hz : 1 < ‖z‖) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (-1) ^ n * z⁻¹ ^ (4 * n + 4)) (1 / (1 + z ^ 4))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.doc: /-- Vieta: the product of the roots of the monic `z⁶ - 1` is `(-1)⁶ · (-1) = -1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.statement: theorem vieta_product : ((-1 : ℂ) ^ 6) * (-1) = -1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement: theorem exp2_div_cube (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) : (∮ z in C(0, R), exp (2 * z) / z ^ 3) = 4 * π * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.doc:
/-- Running the recursion `n + 1` times: `Γ(z) z(z + 1)⋯(z + n) = Γ(z + n + 1)`, i.e.
`Γ(z) = Γ(z + n + 1)/(z(z + 1)⋯(z + n))`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.statement:
theorem gamma_eq_div_prod (z : ℂ) (hz : ∀ m : ℕ, z ≠ -m) (n : ℕ) :
    Complex.Gamma z * ∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (z + k) = Complex.Gamma (z + n + 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.doc: /-- The explicit sixth roots: `ω⁰ … ω⁵ = 1, ½ + i√3/2, -½ + i√3/2, -1, -½ - i√3/2, ½ - i√3/2`. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.con.doc: /-- Across the positive axis both are continuous: `Log` and `√` are continuous at every `x > 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.con.statement:
theorem continuous_positive_axis (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    ContinuousAt Complex.log x ∧ ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ => z ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)) x

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- The other branches `Log z + 2πik` have the same derivative `1/z`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement:
theorem branch_hasDerivAt (k : ℤ) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ slitPlane) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w => Complex.log w + 2 * π * I * k) z⁻¹ z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- The zeros of `z² - 1` are `1` and `-1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem sq_sub_one_eq_zero_iff (z : ℂ) : z ^ 2 - 1 = 0 ↔ z = 1 ∨ z = -1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc:
/-- On every disc `|z - z₀| < |z₀|` (not containing `0`) `ln |z|` has a conjugate: it is the real part of the
holomorphic `Log(z/z₀) + Log z₀`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem log_conjugate_disc (z₀ : ℂ) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ F (ball z₀ ‖z₀‖) ∧ ∀ z ∈ ball z₀ ‖z₀‖, (F z).re = Real.log ‖z‖

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.doc: /-- Products go to products: the matrix of `(x + iy)(u + iv)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement:
theorem toMat_mul (x y u v : ℝ) :
    !![x, -y; y, x] * !![u, -v; v, u] = !![x * u - y * v, -(x * v + y * u); x * v + y * u, x * u - y * v]

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourWorke.statement:
theorem circle_zpow_radius (n : ℤ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∮ z in C(0, r), z ^ n) = I * (r : ℂ) ^ (n + 1) * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..2 * π, exp ((n + 1) * t * I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.statement:
theorem exp_jac_det (x y : ℝ) :
    !![Real.exp x * Real.cos y, -(Real.exp x * Real.sin y); Real.exp x * Real.sin y, Real.exp x * Real.cos y].det =
      Real.exp x ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.res.doc:
/-- The Laurent series at infinity `∑_{n ≥ 2} (2ⁿ⁻¹ - 1) z⁻ⁿ` of `1/((z - 1)(z - 2))` has no `1/z` term:
`Res_∞ = -a₋₁ = 0` on every circle `|z| = ρ > 2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.res.statement:
theorem residue_infinity_series (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 2 < ρ) :
    -residue (fun z => ∑' n : ℕ, (2 ^ (n + 1) - 1) * (z - 0) ^ (-((n : ℤ) + 2))) 0 ρ = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem sq_vx (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => 2 * x * y) x = 2 * y

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- Differentiable implies continuous: `f(z + h) - f(z) → 0` as `h → 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement:
theorem tendsto_of_hasDerivAt (f : ℂ → ℂ) (f' z : ℂ) (hf : HasDerivAt f f' z) :
    Tendsto (fun h => f (z + h) - f z) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourWorke.statement:
theorem fourier_orth (m n : ℤ) :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..2 * π, exp (m * t * I) * exp (-(n * t * I)) = if m = n then (2 * π : ℂ) else 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.log.doc:
/-- `log₊ + 2πik` is a branch of `log` off the cut `[0, ∞)` (continuous across the negative axis); `k = 0` is
`log₊` itself. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.log.statement: theorem logPos_branch (k : ℤ) : IsBranch logSet {z | -z ∈ slitPlane} (fun z => logPos z + 2 * π * I * k)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement: theorem exp_diff (z h : ℂ) : Complex.exp (z + h) - Complex.exp z = Complex.exp z * (Complex.exp h - 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.doc:
/-- After `n` counter-clockwise turns the continued logarithm `iθ` at `θ = 2πn` is back over `z = 1`, with the
value `Log 1 + 2πin`: the continuation depends on the winding. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.statement:
theorem log_continuation_turns (n : ℕ) :
    Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ)) * I) = 1 ∧ ((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * I = Complex.log 1 + 2 * π * I * n

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- `z̄`, `Re z`, `|z|` and `|z|²` are holomorphic at no point. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement:
theorem nowhere_holomorphic (z : ℂ) :
    ¬ HolomorphicAt (fun w => conj w) z ∧ ¬ HolomorphicAt (fun w => (w.re : ℂ)) z ∧
      ¬ HolomorphicAt (fun w => (‖w‖ : ℂ)) z ∧ ¬ HolomorphicAt (fun w => w * conj w) z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc:
/-- Only `-a + √(a² - 1)` lies inside the unit circle: `|-a + √(a² - 1)| < 1 < |-a - √(a² - 1)|`
(the text: `-2 + √3 ≈ -0.27`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement:
theorem inside_root (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 < a) :
    |-a + Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 1)| < 1 ∧ 1 < |-a - Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 1)|

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- The Wick rotation identity for the propagator: `∫ dk⁰ h(k⁰) = i ∫ dk⁴ h(ik⁴)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement:
theorem wick_rotation_propagator (E δ : ℝ) (hE : 0 < E) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∫ k : ℝ, 1 / (((k : ℂ) - (E - δ * I)) * ((k : ℂ) - (-E + δ * I))) =
      I * ∫ k : ℝ, 1 / ((I * k - (E - δ * I)) * (I * k - (-E + δ * I)))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- `Re(i a t²) = -a r² sin 2φ` for `t = r(cos φ + i sin φ)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement:
theorem re_I_mul_sq (a r φ : ℝ) :
    (I * a * ((r : ℂ) * (Real.cos φ + Real.sin φ * I)) ^ 2).re = -a * r ^ 2 * Real.sin (2 * φ)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `u_y = -eˣ sin y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem exp_uy (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun y => Real.exp x * Real.cos y) y = -(Real.exp x * Real.sin y)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.statement:
theorem log_neg_one_values :
    Complex.log (-1) = π * I ∧ Complex.log (-1) + Complex.log (-1) ≠ Complex.log ((-1) ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- The real part of an entire function is harmonic on the whole plane. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement: theorem entire_re_harmonic (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (z : ℂ) : HarmonicAt (fun w => (f w).re) z

theorem normSq_laplacian (x y : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun x => deriv (fun x => x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) x) x + deriv (fun y => deriv (fun y => x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) y) y = 4

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement:
theorem cint_sq (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ) (hγ : ContDiff ℝ 1 γ) :
    cint (fun z => z ^ 2) γ a b = (γ b ^ 3 - γ a ^ 3) / 3

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.doc: /-- The exponent count `-(a - 1) - (b - 1) - 2 = -a - b`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement: theorem rational_exponent (a b : ℝ) : -(a - 1) - (b - 1) - 2 = -a - b

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- `|z|` is not complex differentiable at any `z ≠ 0` (else `|z|² = |z| |z|` would be). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem abs_not_differentiableAt (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (‖w‖ : ℂ)) z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- In the sector `0 ≤ arg t ≤ π/4`, `Re(iat²) = -a r² sin 2φ ≤ 0` (`a ≥ 0`): the arcs vanish there. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement:
theorem re_I_mul_sq_nonpos (a r φ : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (h0 : 0 ≤ φ) (h1 : φ ≤ π / 4) :
    -a * r ^ 2 * Real.sin (2 * φ) ≤ 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- The Jacobian `(2x, -2y; 2y, 2x)` of `z²` has determinant `4(x² + y²)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem sq_jac_det (x y : ℝ) : !![2 * x, -2 * y; 2 * y, 2 * x].det = 4 * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc: /-- A circle enclosing neither pole: `∮ = 0` by Cauchy's theorem (the text: `|z| = 1/2`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement:
theorem circle_neither (a b : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (ha : ρ < ‖a‖) (hb : ρ < ‖b‖) :
    (∮ z in C(0, ρ), 1 / ((z - a) * (z - b))) = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.doc: /-- The sum, product and quotient rules for the complex derivative. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement:
theorem rules (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (f' g' z : ℂ) (hf : HasDerivAt f f' z) (hg : HasDerivAt g g' z) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w => f w + g w) (f' + g') z ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun w => f w * g w) (f' * g z + f z * g') z ∧
      (g z ≠ 0 → HasDerivAt (fun w => f w / g w) ((f' * g z - f z * g') / g z ^ 2) z)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- The Euclidean Lagrangian of the field is non-negative: a sum of squares. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem euclidean_field_nonneg (φτ g m φ : ℝ) : 0 ≤ 1 / 2 * (φτ ^ 2 + g ^ 2 + m ^ 2 * φ ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.exp.doc: /-- `Res₀ e^{a/z} = a`, read from the series `e^{a/z} = ∑ aⁿ z⁻ⁿ/n!` (the text: `a = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.exp.statement: theorem exp_inv_residue (a : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) : residue (fun z => exp (a / z)) 0 ρ = a

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- The horizontal line `Im z = y₀` goes to the ray of argument `y₀` (`-π < y₀ ≤ π`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem exp_horizontal_ray (x y₀ : ℝ) (h₁ : -π < y₀) (h₂ : y₀ ≤ π) : arg (Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) + y₀ * I)) = y₀

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement:
theorem circle_zpow (n : ℤ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∮ z in C(0, R), z ^ n) = if n = -1 then 2 * π * I else 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement:
theorem cif_exp (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∮ z in C(0, R), exp z / z) = 2 * π * I ∧ (∮ z in C(0, R), exp z / z ^ 2) = 2 * π * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- `(k⁴)² + E²` never vanishes for `E ≠ 0`: Euclidean propagators need no `iε`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem euclidean_denominator_pos (k E : ℝ) (hE : E ≠ 0) : 0 < k ^ 2 + E ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.doc: /-- Just below the negative real axis the principal argument tends to `-π`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.statement:
theorem arg_tendsto_below (z : ℂ) (hre : z.re < 0) (him : z.im = 0) :
    Tendsto arg (𝓝[{w : ℂ | w.im < 0}] z) (𝓝 (-π))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- Along the positive real axis `e^{a/x} → ∞` (`a > 0`; the text: `a = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement:
theorem exp_div_pos_axis (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (a / x)) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `v_x = eˣ sin y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem exp_vx (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => Real.exp x * Real.sin y) x = Real.exp x * Real.sin y

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.doc: /-- `J = eˣ (cos y, -sin y; sin y, cos y)`: the Jacobian of `eᶻ` is `eˣ` times the rotation by `y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.statement:
theorem exp_jac_factor (x y : ℝ) :
    !![Real.exp x * Real.cos y, -(Real.exp x * Real.sin y); Real.exp x * Real.sin y, Real.exp x * Real.cos y] =
      !![Real.exp x, 0; 0, Real.exp x] * !![Real.cos y, -Real.sin y; Real.sin y, Real.cos y]

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.no_.doc:
/-- `0` is a branch point of `log`: no continuous `f` on `ℂ ∖ {0}` has `e^{f z} = z` everywhere (following `ln|z| + iθ`
once around the circle would have to increase it by `2πi`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.no_.statement: theorem no_log_branch (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : ContinuousOn f {0}ᶜ) : ¬ ∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 → Complex.exp (f z) = z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.cir.statement:
theorem circle_separates (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    (sphere z₀ r)ᶜ = ball z₀ r ∪ (closedBall z₀ r)ᶜ ∧ Bornology.IsBounded (ball z₀ r) ∧
      ¬ Bornology.IsBounded (closedBall z₀ r)ᶜ

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourWorke.statement:
theorem integral_exp_int (k : ℤ) :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..2 * π, exp (k * t * I) = if k = 0 then (2 * π : ℂ) else 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.seg.statement: theorem seg_length (z₁ z₂ : ℂ) : length (seg z₁ z₂) 0 1 = ‖z₂ - z₁‖

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem sinh_def_claim (z : ℂ) : Complex.sinh z = (Complex.exp z - Complex.exp (-z)) / 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.doc: /-- Every non-zero complex number has exactly two square roots, `w` and `-w ≠ w`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement:
theorem two_square_roots (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w : ℂ, w ^ 2 = z ∧ w ≠ -w ∧ ∀ u : ℂ, u ^ 2 = z → u = w ∨ u = -w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- `cos π = -1` and `sin π = 0`, so `cos π + i sin π = -1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem cos_sin_pi : Real.cos π = -1 ∧ Real.sin π = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- `u_xx = 2` for `u = x² + y²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement: theorem normSq_uxx (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => deriv (fun x => x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) x) x = 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement: theorem im_eq (x y : ℝ) : ((x : ℂ) + y * I - (x - y * I)) / (2 * I) = y

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement: theorem deriv_exp (z : ℂ) : deriv Complex.exp z = Complex.exp z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement: theorem cos_div_outside (R : ℝ) (hR0 : 0 ≤ R) (hR : R < π) : (∮ z in C(0, R), cos z / (z - π)) = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.statement:
theorem regularised_sum_one_claim (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * Real.exp (-ε * n)) (Real.exp ε / (Real.exp ε - 1) ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc:
/-- A Möbius map with `c ≠ 0` is a composition of affine maps and the inversion `w ↦ 1/w`:
`(az + b)/(cz + d) = a/c + (bc - ad)/(c (cz + d))`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement:
theorem mobius_decomposition (a b c d z : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hz : c * z + d ≠ 0) :
    (a * z + b) / (c * z + d) = a / c + (b * c - a * d) / (c * (c * z + d))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement: theorem sq_norm_eq (x y : ℝ) : ‖(x : ℂ) + y * I‖ ^ 2 = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.doc:
/-- `ℂ` admits no order compatible with its arithmetic: there is no set `P` of "positive" numbers closed under sums
and products, not containing `0`, with every non-zero `a` or its negative in `P` (`i²` and `1²` would both be
positive, and so would their sum `0`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement:
theorem no_positive_cone (P : Set ℂ) :
    ¬ ((∀ a ∈ P, ∀ b ∈ P, a + b ∈ P) ∧ (∀ a ∈ P, ∀ b ∈ P, a * b ∈ P) ∧
      (∀ a : ℂ, a ≠ 0 → a ∈ P ∨ -a ∈ P) ∧ (0 : ℂ) ∉ P)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement:
theorem trig_residue_value :
    2 / (I * (2 * (Real.sqrt 3 : ℂ))) = 1 / (I * (Real.sqrt 3 : ℂ)) ∧
      2 * π * I * (1 / (I * (Real.sqrt 3 : ℂ))) = 2 * π / (Real.sqrt 3 : ℂ)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_growth (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ z, ‖f z‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ n) (k : ℕ) (hk : n < k) : iteratedDeriv k f 0 = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- `u_xx = eˣ cos y` for `u = eˣ cos y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem exp_uxx (x y : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun x => deriv (fun x => Real.exp x * Real.cos y) x) x = Real.exp x * Real.cos y

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc:
/-- The Fresnel integral as the `iε`-regularised limit: `∫ e^{i(a + iε)t²} dt → e^{iπ/4}√(π/a)` as `ε → 0⁺` (`a > 0`),
from the complex Gaussian `gaussian_i_eps` at `(2a, 2ε)` and its limit `gaussian_i_eps_limit`. (The improper Riemann
integral `lim_{R→∞} ∫_{-R}^{R} e^{iat²} dt` is not in mathlib.) -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement:
theorem fresnel_regularised (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ∫ t : ℝ, Complex.exp (I * (a + ε * I) * (t : ℂ) ^ 2)) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 (Complex.exp (π * I / 4) * (√(π / a) : ℝ)))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- `|e^{(i/2)(a + iε)x²}| = e^{-εx²/2}`: the `iε` makes the integral absolutely convergent. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement:
theorem norm_gaussian_i_eps (a ε x : ℝ) :
    ‖Complex.exp (I / 2 * (a + ε * I) * (x : ℂ) ^ 2)‖ = Real.exp (-(ε * x ^ 2) / 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement: theorem deriv_inv (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) : deriv recip z = -(recip z) ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.circ.doc: /-- The unit circle is closed under multiplication and inversion. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- Two harmonic conjugates of `u` on a connected open set differ by a constant. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem conjugate_unique (u v₁ v₂ : ℂ → ℝ) (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hc : IsPreconnected U)
    (h₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => (u z : ℂ) + v₁ z * I) U)
    (h₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => (u z : ℂ) + v₂ z * I) U) :
    ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ U, v₁ z - v₂ z = v₁ w - v₂ w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- The strip `0 < Im z < π` is mapped onto the upper half-plane: `w` is an image iff `Im w > 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement:
theorem exp_strip_onto (w : ℂ) :
    (∃ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im ∧ z.im < π ∧ Complex.exp z = w) ↔ 0 < w.im

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.statement:
theorem cube_deriv_parts (x y : ℝ) :
    ((3 * (x ^ 2 - y ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((6 * x * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * I = 3 * ((x : ℂ) + y * I) ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- The values `e^{½(Log z + 2πik)}` of `z^{1/2}` are `±e^{½ Log z}` according to the parity of `k`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement:
theorem sqrt_values (z : ℂ) (k : ℤ) :
    Complex.exp ((Complex.log z + 2 * π * I * k) / 2) = (-1) ^ k * Complex.exp (Complex.log z / 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.doc:
/-- The coefficient formula, hence uniqueness: if `f = ∑ bₙ (z - c)ⁿ` converges absolutely on the circle
`|z - c| = ρ`, then `(2πi)⁻¹ ∮ (z - c)^(-m-1) f(z) dz = bₘ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.statement:
theorem laurent_coeff (c : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (b : ℤ → ℂ) (hb : Summable (fun n => ‖b n‖ * ρ ^ n))
    (m : ℤ) :
    (2 * π * I)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(c, ρ), (z - c) ^ (-m - 1) * ∑' n, b n * (z - c) ^ n) = b m

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.pr.statement:
theorem propagator_abs (E t : ℝ) :
    (0 < t → Complex.exp (-I * E * t) = Complex.exp (-I * E * |t|)) ∧
      (t < 0 → Complex.exp (I * E * t) = Complex.exp (-I * E * |t|))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement:
theorem mean_value_re (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c r)) :
    (f c).re = (2 * π)⁻¹ * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..2 * π, (f (circleMap c r t)).re

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement: theorem conj_mul_self (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) : (starRingEnd ℂ) z * z = 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.doc: /-- For `|z|²` the equations `u_x = v_y`, `u_y = -v_x` read `2x = 0`, `2y = 0`: they hold only at `z = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.statement: theorem normSq_cr_iff (x y : ℝ) : (2 * x = 0 ∧ 2 * y = -0) ↔ (x = 0 ∧ y = 0)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.doc: /-- An identity between entire functions that holds on the real axis holds on `ℂ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.statement:
theorem entire_eq_of_eq_on_real (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (hg : Differentiable ℂ g)
    (h : ∀ x : ℝ, f x = g x) : f = g

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.doc: /-- `cos² z + sin² z = 1` for every complex `z`, continued from the real identity. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.statement: theorem cos_sq_add_sin_sq (z : ℂ) : Complex.cos z ^ 2 + Complex.sin z ^ 2 = 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.inne.doc: /-- `⟨z, z⟩ = Re(z z̄) = |z|²`: the modulus is the norm of the Euclidean inner product. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- At a pole of order `m ≥ 1`, `|f(z)| → ∞` as `z → z₀`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement:
theorem tendsto_norm_of_pole (g : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hg : ContinuousAt g c)
    (hgc : g c ≠ 0) : Tendsto (fun z => ‖g z / (z - c) ^ m‖) (𝓝[≠] c) atTop

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- `(z - a)/(z + b) → 1` as `|z| → ∞` (for the Cayley map `a = b = i`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement:
theorem tendsto_mobius_infty (a b : ℂ) :
    Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => (z - a) / (z + b)) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.doc: /-- The arguments of `z ≠ 0` are exactly the `Arg z + 2πk`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.statement:
theorem arguments_iff (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (θ : ℝ) :
    (‖z‖ : ℂ) * (Complex.cos θ + Complex.sin θ * I) = z ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, θ = arg z + 2 * π * k

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- The rotation to Euclidean signature: with `k⁰ = ik⁴`, `(k⁰)² - 𝐤² = -((k⁴)² + 𝐤²)` (`ksq` standing for `𝐤²`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem euclidean_square (k4 ksq : ℂ) : (I * k4) ^ 2 - ksq = -(k4 ^ 2 + ksq)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement: theorem integral_cos_div (k : ℝ) : ∫ x : ℝ, Real.cos (k * x) / (1 + x ^ 2) = π * Real.exp (-|k|)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.exp.doc: /-- `Res₀ e^{az}/z² = (d/dz) e^{az} |₀ = a`, a pole of order `2` (the text: `a = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.exp.statement: theorem exp_div_sq_residue (a : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) : residue (fun z => exp (a * z) / z ^ 2) 0 ρ = a

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem quartic_factor (z : ℂ) : z ^ 4 - 1 = (z ^ 2 + 1) * (z ^ 2 - 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement: theorem card_roots (p : ℂ[X]) : p.roots.card = p.natDegree

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.doc: /-- As `δ → 0⁺` the opposite prescription gives `2πi/(2E) = iπ/E`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement:
theorem propagator_opposite_limit (E : ℝ) (hE : 0 < E) :
    Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => 2 * π * I / (2 * E + 2 * δ * I)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (π * I / E))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- The set identity: `Log z + Log w` is a logarithm of `zw`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement:
theorem log_add_is_log (z w : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    Complex.exp (Complex.log z + Complex.log w) = z * w

theorem log_sum_failure :
    Complex.log (-1) + Complex.log (-1) = 2 * π * I ∧ Complex.log ((-1) * (-1)) = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.sqr.doc:
/-- Along `z = e^{iθ}` the continuous choice `√z = e^{iθ/2}` returns to `e^{iπ} = -1` after one turn and to `1`
after two. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.sqr.statement: theorem sqrt_monodromy : Complex.exp ((2 * π : ℝ) / 2 * I) = -1 ∧ Complex.exp ((4 * π : ℝ) / 2 * I) = 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement:
theorem growth_eventually (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (n : ℕ) (C R : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ z, R ≤ ‖z‖ → ‖f z‖ ≤ C * ‖z‖ ^ n) :
    ∃ p : ℂ[X], p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ ∀ z, f z = p.eval z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement: theorem mul_conj_coords (x y : ℝ) : ((x : ℂ) + y * I) * (x - y * I) = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.doc:
/-- The identity theorem: two functions holomorphic on a connected open set `U` that agree on a set accumulating at
a point `z₀ ∈ U` agree on `U`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.statement:
theorem identity_theorem (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hc : IsPreconnected U)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g U) (z₀ : ℂ) (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ U)
    (h : ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] z₀, f z = g z) : EqOn f g U

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem sq_sub_one_factor (z : ℂ) : z ^ 2 - 1 = (z - 1) * (z + 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.statement: theorem arg_values : arg 1 = 0 ∧ arg I = π / 2 ∧ arg (-1) = π ∧ arg (-I) = -(π / 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.pol.doc: /-- The polar form `z = |z|(cos Arg z + i sin Arg z)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.pol.statement: theorem polar_form (z : ℂ) : (‖z‖ : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (arg z) + Complex.sin (arg z) * I) = z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- The root test: `R = liminf 1 / |aₙ|^(1/n)`, i.e. `1/R = limsup |aₙ|^(1/n)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem radius_eq_liminf (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    radius a = liminf (fun n => 1 / ((‖a n‖₊ ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞)) atTop

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.sim.doc: /-- At a simple pole, `f = r/(z - z₀) + g` near `z₀` with `g` holomorphic: the residue is `r = lim (z - z₀) f(z)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.sim.statement:
theorem simple_pole (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ r : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (closedBall z₀ ρ))
    (hf : ∀ z ∈ closedBall z₀ ρ, z ≠ z₀ → f z = r / (z - z₀) + g z) :
    residue f z₀ ρ = r ∧ Tendsto (fun z => (z - z₀) * f z) (𝓝[≠] z₀) (𝓝 r)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.re_m.doc: /-- `Re(z w̄) = xu + yv` is the Euclidean dot product. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.re_m.statement:
theorem re_mul_conj_dot (x y u v : ℝ) :
    (((x : ℂ) + y * I) * conj ((u : ℂ) + v * I)).re = x * u + y * v

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.doc: /-- The principal argument lies in `(-π, π]`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.statement: theorem arg_mem_Ioc_claim (z : ℂ) : -π < arg z ∧ arg z ≤ π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- On the upper arc (`Im k ≥ 0`) the factor `e^{-ik⁰t}` is bounded by `1` for `t ≤ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem exp_factor_bounded (k : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≤ 0) (hk : 0 ≤ k.im) : ‖Complex.exp (-I * k * t)‖ ≤ 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.ell.statement: theorem ellipse_ccw_identity (c s : ℝ) (h : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) : 2 * c * c + s * (2 * s) = 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.cir.statement:
theorem circle_clockwise (z₀ : ℂ) (r t : ℝ) :
    reverse (circleMap z₀ r) 0 (2 * π) t = z₀ + r * exp (-(t * I))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc: /-- The roots of `z² + 2az + 1` are `-a ± √(a² - 1)` (the text: `a = 2`, `-2 ± √3`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement:
theorem quadratic_roots (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) :
    (-a + Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 1)) ^ 2 + 2 * a * (-a + Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 1)) + 1 = 0 ∧
      (-a - Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 1)) ^ 2 + 2 * a * (-a - Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 1)) + 1 = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- The bound `πR/(2(R² - M))` tends to `0` as `R → ∞`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem arc_bound_tendsto (M : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun R : ℝ => π * R / (2 * (R ^ 2 - M))) atTop (𝓝 0)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.cir.statement: theorem circle_deriv (z₀ : ℂ) (r t : ℝ) : deriv (circleMap z₀ r) t = I * r * exp (t * I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.res.doc:
/-- For `ρ > |a|, |b|` the large circle integral of `1/((z - a)(z - b))` vanishes: the residue at infinity is `0`,
and `1/(a - b) + 1/(b - a) + 0 = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.res.statement:
theorem residue_infinity_two_poles (a b : ℂ) (hab : a ≠ b) (ρ : ℝ) (ha : ‖a‖ < ρ) (hb : ‖b‖ < ρ) :
    -residue (fun z => 1 / ((z - a) * (z - b))) 0 ρ = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourWorke.statement:
theorem prp_zpow (n : ℤ) (_hn : n ∈ Finset.Icc (-3 : ℤ) 3) :
    (∮ z in C(0, 1), z ^ n) = if n = -1 then 2 * π * I else 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement: theorem exp_reflect_neg (θ : ℝ) : exp (-(θ * I)) + exp (-(((π - θ : ℝ)) * I)) = -2 * Real.sin θ * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.doc:
/-- The derivative of the inverse: if `f'(z₀) ≠ 0` and `g` is a continuous local inverse at `w₀ = f(z₀)`, then
`g'(w₀) = 1/f'(z₀)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.statement:
theorem inverse_deriv (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (f' w₀ : ℂ) (hg : ContinuousAt g w₀) (hf : HasDerivAt f f' (g w₀))
    (hf' : f' ≠ 0) (hfg : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 w₀, f (g w) = w) : HasDerivAt g f'⁻¹ w₀

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.statement:
theorem regularised_sum_zero (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (-ε * ((n : ℝ) + 1))) (1 / (Real.exp ε - 1))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- If `f`, `g` are holomorphic on an open `D`, so are `f + g` and `fg`, with `(fg)' = f'g + fg'`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement:
theorem holo_add_mul (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U)
    (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g U) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => f z + g z) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => f z * g z) U ∧
      ∀ z ∈ U, deriv (fun w => f w * g w) z = deriv f z * g z + f z * deriv g z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `v_x = 2xy/(x² + y²)²` for `v = -y/(x² + y²)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem inv_vx (x y : ℝ) (h : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    deriv (fun x => -y / (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) x = 2 * x * y / (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement:
theorem mean_value (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c r)) :
    f c = ((2 * π)⁻¹ : ℝ) • ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..2 * π, f (circleMap c r t)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- The Euclidean integral `∫ dk/(k² + E²) = π/E` for `E > 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem euclidean_integral (E : ℝ) (hE : 0 < E) : ∫ k : ℝ, 1 / (k ^ 2 + E ^ 2) = π / E

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.statement:
theorem annulus_region (z : ℂ) (hz1 : 1 < ‖z‖) (hz2 : ‖z‖ < 2) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => -(z ^ n / 2 ^ (n + 1)) - z⁻¹ ^ (n + 1)) (1 / ((z - 1) * (z - 2)))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc:
/-- `ln |z - c|` has no harmonic conjugate on the whole punctured plane `ℂ ∖ {c}`: a holomorphic `F` there with
`Re F = ln |z - c|` would differ from `Log(z - c)` by a constant on the slit plane, and so jump by `2πi` across the
cut, against its continuity. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem no_global_log_conjugate (c : ℂ) :
    ¬ ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ F {c}ᶜ ∧ ∀ z ≠ c, (F z).re = Real.log ‖z - c‖

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement: theorem prod_neg_range (n : ℕ) : ∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((k : ℤ) - n) = (-1) ^ n * n !

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc: /-- The circle `|z - b| = r` around `b` only: `∮ = 2πi/(b - a)` (the text: `|z - 2| = 1/2`, `2πi`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement:
theorem circle_around_b (a b : ℂ) (hab : a ≠ b) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hr' : r < ‖a - b‖) :
    (∮ z in C(b, r), 1 / ((z - a) * (z - b))) = 2 * π * I / (b - a)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement:
theorem factor_root (p : ℂ[X]) (z : ℂ) (hz : p.IsRoot z) :
    (X - C z) * (p /ₘ (X - C z)) = p ∧ (p /ₘ (X - C z)).natDegree = p.natDegree - 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- `e^z = ∑ zⁿ/n!` for every `z`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem exp_series (z : ℂ) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => z ^ n / n.factorial) (Complex.exp z)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `diag(1, -1)` is not a rotation-scaling `(a, -b; b, a)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem conj_jac_not_rotation (a b : ℝ) : !![(1 : ℝ), 0; 0, -1] ≠ !![a, -b; b, a]

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.doc:
/-- The trigonometric form `B(a, b) = 2∫₀^{π/2} sin^{2a-1}θ cos^{2b-1}θ dθ` at `a = b = 1/2`: `B(1/2, 1/2) = 2∫₀^{π/2} dθ
= π`. (The general form, a substitution in an improper integral with real powers, is not formalised.) -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement:
theorem beta_half_half_trig :
    (betaIntegral (1 / 2) (1 / 2)).re =
      2 * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sin θ ^ (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1) * Real.cos θ ^ (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement:
theorem cauchy_estimate (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R M : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R)) (hM : ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, ‖f z‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv n f c‖ ≤ n.factorial * M / R ^ n

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.statement: theorem not_summable_pow (k : ℕ) : ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.de_.doc: /-- De Moivre's formula `(cos θ + i sin θ)ⁿ = cos nθ + i sin nθ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.de_.statement:
theorem de_moivre (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (Complex.cos θ + Complex.sin θ * I) ^ n = Complex.cos (n * θ) + Complex.sin (n * θ) * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.doc: /-- The numerator `-z² + 2z + 1` vanishes at `1 + s` and `1 - s` for `s² = 2`, that is at `1 ± √2`. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.doc: /-- By the inverse rule `Log' w = 1/e^{Log w} = 1/w` on the slit plane. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.statement: theorem log_deriv_by_inverse (w : ℂ) (hw : w ∈ slitPlane) : HasDerivAt Complex.log w⁻¹ w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.doc: /-- For real `s > 0` the alternating series `∑ (-1)ⁿ/(n + 1)^s` converges (its partial sums have a limit). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.statement:
theorem alternating_converges (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∃ l : ℝ, Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (-1) ^ n * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ s)) atTop (𝓝 l)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem sq_parts (x y : ℝ) : ((x : ℂ) + y * I) ^ 2 = ((x ^ 2 - y ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * x * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- For real `x`, `|x - i|² = x² + 1 = |x + i|²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement:
theorem real_axis_equidistant (x : ℝ) :
    Complex.normSq ((x : ℂ) - I) = x ^ 2 + 1 ∧ Complex.normSq ((x : ℂ) + I) = x ^ 2 + 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- `Log(zw) = Log z + Log w` exactly when `Arg z + Arg w ∈ (-π, π]`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement:
theorem log_mul_iff (z w : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    Complex.log (z * w) = Complex.log z + Complex.log w ↔ arg z + arg w ∈ Set.Ioc (-π) π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.doc: /-- The sum of the six roots is `0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.statement: theorem sum_roots : ∑ k ∈ range 6, ω ^ k = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.rat.doc: /-- The order-`2` formula at `a`: `(d/dz) (z² + 1)/z |_a = 1 - 1/a²` (the text: `0` at `a = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.rat.statement: theorem rational_deriv (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) : deriv (fun z : ℂ => (z ^ 2 + 1) / z) a = 1 - 1 / a ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- At `z₀ = 1 + i`: `f'(z₀) = 2(1 + i)` sends the tangents `1` and `i` to `2 + 2i` and `-2 + 2i`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem tangent_images : 2 * (1 + I) * 1 = 2 + 2 * I ∧ 2 * (1 + I) * I = -2 + 2 * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem sq_vy (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun y => 2 * x * y) y = 2 * x

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- `u_x = 3x² - 3y²` for `u = x³ - 3xy²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement: theorem cube_ux (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => x ^ 3 - 3 * x * y ^ 2) x = 3 * x ^ 2 - 3 * y ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.doc: /-- For `-π < θ < π` the lift `e^{iθ/2}` is the principal square root of `e^{iθ}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.statement:
theorem sqrt_lift_principal (θ : ℝ) (h₁ : -π < θ) (h₂ : θ < π) :
    Complex.exp (θ * I) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) = Complex.exp (θ * I / 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.doc: /-- On the right half-plane `Arg z = arctan(Im z / Re z)`; for instance `Arg(2 + i) = arctan(1/2)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.statement: theorem arg_eq_arctan (z : ℂ) (h : 0 < z.re) : arg z = Real.arctan (z.im / z.re)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement: theorem integral_inv_fourth (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : ∫ x : ℝ, 1 / (a ^ 4 + x ^ 4) = π / (Real.sqrt 2 * a ^ 3)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.sem.statement: theorem semicircle_left (R t : ℝ) : (I * deriv (seg (-R) R) t).im = 2 * R

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.doc: /-- `sin z ≠ 0` on `0 < |z| < π`: the punctured disc on which the expansion of `1/sin z` holds. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.statement: theorem sin_ne_zero_of_lt_pi (z : ℂ) (h0 : z ≠ 0) (hπ : ‖z‖ < π) : sin z ≠ 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.doc: /-- The radial integral `∫₀^∞ r^{n-1} e^{-r²} dr = Γ(n/2)/2`, `n ≥ 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement:
theorem radial_gaussian (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∫ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), r ^ (n - 1) * Real.exp (-r ^ 2) = Real.Gamma ((n : ℝ) / 2) / 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement:
theorem const_of_sqrt_growth (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (C : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ z, ‖f z‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt ‖z‖) (z w : ℂ) : f z = f w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- With the opposite sign `-iε` the roots of `c² = E² + iε` lie in the first and third quadrants. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement:
theorem pole_quadrants_conj (M ε : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hε : 0 < ε) (c : ℂ) (hc : c ^ 2 = M + ε * I) :
    (0 < c.re ∧ 0 < c.im) ∨ (c.re < 0 ∧ c.im < 0)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc:
/-- The derivatives of `u = rⁿ cos nθ` (`n ∈ ℤ`, `r ≠ 0`): `u_r = n rⁿ⁻¹ cos nθ`, `u_rr = n(n - 1) rⁿ⁻² cos nθ`,
`u_θθ = -n² rⁿ cos nθ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem rn_cos_derivs (n : ℤ) (r θ : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    deriv (fun r => r ^ n * Real.cos (n * θ)) r = n * r ^ (n - 1) * Real.cos (n * θ) ∧
      deriv (fun r => deriv (fun r => r ^ n * Real.cos (n * θ)) r) r =
        n * (n - 1) * r ^ (n - 2) * Real.cos (n * θ) ∧
      deriv (fun θ => deriv (fun θ => r ^ n * Real.cos (n * θ)) θ) θ = -(n ^ 2 * r ^ n * Real.cos (n * θ))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.doc: /-- The product of the six roots is `-1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.statement: theorem prod_roots : ∏ k ∈ range 6, ω ^ k = -1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- So `|f(x)| = 1`: the real axis goes into the unit circle. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem real_axis_to_circle (x : ℝ) : ‖((x : ℂ) - I) / ((x : ℂ) + I)‖ = 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- The inversion maps generalised circles to generalised circles: `gcircle A B C (1/z) = gcircle C B̄ A z / |z|²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement:
theorem inversion_gcircle (A : ℝ) (B : ℂ) (C : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    gcircle A B C z⁻¹ = gcircle C (conj B) A z / Complex.normSq z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc:
/-- The Gaussian with an `iε`: `∫ e^{(i/2)(a + iε)x²} dx = (2π/(ε - ia))^{1/2}` for `ε > 0` (absolutely convergent),
with `2π/(ε - ia) = (2π/(ε² + a²))(ε + ia)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement:
theorem gaussian_i_eps (a ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (I / 2 * (a + ε * I) * (x : ℂ) ^ 2) =
      (((2 * π / (ε ^ 2 + a ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (ε + a * I)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `2z = 2x + i 2y`: the Jacobian of `z²` is the matrix of multiplication by `2z` (`mul_parts`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem two_z_parts (x y : ℝ) : 2 * ((x : ℂ) + y * I) = ((2 * x : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- The mean value property of harmonic functions (the real part of the previous one). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem harmonic_mean_value (u : ℂ → ℝ) (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hu : HarmonicOnNhd u (closedBall z₀ |r|)) :
    circleAverage u z₀ r = u z₀

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem cayley_values : (I - I) / (I + I) = 0 ∧ (0 - I) / (0 + I) = -1 ∧ (1 - I) / (1 + I) = -I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.len.statement: theorem length_reverse (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ) : length (reverse γ a b) a b = length γ a b

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.statement: theorem exp_two_mul (x : ℝ) : Real.exp (2 * x) = Real.exp x ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- The logarithmic series diverges for `|z| > 1`: its radius is `1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem not_summable_log (z : ℂ) (hz : 1 < ‖z‖) :
    ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => (-1) ^ (n + 1) * z ^ n / n)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `eᶻ = eˣ cos y + i eˣ sin y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem exp_parts (x y : ℝ) :
    Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) + y * I) = ((Real.exp x * Real.cos y : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.exp x * Real.sin y : ℝ) : ℂ) * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.doc: /-- `1/Γ(z) = Γ(1 - z) sin(πz)/π`, i.e. `Γ(z) · (Γ(1 - z) sin πz) = π`, for `z ∉ ℤ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement:
theorem inv_gamma_reflection (z : ℂ) (hz : ∀ m : ℤ, z ≠ m) :
    Complex.Gamma z * (Complex.Gamma (1 - z) * Complex.sin (π * z)) = π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement: theorem conj_coords (x y : ℝ) : conj ((x : ℂ) + y * I) = x - y * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.doc: /-- The opposite prescription, multiplied out: `(2E + 2iδ) ∫ dk/((k - (E + iδ))(k - (-E - iδ))) = 2πi`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement:
theorem propagator_opposite (E δ : ℝ) (hE : 0 < E) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (2 * E + 2 * δ * I) * ∫ k : ℝ, 1 / (((k : ℂ) - (E + δ * I)) * ((k : ℂ) - (-E - δ * I))) = 2 * π * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- The logarithms of `-1` are `iπ(2k + 1)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement: theorem logs_neg_one (w : ℂ) : Complex.exp w = -1 ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, w = π * I * (2 * k + 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc:
/-- Sums and products of holomorphic functions are holomorphic, and so are quotients off the zeros of the
denominator. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement:
theorem closure_ops (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g U) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => f z + g z) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => f z * g z) U ∧
      ((∀ z ∈ U, g z ≠ 0) → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => f z / g z) U)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- The Cayley map sends the upper half-plane into the unit disc. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem cayley_disc (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) : ‖(z - I) / (z + I)‖ < 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem exp_one_add_pi_I : Complex.exp (1 + π * I) = -Complex.exp 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement: theorem cos_div_inside (R : ℝ) (hR : π < R) : (∮ z in C(0, R), cos z / (z - π)) = -(2 * π * I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- `|cos z|` is not bounded by `1`: on the imaginary axis it exceeds any bound. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem cos_unbounded (M : ℝ) : ∃ y : ℝ, M < ‖Complex.cos (y * I)‖

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.doc: /-- The Euler integral converges absolutely exactly when `Re z > 0` (near `0` it behaves like `t^{Re z - 1}`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.statement:
theorem gamma_integral_integrable_iff (z : ℂ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ (z - 1) * Complex.exp (-t)) (Ioi 0) ↔ 0 < z.re

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem conj_ux (x : ℝ) : deriv (fun x : ℝ => x) x = 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement: theorem cube_uyy (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun y => deriv (fun y => x ^ 3 - 3 * x * y ^ 2) y) y = -6 * x

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.no_.doc: /-- `0` is a branch point of `√z`: no continuous `f` on `ℂ ∖ {0}` has `f(z)² = z` everywhere. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.no_.statement: theorem no_sqrt_branch (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : ContinuousOn f {0}ᶜ) : ¬ ∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 → f z ^ 2 = z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc:
/-- The Fourier transform of `1/(1 + x²)`: `∫ e^{ikx}/(1 + x²) dx = π e^{-|k|}` (by Fourier inversion of
`e^{-|t|}`, whose transform is `2/(1 + 4π²w²)`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement:
theorem fourier_inv_one_add_sq (k : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, exp (((k * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) / (1 + (x : ℂ) ^ 2)) = ((π * Real.exp (-|k|) : ℝ) : ℂ)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.statement: theorem cube_root_eq : Complex.exp (2 * π * I / 3) = -1 / 2 + √3 / 2 * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem sq_add_one_factor (z : ℂ) : z ^ 2 + 1 = (z - I) * (z + I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- `tan z = sin z/cos z` is holomorphic where `cos z ≠ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem tan_differentiableAt (z : ℂ) (h : Complex.cos z ≠ 0) : DifferentiableAt ℂ Complex.tan z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.doc: /-- Over `ℚ(ω)` with `ω² + ω + 1 = 0`, `z⁶ - 1` splits into six linear factors `(z ∓ 1)(z ∓ ω)(z ∓ ω²)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.statement:
theorem split_over_eisenstein {K : Type*} [Field K] (ω₃ z : K) (h : ω₃ ^ 2 + ω₃ + 1 = 0) :
    z ^ 6 - 1 = (z - 1) * (z + 1) * (z - ω₃) * (z + ω₃) * (z - ω₃ ^ 2) * (z + ω₃ ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- Under the Cauchy-Riemann equations `∂_z f = ½[(u_x + v_y) + i(v_x - u_y)] = u_x + i v_x = f'`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem wirtinger_z (a b c d : ℝ) (h1 : a = d) (h2 : b = -c) :
    (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (((a : ℂ) + c * I) - I * ((b : ℂ) + d * I)) = (a : ℂ) + c * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc:
/-- `(z² + 1)/(z (z - a)²)`, `a ≠ 0`, `a² ≠ -1`, has a simple pole at `0` and a pole of order `2` at `a`
(the text: `a = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement:
theorem rational_poles (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ha' : a ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) :
    IsPoleOfOrder (fun z => (z ^ 2 + 1) / (z * (z - a) ^ 2)) 0 1 ∧
      IsPoleOfOrder (fun z => (z ^ 2 + 1) / (z * (z - a) ^ 2)) a 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc:
/-- The residue theorem on a circle: for `f = ∑ᵢ cᵢ/(z - wᵢ)^(kᵢ+1) + g` with the poles `wᵢ` inside the circle and
`g` holomorphic on the closed disc, `∮ f = 2πi ∑ Res`, where the residue at `wᵢ` collects the `cᵢ` with `kᵢ = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement:
theorem residue_theorem_circle {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (C : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (w c : ι → ℂ) (k : ι → ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, w i ∈ ball C ρ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (closedBall C ρ)) :
    (∮ z in C(C, ρ), ((∑ i ∈ s, c i / (z - w i) ^ (k i + 1)) + g z)) =
      2 * π * I * ∑ i ∈ s, if k i = 0 then c i else 0
