KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement:
theorem poly_lower_bound (p : ℂ[X]) (hp : 0 < p.natDegree) (z : ℂ)
    (hz : max 1 (2 * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range p.natDegree, ‖p.coeff k‖) / ‖p.leadingCoeff‖) ≤ ‖z‖) :
    ‖p.leadingCoeff‖ * ‖z‖ ^ p.natDegree / 2 ≤ ‖p.eval z‖

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement:
theorem arc_denominator_bound (E ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (k : ℂ) :
    ‖k‖ ^ 2 - E ^ 2 - ε ≤ ‖k ^ 2 - E ^ 2 + ε * I‖

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- The three cube roots of `-8`: `z³ = -8` exactly for `z ∈ {1 + i√3, -2, 1 - i√3}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement:
theorem cube_roots_neg_eight (z : ℂ) :
    z ^ 3 = -8 ↔ z = 1 + √3 * I ∨ z = -2 ∨ z = 1 - √3 * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.doc: /-- Conjugation is real differentiable (a reflection of `ℝ²`) but complex differentiable nowhere. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement:
theorem conj_not_differentiableAt (z : ℂ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℂ => conj w) z ∧ ¬ DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => conj w) z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement:
theorem log_jump_end (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => log (exp (t * I) - a)) (𝓝[<] (2 * π)) (𝓝 (Real.log (a - 1) - π * I))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem cosh_def_claim (z : ℂ) : Complex.cosh z = (Complex.exp z + Complex.exp (-z)) / 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem mobius_deriv (z : ℂ) (hz : z + I ≠ 0) : deriv cayley z = cayleyDeriv z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.doc: /-- The reflection formula `Γ(z) Γ(1 - z) = π / sin πz`, i.e. `Γ(z) Γ(1 - z) sin πz = π` for `z ∉ ℤ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.statement:
theorem gamma_reflection (z : ℂ) (hz : ∀ n : ℤ, z ≠ n) :
    Complex.Gamma z * Complex.Gamma (1 - z) * Complex.sin (π * z) = π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement: theorem toMat_det (x y : ℝ) : Matrix.det !![x, -y; y, x] = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.apol.doc: /-- `|z - 1| = 2|z + 1|` exactly when `3x² + 3y² + 10x + 3 = 0`, the circle of centre `-5/3` and radius `4/3`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.apol.statement:
theorem apollonius (x y : ℝ) :
    ‖(x : ℂ) + y * I - 1‖ = 2 * ‖(x : ℂ) + y * I + 1‖ ↔ (x + 5 / 3) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = (4 / 3) ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.doc:
/-- `f'/f = 1/(z - 1) - 1/(z - i) - 1/(z + i)` for `f = (z - 1)/(z² + 1)` (cleared of denominators, with
`f' = (-z² + 2z + 1)/(z² + 1)²`): the logarithmic derivative has residue `+1` at the zero and `-1` at each pole. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc:
/-- `∮_{|z|=1} 2 dz/(i(z² + 2az + 1)) = 2π/√(a² - 1)` by the single enclosed pole `-a + √(a² - 1)`, and hence
`∫₀^{2π} dθ/(a + cos θ) = 2π/√(a² - 1)` for `a > 1` (the text: `a = 2`, `2π/√3`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement:
theorem trig_integral (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 < a) :
    (∮ z in C(0, 1), 2 / (I * (z ^ 2 + 2 * a * z + 1))) = ((2 * π / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
      ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), 1 / (a + Real.cos θ) = 2 * π / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- The inverse `z = i(1 + w)/(1 - w)`: `f(z(w)) = w`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem cayley_right_inv (w : ℂ) (hw : w ≠ 1) : (I * (1 + w) / (1 - w) - I) / (I * (1 + w) / (1 - w) + I) = w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.doc:
/-- Uniqueness of analytic continuation: two holomorphic functions on a connected open `D₂` that both agree with `f`
on a nonempty open `D₁ ⊆ D₂` agree on `D₂`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.statement:
theorem continuation_unique (D₁ D₂ : Set ℂ) (hD₂ : IsOpen D₂) (hc : IsPreconnected D₂) (hD₁ : IsOpen D₁)
    (hne : D₁.Nonempty) (hsub : D₁ ⊆ D₂) (f F G : ℂ → ℂ) (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F D₂)
    (hG : DifferentiableOn ℂ G D₂) (hFf : EqOn F f D₁) (hGf : EqOn G f D₁) : EqOn F G D₂

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement: theorem gamma_ratio_two_three : Real.Gamma 2 * Real.Gamma 3 / Real.Gamma 5 = 1 / 12

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement:
theorem one_sub_cos_series (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (-1) ^ n * z ^ (2 * n) / (Nat.factorial (2 * n + 4) : ℂ))
      (1 / (2 * z ^ 2) - (1 - cos z) / z ^ 4)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- `cos(iy) = cosh y` and `sin(iy) = i sinh y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement:
theorem cos_sin_imaginary (y : ℂ) :
    Complex.cos (y * I) = Complex.cosh y ∧ Complex.sin (y * I) = Complex.sinh y * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.doc: /-- A failure for principal values: `Arg((-1)/(-i)) = Arg(-i) = -π/2`, but `Arg(-1) - Arg(-i) = 3π/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.statement: theorem arg_div_failure : arg ((-1) / (-I)) = -(π / 2) ∧ arg (-1) - arg (-I) = 3 * π / 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement: theorem beta_two_three_integral : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x * (1 - x) ^ 2 = 1 / 12

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- As `ε → 0⁺`, `(2π/(ε - ia))^{1/2} → √(2π/a) e^{iπ/4}` (`a > 0`): the Fresnel value, principal branch. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement:
theorem gaussian_i_eps_limit (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (2 * π / (ε - a * I)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 ((√(2 * π / a) : ℝ) * Complex.exp (π * I / 4)))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- At a point `x < 0` of the cut, `Log` tends to `log |x| - πi` from below, while `Log x = log |x| + πi`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement:
theorem log_limit_below (x : ℝ) (hx : x < 0) :
    Tendsto Complex.log (𝓝[{z : ℂ | z.im < 0}] (x : ℂ)) (𝓝 (Real.log ‖(x : ℂ)‖ - π * I)) ∧
      (Complex.log x).im = π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement:
theorem cint_comp (f : ℂ → ℂ) (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hγ : Differentiable ℝ γ) (hγ' : Continuous (deriv γ)) (hφ : ∀ s, HasDerivAt φ (φ' s) s)
    (hφ'c : Continuous φ') : cint f (γ ∘ φ) c d = cint f γ (φ c) (φ d)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- The polar form `z = r e^{iθ}` with `r = |z|`, `θ = Arg z`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem polar_exp (z : ℂ) : (‖z‖ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (arg z * I) = z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.doc: /-- `Γ(1/4)Γ(3/4) = π/sin(π/4) = π√2`, by the reflection formula. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement: theorem gamma_quarter_product : Real.Gamma (1 / 4) * Real.Gamma (3 / 4) = π * √2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc:
/-- Riemann's theorem: a function holomorphic and bounded on a punctured neighbourhood of `c` extends
holomorphically to `c` (the singularity is removable). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement:
theorem removable_of_bounded (f : ℂ → ℂ) (s : Set ℂ) (c : ℂ) (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 c)
    (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (s \ {c})) (hb : BddAbove (norm ∘ f '' (s \ {c}))) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (update f c (limUnder (𝓝[≠] c) f)) s

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- The rotated integral, multiplied out: `(-2E + 2iδ) · i ∫ dk⁴ h(ik⁴) = 2πi`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement:
theorem propagator_rotated (E δ : ℝ) (hE : 0 < E) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (-2 * E + 2 * δ * I) * (I * ∫ k : ℝ, 1 / ((I * k - (E - δ * I)) * (I * k - (-E + δ * I)))) = 2 * π * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.doc: /-- `ℂ` is a field: every `z ≠ 0` has an inverse. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement: theorem mul_inv_of_ne_zero (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) : ∃ w : ℂ, z * w = 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- The zeros of `cos` are real. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem cos_zero_real (z : ℂ) (h : Complex.cos z = 0) : z.im = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.modu.statement: theorem moduli_values : ‖(3 : ℂ) + 4 * I‖ = 5 ∧ ‖I‖ = 1 ∧ ‖(2 : ℂ) + I‖ = √5

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- `u_x = 2x` for `u = x² + y²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement: theorem normSq_ux (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) x = 2 * x

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- Inside the disc of convergence the sum is holomorphic. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem differentiableOn_sum (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => ∑' n, a n * z ^ n) (Metric.eball 0 (radius a))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.res.doc: /-- The residue is the coefficient `a₋₁` of a Laurent series converging absolutely on the circle. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.res.statement:
theorem residue_eq_coeff (c : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (b : ℤ → ℂ) (hb : Summable (fun n => ‖b n‖ * ρ ^ n)) :
    residue (fun z => ∑' n, b n * (z - c) ^ n) c ρ = b (-1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement: theorem square_inv (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) : squareInt (fun z => z⁻¹) s = 2 * π * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc: /-- `cos z` grows like `e^{|Im z|}`: `|cos(iy)| = cosh y ≥ e^{|y|}/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement: theorem norm_cos_I_mul (y : ℝ) : ‖cos (y * I)‖ = Real.cosh y ∧ Real.exp |y| / 2 ≤ ‖cos (y * I)‖

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.doc:
/-- The simple pole at `s = 1` with residue `1`, approached along any direction `c ≠ 0`:
`(ct) ζ(1 + ct) → 1` as `t → 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.statement:
theorem zeta_residue_direction (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (c * t) * riemannZeta (1 + c * t)) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- The solutions of `e^z = 1 + i` are `z = ½ ln 2 + i(π/4 + 2πk)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement:
theorem exp_eq_one_add_I_iff (z : ℂ) :
    Complex.exp z = 1 + I ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, z = Real.log 2 / 2 + (π / 4 + 2 * π * k) * I
theorem cos_def_claim (z : ℂ) : Complex.cos z = (Complex.exp (z * I) + Complex.exp (-z * I)) / 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem hasSum_inv_sq_add_four (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ < 2) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (-1) ^ n * z ^ (2 * n) / 4 ^ (n + 1)) (1 / (z ^ 2 + 4))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.doc: /-- The telescoping sum `∑_{n < N} (qⁿ - qⁿ⁺¹) = 1 - q^N`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.statement: theorem geom_telescope (q : ℂ) (N : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (q ^ n - q ^ (n + 1)) = 1 - q ^ N

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement:
theorem fourier_contour_value (k : ℝ) :
    exp (I * k * I) = (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ) ∧ 2 * π * I * (exp (I * k * I) / (2 * I)) = π * (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.statement:
theorem regularised_sum_one (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * Real.exp (-ε * n)) (Real.exp (-ε) / (1 - Real.exp (-ε)) ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourWorke.statement:
theorem inv_sub_three_series (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ < 3) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => -(z ^ k / 3 ^ (k + 1))) (1 / (z - 3))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- `cos(z + w) = cos z cos w - sin z sin w` for complex `z, w`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem cos_add_claim (z w : ℂ) : Complex.cos (z + w) = Complex.cos z * Complex.cos w - Complex.sin z * Complex.sin w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.doc: /-- The quotient of `Re`: `Re(h)/h` is `1` along the real axis and `0` along the imaginary axis. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement:
theorem re_quot_axes (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ((t : ℂ).re : ℂ) / t = 1 ∧ (((t : ℂ) * I).re : ℂ) / (t * I) = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- `1 + z² = (z - i)(z + i)`: the poles of `1/(1 + z²)` are `±i`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement: theorem one_add_sq_factor (z : ℂ) : 1 + z ^ 2 = (z - I) * (z + I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.ke.doc:
/-- Solving the keyhole relation `(1 - e^{2πia}) I = -2πi e^{iπa}`: since `-2πi e^{iπa} sin πa = π(1 - e^{2πia})`,
`I = -2πi e^{iπa}/(1 - e^{2πia}) = π/sin πa` whenever `sin πa ≠ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.ke.statement:
theorem keyhole_solve (a : ℝ) :
    -2 * π * I * Complex.exp (π * I * a) * (Real.sin (π * a) : ℂ) = π * (1 - Complex.exp (2 * π * I * a))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement: theorem one_add_I_sq : (1 + I) ^ 2 = 2 * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement: theorem sin_vertical_unbounded (x M : ℝ) : ∃ y : ℝ, M < ‖sin (x + y * I)‖

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- The radius of convergence of the Taylor series is at least the radius of any disc of holomorphy. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem le_radius_taylor (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball c r)) :
    ENNReal.ofReal r ≤ radius (fun n => iteratedDeriv n f c / (Nat.factorial n : ℂ))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.doc: /-- `Γ(1/3) Γ(2/3) = π / sin(π/3) = 2π/√3`, by the reflection formula. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement:
theorem ml_bound (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 < R) :
    ‖∮ z in C(0, R), exp z / (z ^ 2 + 1)‖ ≤ 2 * π * R * (Real.exp R / (R ^ 2 - 1))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.exp.statement: theorem exp_reflect (θ : ℝ) : exp (θ * I) + exp (((π - θ : ℝ)) * I) = 2 * Real.sin θ * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- Inverting the first-order chain rule: `r u_x = r cos θ u_r - sin θ u_θ` and `r u_y = r sin θ u_r + cos θ u_θ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem polar_first (c s r p q : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    r * p = r * c * (c * p + s * q) - s * (-r * s * p + r * c * q) ∧
      r * q = r * s * (c * p + s * q) + c * (-r * s * p + r * c * q)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.quo.doc: /-- The quotient rule at a root `w⁴ = -1`: `(z - w)/(1 + z⁴) → 1/(4w³)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.quo.statement:
theorem quotient_fourth (w : ℂ) (hw : w ^ 4 = -1) :
    Tendsto (fun z => (z - w) * (1 / (1 + z ^ 4))) (𝓝[≠] w) (𝓝 (1 / (4 * w ^ 3)))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.quo.doc: /-- The quotient rule at a simple pole: `Res g/h = g(z₀)/h'(z₀)` when `h(z₀) = 0 ≠ h'(z₀)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.quo.statement:
theorem quotient_rule (g h : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ d : ℂ) (hh : h z₀ = 0) (hd : HasDerivAt h d z₀) (hd0 : d ≠ 0)
    (hg : ContinuousAt g z₀) : Tendsto (fun z => (z - z₀) * (g z / h z)) (𝓝[≠] z₀) (𝓝 (g z₀ / d))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement: theorem arc_pointwise (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 < R) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = R) : ‖1 / (1 + z ^ 2)‖ ≤ 1 / (R ^ 2 - 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- `Log` is not continuous at any point of the cut `(-∞, 0)`, hence not holomorphic there. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem log_not_continuousAt (x : ℝ) (hx : x < 0) : ¬ ContinuousAt Complex.log (x : ℂ)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- The images `(2, 2)` and `(-2, 2)` are orthogonal: `2·(-2) + 2·2 = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem tangent_images_orthogonal : (2 : ℝ) * (-2) + 2 * 2 = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement: theorem circle_inv_any (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (h : ‖c‖ < R) : (∮ z in C(c, R), z⁻¹) = 2 * π * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- A holomorphic function with real values on a connected open set is constant. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem real_valued_const (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hc : IsPreconnected U)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U) (hr : ∀ w ∈ U, (f w).im = 0) : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ U, f z = f w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- The particle: `i · (-i dτ) · (½ m (i x')² - V) = -(½ m x'² + V)`, i.e. `iS = -S_E`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem particle_rotation (m V xp : ℂ) : I * (-I) * (1 / 2 * m * (I * xp) ^ 2 - V) = -(1 / 2 * m * xp ^ 2 + V)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement:
theorem no_primitive_inv (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ¬ ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, HasDerivAt F (z - c)⁻¹ z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc:
/-- The rectangle with vertices `x₀ ± ih`, `x₁ ± ih`, `x₀ < 1 < 2 < x₁`, encloses both poles of
`1/((z - 1)(z - 2))`: its boundary integral is `0` (the text: `x₀ = 0.5`, `x₁ = 2.5`, `h = 1`). -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- `1/(z² - 1)` is holomorphic on `ℂ ∖ {1, -1}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement:
theorem cancelled_differentiableAt (z : ℂ) (h1 : z ≠ 1) (h2 : z ≠ -1) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => 1 / (w ^ 2 - 1)) z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.doc:
/-- The derivative in the dimension: `d/dε [2π^{n/2-ε}/Γ(n/2 - ε)]` at `ε = 0` is
`2π^{n/2}/Γ(n/2) (ψ(n/2) - log π)` (`n = 4`: `2π²(1 - γ - log π)`, since `ψ(2) = 1 - γ`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement:
theorem sphere_area_deriv (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    HasDerivAt (fun e : ℂ => 2 * (π : ℂ) ^ ((n : ℂ) / 2 - e) / Complex.Gamma ((n : ℂ) / 2 - e))
      (2 * (π : ℂ) ^ ((n : ℂ) / 2) / Complex.Gamma ((n : ℂ) / 2) *
        (Complex.digamma ((n : ℂ) / 2) - Complex.log π)) 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem wirtinger_bar (a b c d : ℝ) :
    (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (((a : ℂ) + c * I) + I * ((b : ℂ) + d * I)) =
      (1 / 2) * (((a - d : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((b + c : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `∂_z̄ f = 0` exactly when both Cauchy-Riemann equations `u_x = v_y`, `u_y = -v_x` hold. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem wirtinger_bar_zero_iff (a b c d : ℝ) :
    (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (((a : ℂ) + c * I) + I * ((b : ℂ) + d * I)) = 0 ↔ a = d ∧ b = -c

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.fou.doc: /-- The poles of `1/(1 + z⁴)`: `z_k = e^{iπ(2k+1)/4}` satisfies `z_k⁴ = -1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.fou.statement: theorem fourth_root (k : ℕ) : exp (((2 * k + 1) * π / 4 : ℝ) * I) ^ 4 = -1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.doc: /-- `t = sin²θ`: `1 - t = cos²θ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement: theorem one_sub_sin_sq (θ : ℝ) : 1 - Real.sin θ ^ 2 = Real.cos θ ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- The zeros of `z² + 1` are `i` and `-i`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem sq_add_one_eq_zero_iff (z : ℂ) : z ^ 2 + 1 = 0 ↔ z = I ∨ z = -I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement:
theorem log_jump_start (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => log (exp (t * I) - a)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (Real.log (a - 1) + π * I))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- `e^{iπ/4}√π = √(π/2)(1 + i)`: real and imaginary parts are the Fresnel integrals `∫ cos t² = ∫ sin t² = √(π/2)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem fresnel_value : Complex.exp (π * I / 4) * (√π : ℝ) = (√(π / 2) : ℝ) * (1 + I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement:
theorem diffQuot_inv (z h : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hzh : z + h ≠ 0) (hh : h ≠ 0) :
    (1 / (z + h) - 1 / z) / h = -1 / (z * (z + h))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- `u_xx = 2` for `u = x² - y²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement: theorem sq_uxx (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => deriv (fun x => x ^ 2 - y ^ 2) x) x = 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.doc:
/-- The closed forms `1/(a - z)` and `1/(a - z)²` are holomorphic on `ℂ ∖ {a}` (for `a = 1`: the continuations of
the two series). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.statement:
theorem closed_forms_differentiableOn (a : ℂ) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => 1 / (a - z)) {a}ᶜ ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => 1 / (a - z) ^ 2) {a}ᶜ

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- Indeed `rⁿ cos nθ = Re zⁿ` for `z = r e^{iθ}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem rn_cos_eq_re (n : ℕ) (r θ : ℝ) :
    (((r : ℂ) * Complex.exp (θ * I)) ^ n).re = r ^ n * Real.cos (n * θ)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.doc: /-- The functional equation `e^{z + w} = e^z e^w` holds for all complex `z, w`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.statement: theorem exp_add (z w : ℂ) : Complex.exp (z + w) = Complex.exp z * Complex.exp w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- `aₙ = f⁽ⁿ⁾(c)/n! = (2πi)⁻¹ ∮ f(z)/(z - c)^(n+1) dz` for `f` holomorphic on the closed disc. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem coeff_eq_circleIntegral (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R)) (n : ℕ) :
    (2 * π * I)⁻¹ * ∮ z in C(c, R), f z / (z - c) ^ (n + 1) = iteratedDeriv n f c / (Nat.factorial n : ℂ)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.doc: /-- The numerator factors as `-(z - (1 + s))(z - (1 - s))` with `s² = 2`: its only zeros are `1 ± √2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement:
theorem numerator_factor (z s : ℂ) (hs : s ^ 2 = 2) :
    -z ^ 2 + 2 * z + 1 = -((z - (1 + s)) * (z - (1 - s)))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- The logarithms of `z ≠ 0` (the solutions of `e^w = z`) are `Log z + 2πik`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement:
theorem logarithms_iff (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (w : ℂ) :
    Complex.exp w = z ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, w = Complex.log z + 2 * π * I * k

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- The Euclidean Lagrangian of the particle is non-negative for `m ≥ 0`, `V ≥ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem euclidean_particle_nonneg (m xp V : ℝ) (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hV : 0 ≤ V) : 0 ≤ 1 / 2 * m * xp ^ 2 + V

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem conj_vy (y : ℝ) : deriv (fun y : ℝ => -y) y = -1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement:
theorem growth_estimate (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ z, ‖f z‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ n) (k : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv k f 0‖ ≤ k.factorial * (C * (1 + r) ^ n) / r ^ k

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.ve.doc:
/-- On the vertical sides of the rectangle `[-R, R] × [0, k]` the integrand `e^{-z²/2}` is bounded by
`e^{-R²/2 + k²/2}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.ve.statement:
theorem vertical_side_bound (R t k : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ |k|) :
    ‖Complex.exp (-((R : ℂ) + t * I) ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-R ^ 2 / 2 + k ^ 2 / 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem product_split (a b c d : ℂ) : a * b - c * d = (a - c) * b + c * (b - d)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- The series of `1/(1 + z²)` converges exactly on `|z| < 1`: its radius is `1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem summable_inv_one_add_sq_iff (z : ℂ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (-1) ^ n * z ^ (2 * n)) ↔ ‖z‖ < 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- The Taylor series of `1/(z² + 4)` about `1` converges on `|z - 1| < √5`, the distance to `±2i`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem hasSum_taylor_at_one (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z - 1‖ < Real.sqrt 5) :
    HasSum (fun n => iteratedDeriv n (fun w : ℂ => 1 / (w ^ 2 + 4)) 1 / (Nat.factorial n : ℂ) * (z - 1) ^ n)
      (1 / (z ^ 2 + 4))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.res.doc: /-- `1/(z² + c²)` has residue `1/(2ic)` at `ic` by the quotient rule `g/h' = 1/(2z)` (the text: `c = 1`, `1/(2i)`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Residues.res.statement:
theorem residue_inv_sq_add_sq (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun z => (z - I * c) * (1 / (z ^ 2 + c ^ 2))) (𝓝[≠] (I * c)) (𝓝 (1 / (2 * (I * c))))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement:
theorem sphere_areas :
    2 * π ^ (1 : ℝ) / Real.Gamma 1 = 2 * π ∧ 2 * π ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) / Real.Gamma (3 / 2) = 4 * π ∧
      2 * π ^ (2 : ℝ) / Real.Gamma 2 = 2 * π ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem mobius_deriv_ne_zero (z : ℂ) (hz : z + I ≠ 0) : cayleyDeriv z ≠ 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.doc: /-- The geometric series converges only on the unit disc: it diverges for `|z| ≥ 1` (`1 + 2 + 4 + …` at `z = 2`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.statement: theorem geometric_not_summable (z : ℂ) (hz : 1 ≤ ‖z‖) : ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => z ^ n)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.doc: /-- The Gaussian over `ℝⁿ`: `∫ e^{-|x|²} dx = π^{n/2}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement:
theorem gaussian_euclidean (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Real.exp (-‖x‖ ^ 2) = π ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc:
/-- `e^{az}`, `cos az`, `sin az`, `cosh az`, `sinh az` are entire, for every `a` (`a = 1`: the functions of the
text). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement:
theorem exp_family_entire (a : ℂ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (fun z => Complex.exp (a * z)) ∧ Differentiable ℂ (fun z => Complex.cos (a * z)) ∧
      Differentiable ℂ (fun z => Complex.sin (a * z)) ∧ Differentiable ℂ (fun z => Complex.cosh (a * z)) ∧
      Differentiable ℂ (fun z => Complex.sinh (a * z))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.doc: /-- Orthogonality on circles: `∮ (z - c)ⁿ dz = 2πi` for `n = -1` and `0` for every other integer `n`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.statement:
theorem circle_zpow (c : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) (n : ℤ) :
    (∮ z in C(c, ρ), (z - c) ^ n) = if n = -1 then 2 * π * I else 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.statement: theorem gamma_ne_zero (z : ℂ) (hz : ∀ m : ℕ, z ≠ -m) : Complex.Gamma z ≠ 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- Along the negative real axis `e^{a/x} → 0` (`a > 0`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement:
theorem exp_div_neg_axis (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (a / x)) (𝓝[<] 0) (𝓝 0)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.statement: theorem gamma_add_one (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) : Complex.Gamma (z + 1) = z * Complex.Gamma z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.doc: /-- The product rule `(x + iy)(u + iv) = (xu - yv) + i(xv + yu)`, from `i² = -1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement:
theorem mul_formula (x y u v : ℝ) :
    ((x : ℂ) + y * I) * (u + v * I) = (x * u - y * v) + (x * v + y * u) * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc:
/-- The linear system `u u_x + v v_x = 0`, `v u_x - u v_x = 0` has determinant `u² + v²`: `(u² + v²) u_x = 0` and
`(u² + v²) v_x = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement:
theorem cr_system (u v a b : ℝ) (h1 : u * a + v * b = 0) (h2 : v * a - u * b = 0) :
    (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) * a = 0 ∧ (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) * b = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- The geometric series converges exactly on `|z| < 1`: its radius is `1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement: theorem summable_geometric_iff (z : ℂ) : Summable (fun n => z ^ n) ↔ ‖z‖ < 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc: /-- The small clockwise semicircle: `∫_π^0 e^{iaεe^{iθ}} i dθ → -iπ` as `ε → 0` (the text: `a = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement:
theorem small_arc (a : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ∫ θ in π..0, exp (I * a * (ε * exp (θ * I))) * I) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (-(π * I)))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem exp_pi_div_two_I : Complex.exp (π / 2 * I) = I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement:
theorem circle_inv_sub (w : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hw : ‖w‖ ≠ R) :
    (∮ z in C(0, R), (z - w)⁻¹) = if ‖w‖ < R then 2 * π * I else 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement: theorem sq_add_one_factor (x : ℂ) : x ^ 2 + 1 = (x + I) * (x - I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc:
/-- `x² + y² + c` is the real part of no entire function (its circle average over `|z| = 1` is `1 + c`, its value at
the centre `c`, against the mean value property). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem normSq_not_re (c : ℝ) :
    ¬ ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, Differentiable ℂ f ∧ ∀ z, (f z).re = z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 + c

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- A holomorphic function of constant modulus on a connected open set is constant. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement:
theorem const_of_norm_const (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hc : IsPreconnected U)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U) (c : ℝ) (h : ∀ z ∈ U, ‖f z‖ = c) : ∃ w, ∀ z ∈ U, f z = w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `u_x + i v_x = -1/z²`: its product with `z²` is `-1`. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement: theorem beta_three_four_integral : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ 2 * (1 - x) ^ 3 = 1 / 60
theorem one_sub_rational_subst (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 + x ≠ 0) : 1 - x / (1 + x) = 1 / (1 + x)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- `exp`, `cos` and `sin` are entire. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem entire (z : ℂ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ exp z ∧ DifferentiableAt ℂ cos z ∧ DifferentiableAt ℂ sin z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LaurentSerie.doc: /-- The error of the Taylor partial sums: `f - S_N = z^N/(1 - z) - (z/2)^N/(2 - z)`, geometric on `|z| < 1`. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement: theorem ml_bound_value : 30.9 < 4 * π * Real.exp 2 / 3 ∧ 4 * π * Real.exp 2 / 3 < 31

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.doc: /-- The functional equation `ζ(s) = 2^s π^{s-1} sin(πs/2) Γ(1 - s) ζ(1 - s)` (`s ≠ 0, 1, 2, …`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.statement:
theorem zeta_functional_equation (s : ℂ) (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hs : ∀ n : ℕ, s ≠ n + 1) :
    riemannZeta s =
      2 ^ s * (π : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) * Complex.sin (π * s / 2) * Complex.Gamma (1 - s) * riemannZeta (1 - s)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.fOu.statement: theorem fOut_sq (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) : fOut z ^ 2 = z ^ 2 - 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement: theorem circle_dz_over (c : ℂ) (r t : ℝ) : deriv (circleMap c r) t = I * (circleMap c r t - c)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.doc: /-- Its only zero is `1`: off the poles `±i`, `(z - 1)/(z² + 1) = 0` iff `z = 1`. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement: theorem one_add_I_pow_eight : (1 + I) ^ 8 = 16

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc: /-- The residue of `e^{ikz}/(1 + z²)` at `i` is `e^{-k}/(2i)` (the text: `k = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement:
theorem residue_fourier (k : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun z => (z - I) * (exp (I * k * z) / (1 + z ^ 2))) (𝓝[≠] I)
      (𝓝 (exp (I * k * I) / (2 * I)))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- The vertical line `Re z = c` goes to the parabola `u = c² - t²`, `v = 2ct`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem image_vertical (c t : ℝ) : ((c : ℂ) + t * I) ^ 2 = ((c ^ 2 - t ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * c * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.statement:
theorem arg_mul_mod (z w : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    (arg (z * w) : Real.Angle) = arg z + arg w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.doc: /-- The Euler product `ζ(s) = ∏_p (1 - p^{-s})⁻¹` for `Re s > 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.statement:
theorem zeta_euler_product (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    ∏' p : Nat.Primes, (1 - (p : ℂ) ^ (-s))⁻¹ = riemannZeta s

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.doc: /-- The chain rule for the complex derivative. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement:
theorem chain (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (f' g' z : ℂ) (hf : HasDerivAt f f' z) (hg : HasDerivAt g g' (f z)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w => g (f w)) (g' * f') z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- `v_x = 6xy` for `v = 3x²y - y³`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement: theorem cube_vx (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => 3 * x ^ 2 * y - y ^ 3) x = 6 * x * y

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `u_y = cos x sinh y` for `u = cos x cosh y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem cos_uy (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun y => Real.cos x * Real.cosh y) y = Real.cos x * Real.sinh y

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.sin.doc: /-- The case `n = 3`, imaginary part: `sin 3θ = 3 cos²θ sin θ - sin³θ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.sin.statement: theorem sin_three (θ : ℝ) : Real.sin (3 * θ) = 3 * Real.cos θ ^ 2 * Real.sin θ - Real.sin θ ^ 3

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.sem.statement:
theorem semicircle_length (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    length (seg (-R) R) 0 1 + length (circleMap 0 R) 0 π = 2 * R + π * R

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.statement: theorem inv_gamma_differentiableAt (z : ℂ) : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun s => (Complex.Gamma s)⁻¹) z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc:
/-- Closing in the lower half-plane: `Res_{-ic} 1/(z² + c²) = 1/(2(-ic))` and `-2πi` times it is `π/c`, the same
number (the text: `c = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement:
theorem lower_half_residue (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun z => (z - -(I * c)) * (1 / (z ^ 2 + c ^ 2))) (𝓝[≠] (-(I * c))) (𝓝 (1 / (2 * -(I * c)))) ∧
      -2 * π * I * (1 / (2 * -(I * c))) = π / c

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- The principal logarithm is `Log z = ln|z| + i Arg z`, with imaginary part in `(-π, π]`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement:
theorem log_eq (z : ℂ) :
    Complex.log z = Real.log ‖z‖ + arg z * I ∧ -π < (Complex.log z).im ∧ (Complex.log z).im ≤ π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- Near the cut: a square root `w` of `-1 + εi` in the closed upper half-plane is within `|ε|` of `i`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement: theorem sqrt_near_I (w : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) (hw : w ^ 2 = -1 + ε * I) (him : 0 ≤ w.im) : ‖w - I‖ ≤ |ε|

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.doc: /-- `Γ(a)Γ(b) = Γ(a + b) B(a, b)` for `Re a, Re b > 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement:
theorem gamma_mul_gamma (a b : ℂ) (ha : 0 < a.re) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    Complex.Gamma a * Complex.Gamma b = Complex.Gamma (a + b) * betaIntegral a b

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.doc: /-- `ω ≠ 1`, so the sum of the sixth roots vanishes. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.statement: theorem ω_ne_one : ω ≠ 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- `1/(z² sin(az))`, `a ≠ 0`, has a pole of order `3` at `0` (the text: `a = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement: theorem order_csc_sq (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) : IsPoleOfOrder (fun z => 1 / (z ^ 2 * sin (a * z))) 0 3

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.doc: /-- The Gaussian moments `∫₀^∞ t^{2k} e^{-t²} dt = Γ(k + 1/2)/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.statement:
theorem gaussian_moment (k : ℕ) :
    ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), t ^ (2 * k) * Real.exp (-t ^ 2) = Real.Gamma (k + 1 / 2) / 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `u_y = -2xy/(x² + y²)²` for `u = x/(x² + y²)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem inv_uy (x y : ℝ) (h : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    deriv (fun y => x / (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) y = -2 * x * y / (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.doc: /-- The four residues `-z_k/4 = -z₀ iᵏ/4` sum to `0`: `∑_{k < 4} ζ iᵏ = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueTheor.statement: theorem fourth_roots_sum (ζ : ℂ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 4, ζ * I ^ k = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.doc: /-- Every polynomial is entire. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicF.statement: theorem polynomial_entire (p : Polynomial ℂ) : Differentiable ℂ (fun z => p.eval z)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.co.doc: /-- Completing the square: `-x²/2 + ikx = -(x - ik)²/2 - k²/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.co.statement: theorem complete_square (x k : ℝ) : -(x : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 + I * k * x = -((x : ℂ) - I * k) ^ 2 / 2 - (k : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- A holomorphic function with vanishing derivative on a connected open set is constant. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem deriv_zero_const (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hc : IsPreconnected U)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U) (hd : ∀ z ∈ U, deriv f z = 0) : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ U, f z = f w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.doc: /-- `e^{iθ/2}` is a continuous square root of `e^{iθ}` along the unit circle. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.statement: theorem sqrt_lift_sq (θ : ℝ) : Complex.exp (θ * I / 2) ^ 2 = Complex.exp (θ * I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- `u_y = -6xy` for `u = x³ - 3xy²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement: theorem cube_uy (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun y => x ^ 3 - 3 * x * y ^ 2) y = -6 * x * y

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.doc: /-- The zeros of `1/Γ` are exactly `0, -1, -2, …`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement: theorem inv_gamma_eq_zero_iff (z : ℂ) : (Complex.Gamma z)⁻¹ = 0 ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, z = -n

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.fOu.doc:
/-- `f` is a branch of `√(z² - 1)` on `ℂ ∖ [-1, 1]`: at every point off the segment it is continuous and squares
to `z² - 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.fOu.statement:
theorem fOut_branch_at (z : ℂ) (hz : ¬ (z.im = 0 ∧ |z.re| ≤ 1)) :
    ContinuousAt fOut z ∧ fOut z ^ 2 = z ^ 2 - 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc: /-- The algebraic step of `upper_sum_sq_fourth`: `(1/4)(-2 (s/2) i) = -i s/4`, with `s = √2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement: theorem upper_sum_sq_fourth_alg (J s : ℂ) : 1 / 4 * (-2 * (s / 2) * J) = -J * s / 4

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- The solutions of `e^z = -1` are `z = iπ + 2πik`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem exp_eq_neg_one_iff (z : ℂ) : Complex.exp z = -1 ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, z = π * I + 2 * π * I * k

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- Multiplication by `a + ib` acts on `(x, y)` by the matrix `(a, -b; b, a)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem mul_parts (a b x y : ℝ) :
    ((a : ℂ) + b * I) * ((x : ℂ) + y * I) = ((a * x - b * y : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((b * x + a * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement:
theorem entire_closed_integrals (p : Polynomial ℂ) (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ) (hγ : ContDiff ℝ 1 γ)
    (hclosed : γ a = γ b) :
    cint exp γ a b = 0 ∧ cint cos γ a b = 0 ∧ cint (fun z => p.eval z) γ a b = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- `sin z = (e^{iz} - e^{-iz})/(2i)`, that is `2i sin z = e^{iz} - e^{-iz}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem sin_def_claim (z : ℂ) : 2 * I * Complex.sin z = Complex.exp (z * I) - Complex.exp (-z * I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- The normalisation `v(0, 0) = 3·0²·0 - 0³ = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement: theorem cube_v_origin : (3 : ℝ) * 0 ^ 2 * 0 - 0 ^ 3 = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc: /-- At a pole of `z²/(1 + z⁴)`: `Res = z²/(4z³) = 1/(4z)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement: theorem residue_sq_fourth (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) : z ^ 2 / (4 * z ^ 3) = 1 / (4 * z)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement: theorem ml_exact (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 < R) : (∮ z in C(0, R), exp z / (z ^ 2 + 1)) = 2 * π * I * sin 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement:
theorem square_side (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    cint (fun z => z⁻¹) (seg (s * (1 - I)) (s * (1 + I))) 0 1 = π / 2 * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.statement: theorem arg_neg_one_neg_I : ‖(-1 : ℂ) - I‖ = √2 ∧ arg (-1 - I) = -(3 * π / 4)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- For `e^z` at `0`: `∮ e^z/z dz = ∮ e^z/z² dz = 2πi`, so `a₀ = a₁ = 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem exp_circle (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∮ z in C(0, R), exp z / z) = 2 * π * I ∧ (∮ z in C(0, R), exp z / z ^ 2) = 2 * π * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- For `a = 1/n` every value `e^{(Log z + 2πik)/n}` is an `n`-th root of `z`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement:
theorem nth_root_values (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (k : ℤ) :
    Complex.exp (((1 / n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.log z + 2 * π * I * k)) ^ n = z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem norm_exp_factor (k : ℂ) (t : ℝ) : ‖Complex.exp (-I * k * t)‖ = Real.exp (t * k.im)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc: /-- With `z = e^{iθ}`: `cos θ = (z + 1/z)/2`, `sin θ = (z - 1/z)/(2i)` and `dz = iz dθ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement:
theorem subst_trig (θ : ℝ) :
    (Real.cos θ : ℂ) = (exp (θ * I) + (exp (θ * I))⁻¹) / 2 ∧
      (Real.sin θ : ℂ) = (exp (θ * I) - (exp (θ * I))⁻¹) / (2 * I) ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => exp (t * I)) (I * exp (θ * I)) θ

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement:
theorem primitive_on_disc (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c r)) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, ∀ z ∈ ball c r, HasDerivAt F (f z) z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc:
/-- The Cauchy-Riemann equations: a real differentiable `f` is complex differentiable at `z` iff
`u_x = v_y` and `u_y = -v_x` there, with `u_x + i v_x = L 1`, `u_y + i v_y = L i`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem cr_iff (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ f z ↔
      ((fderiv ℝ f z 1).re = (fderiv ℝ f z I).im ∧ (fderiv ℝ f z I).re = -(fderiv ℝ f z 1).im)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.cir.statement: theorem circle_norm_deriv (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (t : ℝ) : ‖deriv (circleMap z₀ r) t‖ = r

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- The real Gaussian after the rotation: `∫ e^{-au²/2} du = √(2π/a)` for `a > 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.statement: theorem gaussian_real (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : ∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-(a / 2) * u ^ 2) = √(2 * π / a)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- `z = z₀ + r e^{iθ}` has `dz/dθ = i r e^{iθ}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem circle_param_deriv (z₀ : ℂ) (r θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun θ : ℝ => z₀ + r * Complex.exp (θ * I)) (I * r * Complex.exp (θ * I)) θ

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- `Log z = ∑ (-1)^(n+1) (z - 1)ⁿ/n` on `|z - 1| < 1`, the distance from `1` to the cut. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem hasSum_log_at_one (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z - 1‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (-1) ^ (n + 1) * (z - 1) ^ n / n) (log z)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.doc:
/-- The argument principle for `f = (z - 1)/(z² + 1)` on circles of radius `r < 1`: `(2πi)⁻¹ ∮ f'/f` is `+1` around
the zero `1` and `-1` around each pole `±i` (the hue winds once, in opposite senses). -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- The Jacobian `diag(1, -1)` of `z̄` has determinant `-1` (a reflection). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem conj_jac_det : !![(1 : ℝ), 0; 0, -1].det = -1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.doc:
/-- The meromorphic continuation `Γ(a)Γ(b)/Γ(a + b)` is holomorphic in `a` away from the poles of `Γ(a)`
(`1/Γ` being entire). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement:
theorem beta_continuation_differentiableAt (a b : ℂ) (ha : ∀ m : ℕ, a ≠ -m) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun s => Complex.Gamma s * Complex.Gamma b * (Complex.Gamma (s + b))⁻¹) a

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.doc: /-- The columns `(2x, 2y)` and `(-2y, 2x)` of the Jacobian of `z²` are orthogonal and of equal length. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.doc: /-- `ω⁶ = 1`, hence `ω_k⁶ = 1` for every `k`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.statement: theorem ω_pow_six : ω ^ 6 = 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.doc: /-- Every `Log z + 2πik` is a logarithm of `z`: the continued logarithm is many-valued. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.statement: theorem exp_log_add (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (k : ℤ) : Complex.exp (Complex.log z + 2 * π * I * k) = z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- `1/(z² + b²)³`, `b ≠ 0`, has a pole of order `3` at `ib` (the text: `b = 1`, the pole at `i`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement:
theorem order_cube_at_I (b : ℂ) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    IsPoleOfOrder (fun z => 1 / (z ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 3) (I * b) 3

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Argument.arg.statement: theorem arg_one_sub_sqrt_three : ‖(1 : ℂ) - √3 * I‖ = 2 ∧ arg (1 - √3 * I) = -(π / 3)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.disc.doc: /-- The open disc `D(z₀, r) = {z : |z - z₀| < r}` is open. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.disc.statement: theorem disc_isOpen (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ) : IsOpen {z : ℂ | ‖z - z₀‖ < r}

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement: theorem exp_estimate (n : ℕ) : ‖iteratedDeriv n exp 0‖ ≤ n.factorial * Real.exp 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- Along the imaginary axis `|e^{1/(iy)}| = |e^{-i/y}| = 1`: the values run around the unit circle. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement: theorem exp_inv_imag_axis (y : ℝ) : ‖exp (1 / (y * I))‖ = 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement: theorem sq_one_add (x : ℂ) : (1 + x) ^ 2 = 2 * x + (x ^ 2 + 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- The roots of unity lie on the unit circle. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem root_of_unity_norm (n k : ℕ) : ‖Complex.exp (2 * π * I * k / n)‖ = 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement: theorem log_one_add_I : Complex.log (1 + I) = Real.log 2 / 2 + π / 4 * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.doc: /-- Over `ℚ(i)` nothing changes: `z² + z + 1` and `z² - z + 1` have no root `a + bi` with `a, b ∈ ℚ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.statement:
theorem no_root_gaussian (a b : ℚ) :
    ((a : ℂ) + b * I) ^ 2 + (a + b * I) + 1 ≠ 0 ∧ ((a : ℂ) + b * I) ^ 2 - (a + b * I) + 1 ≠ 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- `(e^{az} - 1)/z² = a z⁻¹ + …`, `a ≠ 0`, has a simple pole at `0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement: theorem order_exp_sub_one (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) : IsPoleOfOrder (fun z => (exp (a * z) - 1) / z ^ 2) 0 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.statement: theorem geom_sum_identity (x : ℂ) (n : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, x ^ k) * (1 - x) = 1 - x ^ n

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement:
theorem holo_iteratedDeriv_differentiable (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U) (n : ℕ) : DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv n f) U

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- `y` is an argument of `e^{x + iy}`: `y = Arg e^{x+iy} + 2πk`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem arg_exp_mem (x y : ℝ) : ∃ k : ℤ, y = arg (Complex.exp (x + y * I)) + 2 * π * k

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- A function holomorphic on the disc `|z - c| < r` equals its Taylor series there. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement:
theorem hasSum_taylor (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball c r)) (z : ℂ)
    (hz : z ∈ Metric.ball c r) :
    HasSum (fun n => iteratedDeriv n f c / (Nat.factorial n : ℂ) * (z - c) ^ n) (f z)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.sqr.doc:
/-- `√(z² - 1) = √(z - 1) √(z + 1)` as many-valued functions: a product of square roots of `z - 1` and `z + 1` is a
square root of `z² - 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.sqr.statement: theorem sqrt_product (z a b : ℂ) (ha : a ^ 2 = z - 1) (hb : b ^ 2 = z + 1) : (a * b) ^ 2 = z ^ 2 - 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.doc: /-- For `Re s > 1`: `(1 - 2^{1-s}) ζ(s) = ∑_{n ≥ 1} (-1)^{n+1} n^{-s}` (subtracting twice the even terms). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.statement:
theorem eta_relation (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (-1) ^ n / ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ s) ((1 - 2 ^ (1 - s)) * riemannZeta s)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyTheore.statement:
theorem poly5_primitive (z : ℂ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z ^ 6 / 6 - 3 * z ^ 2 / 2 + 2 * z) (z ^ 5 - 3 * z + 2) z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc:
/-- The computation of the solution, with `a = e^{iz}`, `b = e^{iw}`:
`¼(a + a⁻¹)(b + b⁻¹) + ¼(a - a⁻¹)(b - b⁻¹) = ½(ab + (ab)⁻¹)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement:
theorem addition_core (a b : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    (a + a⁻¹) * (b + b⁻¹) / 4 + (a - a⁻¹) * (b - b⁻¹) / 4 = (a * b + (a * b)⁻¹) / 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- `|z + i|² - |z - i|² = 4 Im z`, so `|z - i| < |z + i|` exactly when `Im z > 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem cayley_normSq_diff (x y : ℝ) : (x ^ 2 + (y + 1) ^ 2) - (x ^ 2 + (y - 1) ^ 2) = 4 * y

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.doc:
/-- The rational form `B(a, b) = ∫₀^∞ x^{a-1}(1 + x)^{-a-b} dx` at `a = 1`: `B(1, b) = ∫₀^∞ (1 + x)^{-1-b} dx = 1/b`
(`b > 0`). (The general form is not formalised.) -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement:
theorem beta_one_rational (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    (betaIntegral 1 b).re = ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), x ^ ((1 : ℝ) - 1) * (1 + x) ^ (-(1 : ℝ) - b)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.GammaFunctio.statement: theorem gamma_half_integer (n : ℕ) : Real.Gamma (n + 1 / 2) = (2 * n)! / (4 ^ n * n !) * √π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- The functional equation `e^{z + w} = e^z e^w`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem exp_add_claim (z w : ℂ) : Complex.exp (z + w) = Complex.exp z * Complex.exp w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- For integer `a = n` all values `e^{n(Log z + 2πik)}` agree, with `zⁿ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement:
theorem int_power_values (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (n k : ℤ) :
    Complex.exp (n * (Complex.log z + 2 * π * I * k)) = z ^ n

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `f'(z) = u_x + i v_x`: the complex derivative is the real derivative in the direction `1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem deriv_eq_fderiv_one (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) (h : DifferentiableAt ℂ f z) :
    deriv f z = fderiv ℝ f z 1

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.doc: /-- All values of `i^i = e^{i log i}` are real: `e^{i(iπ/2 + 2πik)} = e^{-π/2 - 2πk}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexLogar.statement:
theorem I_pow_I_values (k : ℤ) :
    Complex.exp (I * (π / 2 * I + 2 * π * I * k)) = Real.exp (-(π / 2) - 2 * π * k)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement: theorem exp_unbounded (M : ℝ) : ∃ z : ℂ, M < ‖exp z‖

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement: theorem ml_exact_value : 5.17 < 2 * π * Real.sin 1 ∧ 2 * π * Real.sin 1 < 5.3

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement: theorem hasSum_geometric (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ < 1) : HasSum (fun n => z ^ n) (1 / (1 - z))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement: theorem diffQuot_cube (z h : ℂ) (hh : h ≠ 0) : ((z + h) ^ 3 - z ^ 3) / h = 3 * z ^ 2 + 3 * z * h + h ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.doc: /-- `u_y = 2y` for `u = x² + y²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement: theorem normSq_uy (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun y => x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) y = 2 * y

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.doc: /-- The cube roots `1, ω, ω²` with `ω = -½ + i√3/2`: `ω³ = 1`, `ω² = -½ - i√3/2`, `1 + ω + ω² = 0`. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.doc: /-- `t = sin²θ`: `dt = 2 sinθ cosθ dθ`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement: theorem deriv_sin_sq (θ : ℝ) : deriv (fun θ => Real.sin θ ^ 2) θ = 2 * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourWorke.statement: theorem seg_integrand (x t : ℂ) : ((1 + x) * t) ^ 2 * (1 + x) = (1 + x) ^ 3 * t ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyIntegr.statement: theorem sq_div_sq (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 < R) : (∮ z in C(0, R), z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2) = 4 * π * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.doc: /-- `Im z = (1 - |w|²)/|1 - w|² > 0` for `|w| < 1`: the inverse maps the disc into the half-plane. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem cayley_inv_im (w : ℂ) (hw : ‖w‖ < 1) : 0 < (I * (1 + w) / (1 - w)).im

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.doc: /-- `uv = ½ Im f²` and `u² - v² = Re f²` are harmonic, as parts of the holomorphic `f²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.statement:
theorem products_harmonic (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ U) :
    HarmonicAt (fun w => (f w).re * (f w).im) z ∧ HarmonicAt (fun w => (f w).re ^ 2 - (f w).im ^ 2) z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.doc: /-- `|a + bi| = √(a² + b²)`: the poles `±2i` are at distance `2` from `0` and `√5` from `1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.TaylorSeries.statement: theorem norm_add_mul_I (a b : ℝ) : ‖(a : ℂ) + b * I‖ = Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.WickRotation.doc: /-- The field: `i · (-i) · (½(i ∂_τφ)² - ½(∇φ)² - ½m²φ²) = -½((∂_τφ)² + (∇φ)² + m²φ²)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.ke.doc: /-- The residue of `z^{a-1}/(1 + z)` at `z = -1 = e^{iπ}` is `e^{iπ(a-1)} = -e^{iπa}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.ke.statement: theorem keyhole_residue (a : ℝ) : Complex.exp (π * I * (a - 1)) = -Complex.exp (π * I * a)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.NumbersWorke.doc: /-- The non-real roots: `z² - z + 1` has the roots `ω, ω⁵ = ω⁻¹` and `z² + z + 1` the roots `ω², ω⁴`. -/

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `u_x + i v_x = -sin x cosh y - i cos x sinh y = -sin z`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem cos_deriv_parts (x y : ℝ) :
    -Complex.sin ((x : ℂ) + y * I) =
      ((-(Real.sin x * Real.cosh y) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((-(Real.cos x * Real.sinh y) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.dist.doc: /-- `|z - w|` is the distance between `z` and `w`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Modulus.dist.statement: theorem dist_eq_norm_sub (z w : ℂ) : dist z w = ‖z - w‖

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourWorke.statement:
theorem circle_rational (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∮ z in C(0, R), (3 * z ^ 2 + 2 / z + 1 / z ^ 2 + 5 / z ^ 3)) = 4 * π * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.SpecialWorke.statement:
theorem gamma_deriv_nat (n : ℕ) :
    deriv Complex.Gamma (n + 1) = n ! * (((harmonic n : ℚ) : ℂ) - (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- `e^{a/z}`, `a ≠ 0`, has no limit at `0`, neither finite nor infinite (the text: `a = 1`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement:
theorem exp_inv_no_limit (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (¬ ∃ L, Tendsto (fun z => exp (a / z)) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 L)) ∧
      ¬ Tendsto (fun z => exp (a / z)) (𝓝[≠] 0) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.doc: /-- `|z|² = z z̄` is complex differentiable at `z` exactly when `z = 0`, with derivative `0` there. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement:
theorem normSq_differentiableAt_iff (z : ℂ) :
    (DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w * conj w) z ↔ z = 0) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w * conj w) 0 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ConformalMap.statement: theorem cayley_one_add (z : ℂ) (hz : z + I ≠ 0) : 1 + (z - I) / (z + I) = 2 * z / (z + I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.log.doc: /-- The imaginary part of `log₊` lies in `(0, 2π)` off the cut. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Branches.log.statement: theorem logPos_im (z : ℂ) (hz : -z ∈ slitPlane) : 0 < (logPos z).im ∧ (logPos z).im < 2 * π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.doc:
/-- The integrand after the substitution: `1/(a + (z + 1/z)/2) · 1/(iz) = 2/(i(z² + 2az + 1))`
(the text: `a = 2`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement:
theorem trig_integrand (a z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hq : z ^ 2 + 2 * a * z + 1 ≠ 0) :
    1 / (a + (z + z⁻¹) / 2) * (1 / (I * z)) = 2 / (I * (z ^ 2 + 2 * a * z + 1))

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.doc: /-- The substitution `t = sin²θ` turns `∫₀¹ dt/√(t(1 - t))` into `2∫₀^{π/2} dθ = π`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.BetaFunction.statement: theorem two_quarter_turn : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), (2 : ℝ) = π

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDeriv.statement: theorem deriv_pow (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : deriv (fun w : ℂ => w ^ n) z = n * z ^ (n - 1)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- They are the powers of one of them: `ω₁ᵏ = ω_k`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement:
theorem root_of_unity_powers (n k : ℕ) :
    Complex.exp (((2 * π / n : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) ^ k = Complex.exp (((2 * π * k / n : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ResidueWorke.statement: theorem two_pi_I_sq_fourth : 2 * π * I * (-I * (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) / 4) = π / (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ZetaFunction.statement:
theorem zeta_two_mul_nat (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    2 * (2 * n)! * riemannZeta (2 * n) = (-1) ^ (n + 1) * bernoulli (2 * n) * (2 * π) ^ (2 * n)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunc.statement:
theorem exp_laplacian (x y : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun x => deriv (fun x => Real.exp x * Real.cos y) x) x +
      deriv (fun y => deriv (fun y => Real.exp x * Real.cos y) y) y = 0

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.doc: /-- `sin(az)/z → a` as `z → 0`; for `a = 1` the removable singularity of `sin z/z` has the value `1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.IsolatedSing.statement: theorem sinc_limit (a : ℂ) : Tendsto (fun z => sin (a * z) / z) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 a)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `u_y = -2y` for `u = x² - y²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement: theorem sq_uy (x y : ℝ) : deriv (fun y => x ^ 2 - y ^ 2) y = -2 * y

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.doc: /-- `cos z = cos x cosh y - i sin x sinh y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.CauchyRieman.statement:
theorem cos_parts (x y : ℝ) :
    Complex.cos ((x : ℂ) + y * I) =
      ((Real.cos x * Real.cosh y : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((-(Real.sin x * Real.sinh y) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexNumbe.statement: theorem conj_add_mul (z w : ℂ) : conj (z + w) = conj z + conj w ∧ conj (z * w) = conj z * conj w

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicW.statement: theorem exp_norm_sq (x y : ℝ) : ‖Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) + y * I)‖ ^ 2 = Real.exp (2 * x)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.par.statement: theorem parabola_speed (t : ℝ) : ‖deriv parabola t‖ = Real.sqrt (1 + 4 * t ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ContourInteg.statement: theorem conj_no_primitive (F : ℂ → ℂ) : ¬ ∀ z, HasDerivAt F (starRingEnd ℂ z) z

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.LiouvilleThe.statement: theorem cos_imag_axis (y : ℝ) : cos (y * I) = Real.cosh y

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.doc:
/-- No entire function restricts to `|x - a|` on `ℝ` (for `a = 0`: to `|x|`): its restriction would be
differentiable at `a`. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.AnalyticCont.statement: theorem no_entire_abs_sub (a : ℝ) : ¬ ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, Differentiable ℂ g ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, g x = |x - a|

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.doc: /-- The exponential series converges absolutely. -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexExpon.statement: theorem exp_series_abs (z : ℂ) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖z ^ n / n.factorial‖)

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.ga.doc: /-- The Gaussian integral `∫ e^{-b u²} du = Γ(½)/√b` for `b > 0` (at `b = ½`: `√(2π) = Γ(½)√2`). -/
KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Exercises.ga.statement: theorem gaussian_gamma (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) : ∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-b * u ^ 2) = Real.Gamma (1 / 2) / √b

KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.Contours.upp.statement: theorem upper_half_plane_exhausted (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) : ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < z.im ∧ ‖z‖ < R

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Greens.doc: /-- For `f = 1`: `u(x) = ∫₀ˣ ξ(1 - x) dξ + ∫ₓ¹ x(1 - ξ) dξ`, with `∫₀ˣ ξ(1 - x) dξ = x²(1 - x)/2` … -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Greens.statement: theorem tent_load_left (x : ℝ) : ∫ ξ in (0 : ℝ)..x, ξ * (1 - x) = x ^ 2 * (1 - x) / 2

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Separa.doc: /-- Separation is correct: if `H' = 1/g`, `F' = f` and `H(y(x)) = F(x) + C` with `g(y) ≠ 0`, then `y' = f g(y)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Separa.statement:
theorem separation_forward (H F y g f : ℝ → ℝ) (y' : ℝ) (C x : ℝ) (hH : HasDerivAt H (1 / g (y x)) (y x))
    (hF : HasDerivAt F (f x) x) (hy : HasDerivAt y y' x) (hg : g (y x) ≠ 0)
    (hHF : ∀ s, H (y s) = F s + C) : y' = f x * g (y x)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.ODECom.doc: /-- The fourth Picard iterate of `y' = y`, `y(0) = 1`: `1 + ∫₀ˣ y₃ = 1 + x + x²/2 + x³/6 + x⁴/24`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.ODECom.statement:
theorem picard_exp_iterate_four (x : ℝ) :
    1 + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..x, (1 + s + s ^ 2 / 2 + s ^ 3 / 6) = 1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2 + x ^ 3 / 6 + x ^ 4 / 24

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.SturmL.statement: theorem leg11 : ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (x) * (x) = 2 / 3

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Orthog.statement: theorem cos02 : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..Real.pi, Real.cos (0 * x) * Real.cos (2 * x) = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Linear.doc:
/-- `A u` shifts `u = (y, y', …)`: `(Au)ᵢ = uᵢ₊₁` below the last row, and the last row is `-Σ aⱼ uⱼ`, so `u' = Au`
is the equation. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Linear.statement:
theorem companion_mulVec {n : ℕ} (a u : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (companion a *ᵥ u) i = if (i : ℕ) = n then -∑ j, a j * u j else u ⟨(i + 1) % (n + 1), Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Initia.doc: /-- `2√|y|` is not Lipschitz at `y = 0`: for every `L` some `0 < y` has `2√y > L y`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Initia.statement: theorem sqrt_not_lipschitz (L : ℝ) : ∃ y : ℝ, 0 < y ∧ L * y < 2 * Real.sqrt y

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Orthog.statement: theorem gs_one : ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (1 : ℝ) = 2

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.PDECom.statement:
theorem standing_from_position (c t x : ℝ) :
    (Real.sin (2 * (x - c * t)) + Real.sin (2 * (x + c * t))) / 2 = Real.sin (2 * x) * Real.cos (2 * (c * t))

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Harmon.doc: /-- The ratio `e^{-4t}/e^{-t} = e^{-3t}` of the two terms is below `1%` for `t > 1.6`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Harmon.statement: theorem overdamped_example_ratio (t : ℝ) (ht : 1.6 < t) : Real.exp (-3 * t) < 1 / 100

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Partia.statement:
theorem burgers_ratio (t x : ℝ) (ht : t + 1 ≠ 0) :
    deriv (fun s => x / (1 + s)) t + x / (1 + t) * deriv (fun y => y / (1 + t)) x = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Separa.doc: /-- `Tₙ = e^{-κn²t}` solves `T' = -κn²T`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Separa.statement:
theorem heat_time_factor (κ n : ℝ) (T : ℝ → ℝ) (hT : T = fun s => Real.exp (-κ * n ^ 2 * s)) (t : ℝ) :
    deriv T t = -κ * n ^ 2 * T t

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Separa.doc:
/-- Every solution of `y' = -ky` is `A e^{-kx}` with `A = y(0)`: the constant solution `0` and the separated
solutions `±e^C e^{-kx}` together. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Separa.statement:
theorem decay_all_solutions (k : ℝ) (y : ℝ → ℝ) (hy : ∀ x, HasDerivAt y (-k * y x) x) (x : ℝ) :
    y x = y 0 * Real.exp (-k * x)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Ordina.statement:
theorem euler_inv_solves (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    x ^ 2 * deriv (deriv fun s => s⁻¹) x - 2 * x⁻¹ = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.SturmL.doc:
/-- The Bessel form expands: `(xu')' = xu'' + u'`, so `-(xu')' + n²u/x = λxu` is `x²u'' + xu' + (λx² - n²)u = 0`
after multiplying by `-x`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.SturmL.statement:
theorem bessel_form (u' u'' : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (hu : HasDerivAt u' (u'' x) x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => s * u' s) (x * u'' x + u' x) x

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.PhaseP.statement: theorem lv_conserved_deriv (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : deriv (fun s => s - Real.log s) x = 1 - 1 / x

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Feynma.doc:
/-- The residue at `k₀ = ω`: `-e^{-ik₀t}/(k₀ + ω)` there is `-e^{-iωt}/(2ω)`; `-2πi/(2π)` times it is
`(i/2ω)e^{-iωt}`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Feynma.statement: theorem feynman_residue (E i ω : ℂ) (hω : ω ≠ 0) : -i * (-E / (ω + ω)) = i / (2 * ω) * E

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Laplac.doc:
/-- The energy identity behind uniqueness: `∇·(w∇w) = |∇w|² + w∇²w` (here in two variables, with
`∂ₓ(wwₓ) = wₓ² + wwₓₓ`). -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Laplac.statement:
theorem divergence_identity (w wx wy wxx wyy : ℝ) :
    (wx * wx + w * wxx) + (wy * wy + w * wyy) = (wx ^ 2 + wy ^ 2) + w * (wxx + wyy)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Partia.doc: /-- … and so is the imaginary part `2xy`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Partia.statement:
theorem im_z_sq_harmonic (x y : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun s => deriv (fun r => 2 * r * y) s) x + deriv (fun s => deriv (fun r => 2 * x * r) s) y = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Orthog.statement: theorem sin24 : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..Real.pi, Real.sin (2 * x) * Real.sin (4 * x) = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Ordina.doc: /-- `y = C₁ cos x + C₂ sin x` solves `y'' + y = 0` for all constants. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Ordina.statement:
theorem cos_sin_solves (C₁ C₂ : ℝ) (y : ℝ → ℝ) (hy : y = fun s => C₁ * Real.cos s + C₂ * Real.sin s) (x : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv y) x + y x = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Linear.doc: /-- Summing the series: `e^{tJ} = cos t · 1 + sin t · J`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Linear.statement:
theorem exp_J_series (t : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (t • !![(0 : ℝ), 1; -1, 0]) =
      Real.cos t • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) + Real.sin t • !![(0 : ℝ), 1; -1, 0]

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Existe.doc: /-- The first Picard iterate of `y' = y`, `y(0) = 1`: `1 + ∫₀ˣ 1 = 1 + x`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Existe.statement: theorem picard_exp_iterate_one (x : ℝ) : 1 + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..x, (1 : ℝ) = 1 + x

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.SturmL.statement: theorem fs_b3 : 2 / Real.pi * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..Real.pi, x * (Real.pi - x) * Real.sin (3 * x) = 8 / (27 * Real.pi)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Harmon.doc: /-- The period is `2π/ω₀`, independent of the amplitude. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Harmon.statement:
theorem undamped_period (R φ ω₀ t : ℝ) (hω : ω₀ ≠ 0) :
    R * Real.cos (ω₀ * (t + 2 * Real.pi / ω₀) - φ) = R * Real.cos (ω₀ * t - φ)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Matrix.statement:
theorem exp_diagonal_smul {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (t • Matrix.diagonal d) = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Real.exp (t * d i))

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Separa.doc: /-- The Euler equation `r²R'' + rR' - n²R = 0` has the solution `R = rⁿ` (`r > 0`) … -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Separa.statement:
theorem euler_rn (n r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    r ^ 2 * deriv (fun s => deriv (fun ρ => ρ ^ n) s) r + r * deriv (fun ρ => ρ ^ n) r - n ^ 2 * r ^ n = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Laplac.statement:
theorem laplacian_r_sq (x y : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun s => deriv (fun r => r ^ 2 + y ^ 2) s) x + deriv (fun s => deriv (fun r => x ^ 2 + r ^ 2) s) y = 4

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Linear.doc:
/-- Bernoulli's substitution: if `y > 0` solves `y' + p y = q yⁿ` then `u = y^{1-n}` solves
`u' + (1 - n) p u = (1 - n) q`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Linear.statement:
theorem bernoulli_substitution (n : ℝ) (p q y : ℝ → ℝ) (x y' : ℝ) (hpos : 0 < y x) (hy : HasDerivAt y y' x)
    (he : y' + p x * y x = q x * y x ^ n) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => y s ^ (1 - n)) ((1 - n) * q x - (1 - n) * p x * y x ^ (1 - n)) x

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Classi.doc: /-- Its coefficient matrix `diag(1, -c²)` has determinant `-c² < 0`: one positive and one negative eigenvalue. -/

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Resona.doc: /-- … upper bound. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Resona.statement: theorem numbers_peak_upper : 8 / Real.sqrt 15 < (1033 / 500 : ℝ)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Existe.doc: /-- The Picard iterates of `y' = x + y`, `y(0) = 1`: `y₁ = 1 + x + x²/2`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Existe.statement: theorem picard_xy_one (x : ℝ) : 1 + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..x, (s + 1) = 1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Matrix.statement:
theorem exp_one_add_nilpotent {n : ℕ} (N : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hN : N * N = 0) (t : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (t • (1 + N)) = Real.exp t • (1 + t • N)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.SturmL.doc: /-- Hence `λ ≥ 0`: `λ ∫wu² = ∫(pu'² + qu²)` with `∫wu² > 0` and the right side `≥ 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.SturmL.statement: theorem sl_nonnegative (l W P Q : ℝ) (hW : 0 < W) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (h : l * W = P + Q) : 0 ≤ l

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Laplac.statement:
theorem polar_rn_cos (n r θ : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    deriv (fun s => deriv (fun ρ => ρ ^ n * Real.cos (n * θ)) s) r + 1 / r * deriv (fun ρ => ρ ^ n * Real.cos (n * θ)) r +
      1 / r ^ 2 * deriv (fun s => deriv (fun φ => r ^ n * Real.cos (n * φ)) s) θ = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Orthog.statement: theorem gs_x2 : ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, x ^ 2 = 2 / 3

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.ODECom.doc:
/-- The Picard iterates of `y' = ay`, `y(0) = 1` are the Taylor polynomials of `e^{ax}`:
`1 + ∫₀ˣ a Σ_{j≤k} (as)ʲ/j! ds = Σ_{j≤k+1} (ax)ʲ/j!`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.ODECom.statement:
theorem picard_linear_iterate (a x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    1 + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..x, a * taylorExp a s k = taylorExp a x (k + 1)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.HeatEq.doc: /-- The heat kernel `K(t, x) = e^{-x²/(4κt)}/√(4πκt)` solves `u_t = κu_xx` for `κ, t > 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.HeatEq.statement:
theorem kernel_solves (κ t x : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (ht : 0 < t) (h4 : 4 * κ * t ≠ 0) (hs : 0 < 4 * Real.pi * κ * t) :
    deriv (fun s => Real.exp (-x ^ 2 / (4 * κ * s)) / Real.sqrt (4 * Real.pi * κ * s)) t =
      κ * deriv (fun y => deriv (fun z => Real.exp (-z ^ 2 / (4 * κ * t)) / Real.sqrt (4 * Real.pi * κ * t)) y) x

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Resona.doc: /-- Every solution approaches the steady state: the free part `e^{-γt}·(bounded)` tends to `0` for `γ > 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Resona.statement:
theorem transient_decays (γ C : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ t, |f t| ≤ C) :
    Tendsto (fun t => Real.exp (-γ * t) * f t) atTop (𝓝 0)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Existe.doc: /-- `y₄ = 1 + x + x² + x³/3 + x⁴/12 + x⁵/120`, agreeing with the Taylor polynomial of `2eˣ - x - 1` up to degree 4. -/

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Orthog.statement: theorem sin11 : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..Real.pi, Real.sin (1 * x) * Real.sin (1 * x) = Real.pi / 2

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Stabil.doc:
/-- For complex eigenvalues `α ± iβ` (`β ≠ 0`): trace `2α`, determinant `α² + β² > 0`, so the real parts are
negative exactly when `tr < 0` and `det > 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Stabil.statement: theorem stable_complex_iff (α β : ℝ) (hβ : β ≠ 0) : α < 0 ↔ (2 * α < 0 ∧ 0 < α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Orthog.statement: theorem cos33 : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..Real.pi, Real.cos (3 * x) * Real.cos (3 * x) = Real.pi / 2

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.PDECom.doc: /-- Linear dispersion `ω ≈ ω₀ + v(k - k₀)`: `kx - ωt = k(x - vt) - (ω₀ - vk₀)t`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.PDECom.statement: theorem packet_phase (k x t ω₀ v k₀ : ℝ) : k * x - (ω₀ + v * (k - k₀)) * t = k * (x - v * t) - (ω₀ - v * k₀) * t

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Orthog.statement: theorem cos23 : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..Real.pi, Real.cos (2 * x) * Real.cos (3 * x) = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Bessel.doc:
/-- `d/dx[xⁿJₙ] = xⁿJₙ₋₁` for `n = 1`, on the truncations at `k = 2`: `d/dx[x(x/2 - x³/16 + x⁵/384)]
= x(1 - x²/4 + x⁴/64)`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Bessel.statement:
theorem truncated_recurrence_up (x : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun s => s * (1 / 2 * s - 1 / 16 * s ^ 3 + 1 / 384 * s ^ 5)) x = x * (1 - 1 / 4 * x ^ 2 + 1 / 64 * x ^ 4)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.DeltaF.doc: /-- Its flux through the sphere of radius `R` is `1`: `∫₀^{2π}∫₀^π (1/(4πR²)) R² sin θ dθ dφ = 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.DeltaF.statement:
theorem coulomb_flux (R : ℝ) (hR : R ≠ 0) :
    ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..Real.pi, 1 / (4 * Real.pi * R ^ 2) * (R ^ 2 * Real.sin θ) = 1

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Exerci.doc: /-- (b) The static shape under `f = 1`: `∫₀ˣ ξ(π - x)/π dξ + ∫ₓ^π x(π - ξ)/π dξ = x(π - x)/2`; the first piece … -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Exerci.statement: theorem string_static_left (x : ℝ) : ∫ ξ in (0 : ℝ)..x, ξ * (Real.pi - x) / Real.pi = x ^ 2 * (Real.pi - x) / (2 * Real.pi)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Ordina.statement:
theorem euler_sq_solves (y : ℝ → ℝ) (hy : y = fun s => s ^ 2) (x : ℝ) :
    x ^ 2 * deriv (deriv y) x - 2 * y x = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.PDECom.statement:
theorem dalembert_example_position (c x : ℝ) :
    (Real.exp (-(x - c * 0) ^ 2) + Real.exp (-(x + c * 0) ^ 2)) / 2 + Real.cos x * Real.sin (c * 0) / c =
      Real.exp (-x ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Orthog.statement: theorem cos01 : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..Real.pi, Real.cos (0 * x) * Real.cos (1 * x) = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Bessel.doc:
/-- If `F` satisfies Bessel's equation of order `0`, `y²F'' + yF' + y²F = 0`, then `u(x) = F(jx)` has
`u' = jF'(jx)`, `u'' = j²F''(jx)` and `x²u'' + xu' + j²x²u = 0`, that is `-(xu')' = j²xu`: the drum modes are
Sturm-Liouville eigenfunctions with weight `x`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Bessel.statement:
theorem drum_mode (j x : ℝ) (F F' F'' : ℝ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ y, HasDerivAt F (F' y) y) (hF' : ∀ y, HasDerivAt F' (F'' y) y)
    (hB : ∀ y, y ^ 2 * F'' y + y * F' y + y ^ 2 * F y = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => F (j * s)) (j * F' (j * x)) x ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun s => j * F' (j * s)) (j ^ 2 * F'' (j * x)) x ∧
      x ^ 2 * (j ^ 2 * F'' (j * x)) + x * (j * F' (j * x)) + j ^ 2 * x ^ 2 * F (j * x) = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Greens.doc: /-- `r²G' = rv' - v` for `G = v/r`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Greens.statement:
theorem yukawa_substitution_derivative (v : ℝ → ℝ) (v' r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hv : HasDerivAt v v' r) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => v s / s) ((r * v' - v r) / r ^ 2) r

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.PhaseP.doc: /-- The energy's time derivative: `d/dt (ω²/2 - cos θ) = ω ω̇ + sin θ θ̇` (the chain rule along a trajectory). -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.PhaseP.statement:
theorem pendulum_energy_deriv (θ ω : ℝ → ℝ) (θ' ω' t : ℝ) (hθ : HasDerivAt θ θ' t) (hω : HasDerivAt ω ω' t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => ω s ^ 2 / 2 - Real.cos (θ s)) (ω t * ω' + Real.sin (θ t) * θ') t
theorem dissipation_rate (γ q' q'' dV : ℝ) (h : q'' + γ * q' + dV = 0) : q' * q'' + dV * q' = -γ * q' ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Greens.statement: theorem tent_load_right (x : ℝ) : ∫ ξ in x..1, x * (1 - ξ) = x * (1 - x) ^ 2 / 2

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Feynma.doc: /-- The retarded residues sum: `-i(-e^{-iωt}/(2ω) + e^{iωt}/(2ω)) = sin ωt/ω` (with `e^{±iωt} = c ± is`). -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Feynma.statement:
theorem retarded_residues (i c s ω : ℂ) (hi : i ^ 2 = -1) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    -i * (-(c - i * s) / (2 * ω) + (c + i * s) / (2 * ω)) = s / ω

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Resona.doc: /-- `A(ω₀) = 1/(2γω₀) = 2`, slightly below the peak. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Resona.statement: theorem numbers_natural : (1 : ℝ) / (2 * (1 / 4) * 1) = 2

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.PhaseP.doc: /-- The separatrix `E = 1` passes through the upright equilibria: `E(±π, 0) = 0²/2 - cos π = 1`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.PhaseP.statement: theorem separatrix_energy : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 - Real.cos Real.pi = 1

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Linear.statement:
theorem bernoulli_example_solves (y : ℝ → ℝ) (hy : y = fun s => 1 / (1 + Real.exp s)) (x : ℝ) :
    deriv y x + y x = y x ^ 2

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Linear.doc: /-- Combinations `αy₁ + βy₂` of homogeneous solutions are homogeneous solutions. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Linear.statement:
theorem homogeneous_combination (p y₁ y₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (α β x : ℝ) (h₁ : HasDerivAt y₁ (-(p x * y₁ x)) x)
    (h₂ : HasDerivAt y₂ (-(p x * y₂ x)) x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => α * y₁ s + β * y₂ s) (-(p x * (α * y₁ x + β * y₂ x))) x

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Stabil.doc: /-- … and eigenvalues `-½ ± i√15/2`: a spiral sink. -/

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Bounda.doc: /-- … and vanishes at `0` and at `π` for integer `n`: `sin nπ = 0`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Bounda.statement: theorem sine_mode_boundary (n : ℕ) : Real.sin (n * 0) = 0 ∧ Real.sin (n * Real.pi) = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Resona.statement:
theorem beats_velocity (F ω₀ ω : ℝ) (q : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hq : q = fun s => F / (ω₀ ^ 2 - ω ^ 2) * (Real.cos (ω * s) - Real.cos (ω₀ * s))) : deriv q 0 = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Matrix.statement:
theorem exp_add_of_commute {n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (h : A * B = B * A) :
    NormedSpace.exp (A + B) = NormedSpace.exp A * NormedSpace.exp B

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.WaveEq.doc: /-- … the phase velocity exceeds `1` and the group velocity is below `1` (`k > 0`, `m ≠ 0`). -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.WaveEq.statement:
theorem kg_velocities_bounds (k m : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    1 < Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + m ^ 2) / k ∧ k / Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + m ^ 2) < 1

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.DeltaF.doc:
/-- Integrating `(2/π)Σₙ sin nξ sin nx` against `sin mx` term by term leaves `sin mξ` (orthogonality), for a finite
sum containing `m`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.DeltaF.statement:
theorem delta_series_against_sine (N m : ℕ) (hm : m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N) (ξ : ℝ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, 2 / Real.pi * Real.sin (n * ξ) *
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..Real.pi, Real.sin (n * x) * Real.sin (m * x) = Real.sin (m * ξ)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Bounda.statement:
theorem negative_case_solves (μ C₁ C₂ : ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : u = fun s => C₁ * Real.exp (μ * s) + C₂ * Real.exp (-μ * s))
    (x : ℝ) : deriv (deriv u) x - μ ^ 2 * u x = 0

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Exerci.doc: /-- … `∫_ξ^π ξ(π - x)/π sin x dx` … -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Exerci.statement:
theorem string_coeff1_right (ξ : ℝ) :
    ∫ x in ξ..Real.pi, ξ * (Real.pi - x) / Real.pi * Real.sin (1 * x) =
      ξ / Real.pi * ((Real.pi - ξ) * Real.cos (1 * ξ) / 1 + Real.sin (1 * ξ) / 1 ^ 2)

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Harmon.statement:
theorem underdamped_ivp_position (γ ωd : ℝ) (q : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hq : q = fun s => Real.exp (-γ * s) * (Real.cos (ωd * s) + γ / ωd * Real.sin (ωd * s))) : q 0 = 1

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Exerci.doc: /-- (b) The box modes `sin n₁x sin n₂y sin n₃z` have `-∇² = n₁² + n₂² + n₃²`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Exerci.statement:
theorem kg_box_mode (n₁ n₂ n₃ x y z : ℝ) :
    -(deriv (fun s => deriv (fun r => Real.sin (n₁ * r) * Real.sin (n₂ * y) * Real.sin (n₃ * z)) s) x +
      deriv (fun s => deriv (fun r => Real.sin (n₁ * x) * Real.sin (n₂ * r) * Real.sin (n₃ * z)) s) y +
      deriv (fun s => deriv (fun r => Real.sin (n₁ * x) * Real.sin (n₂ * y) * Real.sin (n₃ * r)) s) z) =
      (n₁ ^ 2 + n₂ ^ 2 + n₃ ^ 2) * (Real.sin (n₁ * x) * Real.sin (n₂ * y) * Real.sin (n₃ * z))

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Stabil.doc: /-- A positive eigenvalue makes the origin unstable: along an eigenvector the solution `e^{λt}c` (`c > 0`) escapes. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Stabil.statement: theorem unstable_escape (l c : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (hc : 0 < c) : Tendsto (fun t => Real.exp (l * t) * c) atTop atTop

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Legend.doc:
/-- The generating function to order `t²`: `s = 1 + xt + P₂t²` satisfies `(1 - 2xt + t²)s² = 1 + O(t³)`, so
`s = (1 - 2xt + t²)^{-1/2} + O(t³)`. -/

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.SturmL.doc: /-- From the sphere: with `x = cos θ`, `d/dθ(sin θ dP₂(cos θ)/dθ) = sin θ ((1 - x²)P₂'' - 2xP₂')`. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.SturmL.statement:
theorem legendre_sphere_P2 (θ : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => Real.sin t * deriv (fun φ => (3 * Real.cos φ ^ 2 - 1) / 2) t) θ =
      Real.sin θ * ((1 - Real.cos θ ^ 2) * 3 - 2 * Real.cos θ * (3 * Real.cos θ))

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.Resona.doc: /-- Its amplitude: `a² + b² = F²/Δ`, so `A(ω) = F/√Δ`. -/

KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.PhaseP.doc: /-- The angular velocity `q ṗ - p q̇ = -(q² + p²) < 0`: the circles are traversed clockwise. -/
KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.PhaseP.statement: theorem oscillator_clockwise (q p q' p' : ℝ) (hq : q' = p) (hp : p' = -q) : q * p' - p * q' = -(q ^ 2 + p ^ 2)
